chapters.title: Chapter 301: Bewitched
paragraphs: The demons at the 3rd Legion rank who were commanding the small army of demons were baffled when Vritra and the others suddenly started killing them.
It was supposed to be a surprise attack for the humans, but the demons were caught off guard this time.
The six or so commanders instantly rushed towards Vritra; he seemed to be the biggest threat to their army.
But all of a sudden, they were surrounded by darkness and lost their sense of space and time.
Then a terrifying sorcerer rose in front of them out of that darkness, holding a big staff in his hand.
"F- Fourth Legion rank?!! How is there someone like this among these humans, he is not even a human!!" one of the commanders spoke in terror.
All their fighting spirit was put out the moment Hellmancer appeared.
"This mission is a failure, we have to run and give this information back to our base. This God of Mercy isn’t as weak as we were told, damn the Slave Beast Gang."
Another commander said as they took random directions and tried to flee.
GHUUUUUOOOOOOOO
A ghostly sound rang out as Hellmancer chanted something, and in the next moment, worm-like creatures began to wriggle under the skin and through the veins of all the demon commanders.
They had no time to understand anything as intense pain coursed through their bodies.
The most they could do was try to rip out those worms from their bodies, as the demon commanders tore their own skin and veins, but it was of no use.
Within a few moments, they lost complete control of their bodies. All of them were terrified and for the first time experienced what true despair and regret was.
Then Hellmancer simply ordered the commanders to fly into the midst of their army and self-destruct.
’N- No, we can’t do this, we could never harm our brethren. Ughhh, it hurts so much, just kill us instead of this torture.’ All the commanders were in a similar condition.
The darkness disappeared, and despite their internal struggle, they flew towards their army, who had no idea what had happened, and then...
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
Explosion upon explosion took place, more than fifty percent of the demons were instantly killed, and Vritra received an enormous amount of experience points.
Meanwhile, the soul wraiths devoured all their souls.
Onest was shocked to see such a scene. Vritra and the three women were unstoppable; they made this battle look so easy.
’Uh... Shouldn’t I do something as well? I am an agent too...’ he thought but couldn’t find the right time to join the battle.
A couple of the demons separated from the army and flew towards the crowd; Onest finally felt his time had come.
He rushed forward and slashed their bodies into several pieces.
But just when he was about to deliver the final blow, a black shadow flashed by, too fast to be seen, and killed both the demons.
"H- Huh? What just happened? Why didn’t I receive any experience points?" Onest spoke in bewilderment.
He looked back, and seeing that none of the enemy could get close to the people, he flew forward to take part in the battle.
But again, after he injured a demon gravely and was about to finish it off, someone stole his kill again.
"What the fuck is going on? A- Am I being haunted by a ghost or something, was that monk right?" Onest shivered and decided to resume his great role of protecting all the people.
Vritra, Fiona, Vanessa, and Diana—all of them were bathed in blood, but it was so much fun.
Sensing the commotion, Yennefer, who was away from the capital, flew back towards the entrance of the White Kingdom upon ending her search. The protector of the emperor followed behind her as usual.
By the time they arrived at the entrance, the battle had already been going on for an hour or so, and barely any demons were left while all the gang members were already dead.
Yennefer scanned the surroundings, and soon her gaze focused on Vritra.
Yasmine had informed him about her presence in advance, so he had already deactivated the Switch skill and was now fighting with his own actual strength while even hiding the soul wraiths.
Yet Yennefer, just after sensing his energy, was a hundred percent sure that it was Vritra. Her lips curled up as she finally caught him.
She was about to fly up to Vritra, but the breathtaking sight in front of her made her halt in the air.
Ever since she was little, Yennefer had been obsessed with strength and killing demons, and had no other interests.
But seeing Vritra’s current image—bathed in the blood of demons, two battle axes in his hands, the complete warrior-like figure—the heart of the heartless empress skipped a beat.
For some reason, that image was too addictive and intoxicating. Yennefer stared absentmindedly at him as Vritra exterminated the remaining demons.
She turned around abruptly and took a deep breath, but whether she closed her eyes or opened them, that image was deeply engraved into her very being.
Her body turned on its own, and her gaze drifted back to him.
’Why... does he look so charming? So strong and attractive...’ the thought crept into her brain on its own, as she watched the remaining battle.
All these feelings were foreign for the empress, as a tsunami of emotions struck the ice shell she had formed around herself ever since she was little.
Shaking her head, Yennefer glanced one more time at the blood-soaked Vritra and then flew away, not wanting to let herself be impacted by that image or these strange feelings.
"Haa, and we are done." Vritra spoke as he killed the last demon.
"Yennefer is gone, but how shocking..." Yasmine said, thinking about that entranced look that appeared on the empress’s face.
Yennefer was truly emotionless, so it was a shock for Yasmine.
"What is?" Vritra asked as he looked at his fierce women, all of them looking so damn good.
"It’s nothing. Anyway, what a great event this was—we got Sin Points, experience points, merit points from the Golden Moon, the souls of enemies, and the true devotion of people."
The dragon waifu replied, and to be honest, she too felt her breath stolen at Vritra’s current image, even though he was in Ben Tennyson’s form.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +193,281}
{Sin Point Gained: Cheered for +189,329}
{Sin Point Gained: Prayed +189,810}
{Sin Point Gained: Devoted +189,735}
"Yeah, this was truly great." Vritra spoke as he glanced at the new messages, then raising his right hand he let out a thunderous shout: "WE WON!!"
The crowd almost went crazy, as they chanted his name, prayed to him, praised him, and sent a flood of Sin Points towards Vritra.
"Haa, that felt so good, and my level went up by a lot." Diana said as she arrived beside him. She put away her weapons, and the wings on her back disappeared.
The goddess, covered in blood with that big smile, looked quite twisted and gorgeous at the same time.
Wiping her cheek, Vritra spoke: "You fought well. Diana, you have become stronger."

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Returning Gift
paragraphs: The battle ended and finally the guards started the cleanup, there were a lot of limbs scattered all over the place, not to mention the blood that covered the land.
Vritra and the others left to get cleaned up and returned soon after. After this incident, the popularity of the God of Mercy shot through the roof.
More and more people started to have faith in Vritra, though many still wondered if Vritra was seeking some sort of benefit through this.
And many felt that he might not be alive for long against an organization as big as the Slave Beast Gang.
But Vritra didn’t care about any of that. After the entire place was cleaned up and things returned to normal, he sat on his chair and asked Monk Shitless to continue the interview.
The rest of the day of Vritra’s first duty as an agent passed quite peacefully. And upon hearing about the news, Joey asked Vritra to come visit him the next day through the communication glyph.
Just a few more days like this and he would become too rich, to the point he wouldn’t even mind wasting a few million points on the lottery, of course after upgrading several things.
Vritra was flying back towards the castle in the evening at a rather slow pace, while lots of people kept chanting his name and praying as if he truly was a god.
’I am sure after this incident, even stronger opponents from this gang will come, and even demons.
Hmm, things might get problematic if even Hellmancer and Dark Knight can’t handle them.’ Vritra thought.
He wouldn’t underestimate his opponents, especially since they could survive so openly in such a strong kingdom.
The attack today was just to scare him, but they judged his strength wrongly, which had the opposite effect from what they intended.
While flying back, he opened his status window to check his stats.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Level: 2,804 (2nd Legion Rank)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank A) [SSS+(?)]
Title: The Cursed Hunter [Lv.10]
Race: Demon God (Origin), Dragon
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength: 63,398
Agility: 75,513
Endurance: 61,762
Intelligence: 72,539
Luck: 512
[Allocation Points: 4,300]
’Nice, I gained quite a lot of levels and a whole lot of sin points, heh I could fight to protect on a daily basis if the rewards are so damn good.’
Vritra thought, and like always invested his sin points in Agility and Intelligence.
Stats:
Strength: 63,398
Agility: 77,233
Endurance: 61,762
Intelligence: 75,119
Mana (Stat): 63,041
Luck: 512
[Allocation Points: 0]
Despite his excitement, Vritra didn’t even glance at the sin points. He wanted to give himself a surprise after collecting a lot of points.
After a long day at work, they returned to the castle. Monk Shitless also got a room in the castle, since he was the servant of the God of Mercy, so he was treated with respect.
"Wifey, I am in such a great mood today, tell me if there is anything you want." Vritra said as he climbed the stairs of the castle.
"Anything? Don’t regret it later, hehe." She said playfully.
Vritra rolled his eyes, she was back to her mischievous self.
"Yeah, just ask for anything." He replied, thinking aside from Soul Potions what could she possibly need.
"Hehe, then slap Joey and Han." Yasmine said, making Vritra stop abruptly.
"Uh... What? Why do you even want that? And do you want me to get fired right on the second day? And Han? He could kill me just as easily, you are joking right?" he questioned.
"Yes, I was just joking about Han’s part, but I would really like it if you can slap that old man." She replied.
"Why?"
"I am sure you are aware as well, but he is simply making the two of you do extra work while he must be resting in his room.
I know this turned out to be advantageous for you, but in truth, he is just taking advantage of the situation.
There is no way two newcomers would be assigned such a duty right off the bat, and I just don’t like people like that." She answered.

"Yeah, I know. I am sure it must be his task to keep a watch over the entrance where the possibility of the attack is the highest. Haa, but completing your request will be a bit tough." Vritra said and decided to think about it later.
The group of four entered the castle. By now, almost all the people knew about the latest incident.
Just by walking simply, Vritra was still receiving quite a bit of sin points. He saw Diddy and the others while they were walking towards the dining room, the group of six seemed quite frightened.
They ate dinner in peace, and after a walk in the market, they returned to their room.
Vritra found it a bit strange that he hadn’t encountered Yennefer even once, when she would just pop out anytime like a ghost.
And so another wonderful day ended, as Vritra once again found himself surrounded by the soft bodies of his women.
Early the next morning, Vritra got dressed up in his Golden Moon uniform, and after having breakfast, he decided to head to the base of Golden Moon.
After giving goodbye kisses to the three women, he told them to just meet him at the entrance after an hour or so, where he would resume collecting sin points.
"Haa, what a fresh start to another wonderful day, let’s earn even more sin points today." Vritra said, flying through the capital as people kept looking up at him.
"Heh, remember your promise, right?" Yasmine reminded, and Vritra could only sigh.
It wasn’t long before he arrived at the entrance of the base. The guards saluted as Vritra entered and headed directly towards the training field.
"Oh mugger, you are here as well? Ha, what a great way to ruin my perfect day." Vritra said with a shake of his head.
"Tch, Psycho, I... uhm... I will give a better reply after thinking." Onest said after failing to give a good one-liner.
While quarrelling, the two entered the training field and joined behind the short line of agents.
After a few minutes, Joey walked in front of the group with a big smile on his face. The old man was wearing his uniform today as well.
"Yesterday I heard about the demon invasion and the attack by the Slave Beast Gang, and one of our capable and new agents singlehandedly stopped both sides.
He protected nearly two hundred thousand lives while battling those dangerous creatures." Joey said as everyone’s gaze shifted towards Vritra.
Then he continued: "Yes, it is our new recruit Ben who performed this splendid deed. There are also agents like Onest who prioritized their own safety and hid behind the normal people.
Such a brave guy our new agent is. Anyway, let’s not waste our words on him, this is to congratulate Vritra today."
After Joey stopped speaking, everyone applauded for Vritra, giving him all sorts of praise, while Onest felt so wronged.
"Quiet!! Now, for saving so many lives and fighting for the honour of our Golden Moon, I feel our young agent, Ben, deserves a reward—"
Before Joey could finish his sentence, Vritra all of a sudden moved to the front and without saying a word—
SLAAPPP!!

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Suffocating
paragraphs: Before Joey could finish his sentence, Vritra all of a sudden moved to the front and without saying a word—
SLAAPPP!!
There was pin-drop silence all of a sudden.
Everyone stared at Vritra and Joey in shock. The old man hadn’t expected it in the least bit, that’s why despite his fast reflexes he had no time to dodge.
A few moments passed and then anger burst out inside Joey, but before he could say anything, Vritra spoke:
"Sir, how dare you even mention a reward? Do you think I did all that, protected those human lives, fought against those demons and gang scums just for some reward?
Are you belittling me or telling me I am so low that I did all that to receive something in return?
Tch, I— I never thought you were this sort of person, you are worse than a demon, a pig, a gutter worm." After speaking, Vritra shook his head and walked away, leaving Joey in utter bewilderment.
"Sir, I never thought you would go so low. How can you make a joke of my friend’s honour in front of everyone? You utter embarrassment of a leader."
Onest finally felt a lot better, and with a grin, he followed Vritra out.
Joey couldn’t understand what he had done wrong. Isn’t it normal to reward someone in the organization after they performed exceptionally well?
All the members looked at Joey with shame in their eyes, as if he had suddenly become the biggest criminal in the world.
"Hahaha, that was so good, his face hahaha, he looked so shocked. I am sure he won’t be able to sleep tonight, wondering what mistake he actually made."
Onest laughed as the two flew away from the base and towards the entrance.
They both were flying at a normal pace while Vritra kept waving at his followers.
"Well, it was kind of a dare to slap him, he should have done his job better, you know." Vritra added, more interested in the sin points he was receiving.
As Vritra got close to the entrance, he saw a large crowd already gathered there. And in front of the crowd, a person with a shiny head was standing.
"Shout with me!!" Monk Shitless spoke in a thunderous voice and then the entire crowd roared:
"ALL HAIL THE GOD OF MERCY, THE GOD WHO DESCENDED TO MAKE SLAVERY DISAPPEAR, PLEASE HELP US!!"
"Good work, my students." Shitless added, proudly.
{Sin Point Gained: Welcomed +144,123}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +144,083}
{Sin Point Gained: Prayed to +143,952}
Instantly Vritra received lots of sin points. This evil little monk was actually quite good at managing things.
"Hello everyone, shall we start the purge?" Vritra paused in the air, an ethereal aura burning around his body, making the crowd even more crazed.
"You continue with your purge, I will go do my duty... sigh, earning honestly is so tiring." Onest sighed and walked away, he didn’t like being a watchman one bit.
The three women were already there, waiting for him, seated on either side of his chair.
Vritra took his seat, then after a short talk with his women, he looked at the growing crowd and spoke:
"I can see many people who want to be free from their tag as a slave, just take one step of courage and tell me, I will take care of the rest."
This time, more than the people who were here for free gold, there were slaves and people who came to support Vritra.
One by one, several slaves approached him. They were still afraid and unsure, but the ones who managed to gather courage received the sweet fruit of freedom.
Around three or so hours had passed, a few people in the crowd looked around sneakily.
They were from the Slave Beast Gang. Since they had failed to scare off Vritra, before sending their stronger force, they had decided to turn the crowd against him.
"I have a question for you." One of the gang members stood up and shouted, attracting all the attention.

"Hah, as if I would need money from your broke ass, I am rich. Who allowed you to even speak here? My dear followers, please kindly show this gentleman out who is wasting my time."
Vritra said, and the voice of the gang member was drowned in the angry curses of the crowd as he got beat up by people and thrown away.
The rest of the gang members, after seeing that scene, didn’t dare to speak. Even though the level of people in public wasn’t high, they hit like wild beasts.
This new day was even better than the previous. The number of people easily crossed two hundred thousand and continued to rise; Vritra’s popularity was skyrocketing.
To the point that the Slave Beast Gang had started to take him quite seriously, along with the demons, and even the kingdom’s royal family felt that Vritra was growing too big too fast.

But the royal family couldn’t do anything, at least not openly. After all, he was a member of the Golden Moon, and if they even tried to murder him, the entire family would be slaughtered immediately.
Thankfully, the demons and the Gang also didn’t make any drastic moves, probably since they couldn’t waste too many resources on a single person.
Not to mention they were going to take control of the entire kingdom anyway, so it didn’t matter if the royal family ruled it or Vritra.
By the end of the day, the number of people rose well over three hundred thousand and Vritra collected sin points like crazy.
Just in this short amount of time, the points he had gathered were going to be enormous, and Vritra just wasn’t going to stop until he had gathered a whole lot more.
Only when the sky started to turn dark did Vritra finally end the day, reluctantly, and return to the castle.
Again, he didn’t encounter Yennefer even once, but she was probably busy with her search or maybe she left. But since demons hadn’t attacked yet, she was most probably still in the kingdom.

Vritra truly felt like a celebrity no matter where he walked, all the people looked at him with respect and reverence.

"Ben, I was waiting for you, can we have a talk?" Yennefer spoke, her expression was difficult to read.

Fiona smiled, she gave a kiss on his cheek and spoke in a sweet voice: "Hurry up, darling."
A ripple went through Yennefer’s body as she saw the intimate gesture. For some reason, she didn’t like this suffocating feeling one bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Earthquake?
paragraphs: "Yes, Empress, what do you want to talk about?" Vritra asked, as the three women walked into the room.
"About... ha, it’s nothing." Yennefer said, then she turned and walked into her room.
"..." Vritra remained standing there in confusion, wondering why the Empress was suddenly having mood swings.
Then he returned to his room, and got quite the surprise. All three of the ladies were wearing sexy lingerie they had recently bought as they waited for him on the bed.
"Oh... You look gorgeous and really hot." Vritra said, climbing onto the bed. As he laid down, Fiona, Diana, and Vanessa pressed their bodies against his.
Their cuddling felt especially warm and soft today, as Vritra felt their buttery smooth skin rubbing against his own body.
They quickly got in their sleeping positions and were about to sleep but just then...
RUMBLE
Yennefer returned to her room, suddenly in a bad mood.
She sat over her chair and drank some water to calm herself down, but despite not trying to hear, she could clearly hear the voices of the poor people next door who had to share a single bed.

Hearing Vritra’s praise, the Empress clicked her tongue as she unconsciously let out a wave of energy that shot through the entire castle, making it shake violently, as all the guards went on high alert.
This was such a strong attack that they believed the demons had already started the war and had already reached the capital.
Vritra also got out of his room, looking around to see what was going on.
Then he saw Yennefer walking out of her room, with absolutely no emotion on her face.
"What?" she asked, feeling his gaze on her.
"Did you not notice that shake just now?" Vritra asked. He could even see a few cracks in the walls that seemed especially high around her room.
"No, I was sleeping. Anyway, have a good night and be careful that the ceiling doesn’t fall on top of you." After speaking she walked back into her room.
’Was that a threat? Haa, so she really recognised me, but how strange that she hasn’t attacked yet.’ Vritra thought.
He had only met the Empress once before the White Kingdom, yet he had a clear idea about her personality.
"Our Empress is getting a bit frustrated hehe." Yasmine giggled, both of them knew that it was actually Yennefer responsible for that supposed attack just now.
’Sigh, let’s just sleep now, we have to do quite a lot of work tomorrow as well.’ Vritra thought and returned to his room, thankfully nothing was broken.
Early the next morning, Vritra went to the entrance of the kingdom to do his duty for the third time. Along with his women and Onest, he arrived there while Monk Shitless was already present.
And so began the session of interviews and helping the slaves. Within just a few minutes the number of people was already above two hundred thousand and the Sin Points poured in like crazy.
As hours passed by, more and more people started to join the God of Mercy on his conquest to make the White Kingdom completely slave-free.

But it was quite strange that no organisation had made a move against him yet, neither the demons nor the Slave Beast Gang or his old enemies like Nine Pacts or Bone Blood Cult, but they weren’t aware that he was already in the White Kingdom.
As for the Gang and demons, they were most probably planning something bigger, maybe to take care of him in one fell swoop.
But for now Vritra could just continue to gather Sin Points and wait passively for their attack, though he kept killing the members of the Slave Beast Gang with his Soul Wraiths all over the kingdom.
And just like that, another day passed. Vritra collected even more Sin Points than the previous day, each day his collection kept growing rapidly.
Just two more days and his quest would be complete, and he would get some map that belonged to Divine.
When the sky turned dark, they returned to the castle. After eating dinner, they went to bed.

The same routine as the previous two days, Vritra wondered if it was okay to be intimate with the three women at the same time, but each time they were about to start, a mysterious earthquake would shake the entire castle.
So the group of four had no choice but to sleep.
The next two days passed quite peacefully as Vritra followed the same pattern, and the number of people coming to watch him had already crossed five hundred thousand by the end of the fifth day.
The messages of Sin Points flashing in front of Vritra were just blinding. He got excited just thinking about the number he had already collected.
After finishing the fifth day of work, Vritra sent the three women to the castle first since Joey had asked to meet him.

"You have surprisingly gathered quite a big fan following, don’t tell me, are you planning to rebel against the king?" Onest asked. Although they still quarrelled quite a bit, he felt they could probably be called friends now.
"What rebel, there isn’t even a king here to rebel against, and don’t ask such private questions like we are friends. I don’t want to be seen in the same space as a mugger."
Vritra said, maintaining a distance of five meters from him as they flew towards the Golden Moon base.
...or not, yeah, they can’t be friends.
"Psycho, I am not a mugger, I am a professional and respectful thief." Onest retorted.
"Yeah right, try stealing something from a person and see how much respect you would get from him, he will curse seven generations of yours." Vritra replied with a mocking laugh.
While having the friendly talk, the two soon arrived at the base. They headed to the training field and joined the group of excited fighters.
Although Vritra barely knew them, all of them were quite welcoming towards him. They talked amicably and praised him for slapping the old man.
"Cough." Joey coughed to grab the attention of the blabbermouths who were badmouthing him right in front of him.
"Ben... sigh, forgive me, it seems I was wrong the previous time somehow, even though I still can’t understand how, but I didn’t mean to belittle your patriotic feelings." Joey apologised.
Then clearing his throat, he spoke in a loud voice:
"All of you have performed your duties very well for the past five days. We are still trying to find where the king is but haa, there is no sign of him.
Anyway, we have to do our best to stop the demons from taking over the White Kingdom, and from today, your duties will be changing."
Joey said, then he started instructing all the members about their duties.
"Onest, you head towards the south and guard the backside door of the kingdom. Though that place is a lot safer, still be careful." Joey ordered.
"Yes sir!" Onest replied, missing his old days as a thief but then asked: "Isn’t Ben going on the same mission as me?"
"No, his mission this time is a little different." Joey answered, then he looked straight at Vritra and gave his instructions.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: An Easy Mission
paragraphs: Joey looked straight at Vritra and spoke: "You just need to check a few sites for any abnormal activity.
If you find anything you can just report it back to the base, and if nothing, then you are free to do as you wish for the next five days."
The old man made this mission sound quite nice, but this was certainly quite dangerous, and most probably he was shifting his own work at Vritra again.
"Are you sure a new hire like me should be completing such a big mission?" Vritra asked.
"Of course, don’t worry, we will provide a few emergency material that you could use if you encounter anything dangerous.
And don’t worry, you don’t have to be so cautious. Just go and check, if you see something then leave, as simple as that." Joey said, in a nonchalant tone.
"...Right." Vritra rolled his eyes, it was no use arguing. He would just check a site or two and then continue with his Sin point gathering.
"This here is the detailed list of the ten places you have to check, match them onto the provided map and you will easily find them." Joey added as he passed a folded paper to Vritra.
"Ah right I almost forgot, use these items in case you encounter danger, this isn’t much but will definitely help you." Joey said as he passed a storage glyph and then patted Vritra’s shoulder.
"..." Vritra held the storage glyph and scanned the content, aside from a few danger signal sending glyphs, there was food and water.
’This son a... He plans to send me onto a dangerous mission with just this?’ Vritra’s expression changed.

Seeing the developing frown on Vritra’s face, joey was afraid that he would reject this mission and then he would have to do it himself, so he hastily added: "I- if you can finish it properly then you would receive a really nice rewaarrrdddd-"
Joey knew he fucked up but he was a second too late, Vritra’s frown soon transformed into a big grin as he swung his right hand with all his strength and even activated Switch.
BOOOOOM
Joey stumbled backwards and a clear imprint of Vritra’s hand appeared on his cheek, the old man could feel slight pain in his face this time, instantly filled with anger he was about to shout but...
"SIR, HOW DARE YOU!! I expected better from you, you think I only care about these useless rewards?"
Vritra shook his head as he walked out of there before the old man could explode, it felt quite satisfying to hit him again.
Though in his excitement, he slapped a bit too hard without caring about Joey’s reputation in front of all the members.
"ptui You are a scum sir, the worst piece of shit. I can’t believe you hurt my friend right after apologizing for the same thing, what an absolute piece rotten-"
Onest spat and took advantage of the moment as he started cursing joey but seeing the expression of the old man change he hastily followed Vritra.
The two ran as fast as they could as the loud voice of the old man shook the entire building. All the other member fled as well, they didn’t want to receive the punishment in place of Vritra.
"Dude, do you have balls of steel or something? I don’t know how can you even slap that scary old man haa." Onest was truly impressed, as he gave Vritra a thumbs up.

"why don’t you try doing it too, it isn’t that hard. Just make sure you catch the old man off guard or he will beat the shit out of you." Vritra added as they flew into the sky, after chatting for a while they went their separate ways.
’Haa Looks like I won’t be to earn as many sin points tomorrow.’ Vritra thought in disappointment.
"You can if you decide to leave the Golden Moon." Yasmine said, though she knew what his answer was going to be.

’Yeah but this identity do give me a protection, at least against the kingdom and I can do as I wish here, normally they definitely wouldn’t have let a person have so much influence again after what happened with the Slave Beast Gang.’ Vritra said in his mind.
"Yeah, let’s just get over with that task tomorrow then we will start with the God of Mercy identity again." Yasmine added, but she had a feeling that something big was about to happen.
Vritra soon arrived at the castle, he ate dinner as usual with his family and then returned to his room.
He planned to look at the few places even before the sun rises so he doesn’t end up wasting too much time.
And so, after strolling around the castle they returned to the room and slept early.
"Ughh I sure am not an early person." Vritra grumbled as Yasmine woke him up a little before 3, after a few failed attempts she finally succeeded in waking him up.
"Don’t forget about the sweet sin points we will be missing if you keep sleeping." Yasmine said, knowing her husband quite well.
"Haa Yeah, Sin Points..." like a zombie he sat up, got off the bed after gently laying down Fiona and getting out of the embrace of the three women. He let them sleep and went into the bathroom.
After getting dressed, Vritra took out the list and the map, while yawning he located all the places he needed to check.
"Oh wait, I forgot to check the notifications." Vritra thought, and looked at the newest notification and indeed he was what he was waiting for.
[Quest completed.]
[You have obtained the map of one of the Divine’s Secret Realm.]
"I got it!!" Vritra exclaimed, almost waking up the three, calming himself he first walked out of the room. He decided to check the map at a safer and desolate location.
"Hah just how much I have gained in last five days, the white kingdom has been too lucky for me.
Maybe if I spin the wheel I could get a few dozens of Hybrid skills haha" Vritra laughed, letting his imagination run wild.
"Earth to Vritra chan, let’s not get our hopes to high, the least you expect the less bad you feel at the failure." Yasmine gave her wise thoughts.
"Yeah, I don’t even have any expectations, I am just planning to waste some sin points on Sin keys since I am too rich now." Vritra said acting indifferent.
The guards seemed quite sleepy, they straightened as they saw Vritra walking out of the castle. The door to Yennefer’s room opened as Vritra walked away from there.
"Where is he going this early in the morning?" she wondered.
After marking all the locations in the White kingdom map, Vritra flew towards his first and closest location which was in the capital.
After flying for a while, he could no longer stop himself from checking his Sin Points.
"Wifey, what do you say, should we check how many Sin points we had gathered in the past few days?"
"Yes, let’s do it." Yasmine agreed, sharing the same excitement.
Without wasting a moment, Vritra opened the status window and looked at the Sin points in anticipation.

Vritra shook his head as he walked out of there before the old man could explode, it felt quite satisfying to hit him again.
Though in his excitement, he slapped a bit too hard without caring about Joey’s reputation in front of all the members.
"ptui You are a scum sir, the worst piece of shit.
I can’t believe you hurt my friend right after apologizing for the same thing, what an absolute piece rotten-"
Onest spat and took advantage of the moment as he started cursing joey but seeing the expression of the old man change he hastily followed Vritra.
The two ran as fast as they could as the loud voice of the old man shook the entire building.
All the other member fled as well, they didn’t want to receive the punishment in place of Vritra.
"Dude, do you have balls of steel or something?
I don’t know how can you even slap that scary old man haa." Onest was truly impressed, as he gave Vritra a thumbs up.
"why don’t you try doing it too, it isn’t that hard.
Just make sure you catch the old man off guard or he will beat the shit out of you." Vritra added as they flew into the sky, after chatting for a while they went their separate ways.
’Haa Looks like I won’t be to earn as many sin points tomorrow.’ Vritra thought in disappointment.
"You can if you decide to leave the Golden Moon." Yasmine said, though she knew what his answer was going to be.

’Yeah but this identity do give me a protection, at least against the kingdom and I can do as I wish here, normally they definitely wouldn’t have let a person have so much influence again after what happened with the Slave Beast Gang.’ Vritra said in his mind.
"Yeah, let’s just get over with that task tomorrow then we will start with the God of Mercy identity again." Yasmine added, but she had a feeling that something big was about to happen.
Vritra soon arrived at the castle, he ate dinner as usual with his family and then returned to his room.
He planned to look at the few places even before the sun rises so he doesn’t end up wasting too much time.
And so, after strolling around the castle they returned to the room and slept early.
"Ughh I sure am not an early person." Vritra grumbled as Yasmine woke him up a little before 3, after a few failed attempts she finally succeeded in waking him up.
"Don’t forget about the sweet sin points we will be missing if you keep sleeping." Yasmine said, knowing her husband quite well.
"Haa Yeah, Sin Points..." like a zombie he sat up, got off the bed after gently laying down Fiona and getting out of the embrace of the three women.
He let them sleep and went into the bathroom.
After getting dressed, Vritra took out the list and the map, while yawning he located all the places he needed to check.
"Oh wait, I forgot to check the notifications." Vritra thought, and looked at the newest notification and indeed he was what he was waiting for.
[Quest completed.]
[You have obtained the map of one of the Divine’s Secret Realm.]
"I got it!!" Vritra exclaimed, almost waking up the three, calming himself he first walked out of the room.
He decided to check the map at a safer and desolate location.
"Hah just how much I have gained in last five days, the white kingdom has been too lucky for me.
Maybe if I spin the wheel I could get a few dozens of Hybrid skills haha" Vritra laughed, letting his imagination run wild.
"Earth to Vritra chan, let’s not get our hopes to high, the least you expect the less bad you feel at the failure." Yasmine gave her wise thoughts.
"Yeah, I don’t even have any expectations, I am just planning to waste some sin points on Sin keys since I am too rich now." Vritra said acting indifferent.
The guards seemed quite sleepy, they straightened as they saw Vritra walking out of the castle.
The door to Yennefer’s room opened as Vritra walked away from there.
"Where is he going this early in the morning?" she wondered.
After marking all the locations in the White kingdom map, Vritra flew towards his first and closest location which was in the capital.
After flying for a while, he could no longer stop himself from checking his Sin Points.
"Wifey, what do you say, should we check how many Sin points we had gathered in the past few days?"
"Yes, let’s do it." Yasmine agreed, sharing the same excitement.
Without wasting a moment, Vritra opened the status window and looked at the Sin points in anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: The S Rank
paragraphs: Rubbing his hands in anticipation, Vritra opened the status panel and both of them looked at the Sin Points.
Oooof!!
Vritra’s heart almost jumped out of his chest upon seeing that big of a number.
After barely managing to stop himself from falling, he looked at the number again to make sure he hadn’t seen wrong.
"Damn, two hundred seventy-eight million in just five days?!! Hah, we are so darn rich." Vritra laughed his heart out, his hard work had truly paid off.
"Whoa, I didn’t expect it to reach so high. Congrats, hubby, you are going to grow so much with these points." Yasmine was overjoyed as well.
There was truly no match for her husband when it came to gathering Sin Points.
Vritra patted his chest and took in several long breaths, both of his hearts beating so fast it seemed they might jump out of his chest.
"It’s been so long since we upgraded something. Now let’s see what we should upgrade." Vritra said and focused on his status window again.
Starting from the top, he began to calculate how he was going to spend all his Sin Points.
"Demon God Bloodline and Physique is 50 million Sin Points; Dragon Bloodline and Physique is 30 million Sin Points.
Hmm, let’s give 20 to 25 million to Axe of Chaos, that will make it reach the Fourth Legion rank.
Then 20 million for Dust Manipulation, 20 million for the skills Fourth Dimension, Nether Eye, Blood Lock, Forbidden, Intra Shuffle, Suck! Suck! Suck! and Elegy Parasite each.
Oh right, I almost forgot 30 million to upgrade Divine Sin Arrow." Vritra mumbled, then added:
"And that totals to around 290 million. Haa, we went a bit overboard with our shopping there. Let’s upgrade Axe of Chaos the next time, and we got our perfect budget."
Vritra couldn’t even imagine how much his strength would grow after upgrading all his skills and physiques. Though it was a pity he couldn’t buy the Sin Key, he could just earn more later on.
He flew at full speed and soon arrived at his first destination. It was a desolate area with broken houses and signs of an intense battle that must have happened years ago.
"Hmm, I don’t see anything out of the ordinary here, wifey, do you?" Vritra asked after scanning the surroundings.
"No, everything is fine." Yasmine replied.
Vritra took out the map again. He couldn’t upgrade his skills in the middle of the capital, so he soon found a location that was close to the boundary.
He also needed to test his skills after all.
Marking his current location with a cross, Vritra put away the map and flew towards the furthest location, in a hurry to have the big upgrade.
Vritra flew at full speed, not caring about collecting Sin Points—not that there were many people out at this time. He soon arrived in a forest.
The place he needed to check was somewhere in the middle of the forest, so he landed on the ground.
"But I don’t think it would be safe to upgrade my physique right here. I have a feeling that the commotion might be too big, and it wouldn’t be good to let everyone know I have Demon God Physique."
Vritra mumbled, while walking deeper into the forest.
"I wonder what would come after the God Physique. For all of us, there is no bigger entity than a god, so I am really curious about it." Yasmine said.
"Yeah, so let’s upgrade a few skills here and then head outside the kingdom to finish all upgrades."
Vritra soon saw several strange statues that were half-buried in the ground.
It was said that a large group of people used to live here, and they believed in the same religion.
But when they tried to oppose the growing Slave Beast Gang, the whole group was slaughtered, and that was when the king finally understood that this gang had grown too powerful.
But it was too late. And the gods’ statues of those people were now in these conditions.
"Hmm, I don’t think there is anything wrong here, so second location is clear as well." Vritra marked it with a cross on the map too.
He scanned the surroundings and, after making sure no one was around, Vritra took out the map he had just received and tried to understand it.
"...Why the hell is it blank?" Vritra spoke in frustration.
No matter what he tried, the map wouldn’t change. Even Yasmine couldn’t find a way to make the map work, then she spoke:
"I think this is the type of map that will only activate once you are inside that realm. It won’t work until you find the entrance."
"Damnit, what use is this map then?" Vritra cursed and threw the map into his inventory. Feeling a bit down, he decided to just upgrade his skills.
"Hmm, so where do we start from..." he mumbled and scanned the entire status panel again, finally focusing his gaze on one single skill.
"Dust Manipulation, one of my first skills." Without wasting a moment, he used 20 million Sin Points on Dust Manipulation.
[Upgrading Dust Manipulation.]
[Dust Manipulation is evolving to Rank S.]
[Evolution of the body has started...]
Just as the message popped, a storm started brewing around Vritra, making the trees shake and the ground tremble.
The radius of the storm kept increasing and soon reached a few kilometres.
Vritra hastily turned on the Fourth Dimension, but it still wasn’t contained, so he had no choice but to fly high into the sky before the entire forest and even the closest city would get destroyed.
After reaching high into the sky, a point where the changes wouldn’t affect the ground, he paused.
A strange sort of change started happening in his body, almost like he was undergoing some sort of mutation.
The whole process continued for thirty to forty minutes and finally everything returned to normal.
[Evolution complete.]
[Dust Manipulation has levelled up to level 7.]
[Body of Dust has transformed into...]
"Hoo, that was intense. People might have noticed such a big change, so it’s better to change the location first."
After a moment, he flew in a different direction, heading out of the kingdom.
After travelling for a while in the Night Forest, Vritra finally stopped and landed in the midst of darkness, surrounded by extremely tall trees.
"So now your skill has reached the S level, and considering the storm just now, it must have become truly powerful." Yasmine spoke, eager to see the description and the skill at work.
"Yeah, let’s see what these 20 million points brought us." Vritra opened the status panel and read the description of his skill, and first he got shocked by the name itself.
[Dust Zombie]
[Skill Description]: The body begins to take on the nature of dust, able to scatter, reform, and endure.
Dust spreads into the surroundings, reducing what it touches into tiny particles under your control.
Most attacks lose their meaning as your form drifts closer to dust, while your influence expands, eroding even the world around you toward the path of the Dust Lord.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +2}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +2}
Both Vritra and Yasmine were surprised upon reading that description.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Writ
paragraphs: Vritra and Yasmine read the skill description, the name was rather strange but from the description, it was obvious that Dust Manipulation had grown significantly.
After scanning his surroundings once, Vritra snapped his fingers and in the next instant, everything around him crumbled into dust.
Whether it was trees, rocks, insects, or anything else, he could change it as he wished, and with another snap of his fingers, everything returned to normal.
"Whoa, not only can I affect my surroundings to such a large extent, but the biggest changes happened in my body.
Hmm, it says most attacks will be useless against me now. And the name Zombie, is it like infecting others and making them crumble into dust or something?"
Vritra wondered, but unfortunately, he didn’t have any target for practice currently.
Vritra’s body broke into countless dust particles that spread over a large distance, and Vritra’s consciousness was actually present all over the space.
It was a lot different and more powerful—Body of Dust.
After doing a few more tests he decided to upgrade his next skill, and Vritra’s gaze moved straight towards the Forbidden skill, one of his greatest abilities.
"Let’s see what sort of route this skill will take." Vritra muttered and used 20 million points to upgrade Forbidden as he landed on the ground.
[Upgrading Forbidden.]
[Process: 0%]
A strange sort of pressure descended upon the surroundings as if everything was bound by thick iron chains, almost like everything had become a slave who couldn’t refuse any command.
The percentage rose quickly and within a few minutes—
[Upgrade Complete.]
[You have obtained the skill Forbidden: Writ!!]
Finally, the oppressive feeling from the surroundings disappeared.
Vritra focused on the new messages and saw that unlike Switch, there was a change in the name of this skill.
He directly opened the status panel and read the new description.
[Forbidden]

(Skill Description): A forbidden law shall remain non-existent. It allows you to seal a single core concept or attribute from up to five targets, rendering it null and unusable or five concepts on a single target.
The chosen concept may be physical, mental, or abstract. Once sealed, the target suffers complete loss of that function until the effect ends or is broken.
Effects and duration are based on your Intelligence stat.
You can rewrite a fundamental concept within the battlefield itself. The chosen writ/command alters how reality functions for all caught within its range.
Duration and effectiveness depend on Intelligence stat. The writ has certain restrictions.
Vritra and Yasmine read the skill description in silence.
The first part of the skill was the same as before, except that now he could seal attributes or concepts of five people instead of just one.
It was already quite a nice jump.
But the next part of the skill confused the two—writand altering fundamental concepts—it sounded a bit complicated.
"It does sound great, but how does it exactly work and what are its limitations? Will the enemies just stop breathing if you create a law like that?" Yasmine questioned.
"That would be great, but I doubt it could work like that. Let’s test it out and check." Vritra said.
Although there was no one around, he decided to use the trees themselves as his targets.
"Forbid Writ: Darkness turns into Weightlessness."
[Forbidden Activated!!]
WHOOSH WHOOSH
At first, everything seemed the same but in the next moment, almost everything in the Night Forest several kilometers around Vritra started floating upwards.
The trees became weightless and swung heavily with just the slightest breeze.
Since he was using it for the first time, Vritra forgot to control the range, and the skill affected an area of more than ten kilometers around him.
Even inside the White Kingdom, people who were sleeping in dark rooms suddenly found their bodies, beds, and everything in the room floating.
Vritra canceled the skill hastily, and with a loud thud, everything fell down. A large amount of his mana was depleted, but it regenerated quickly.
"Oh, that was a bit dangerous." Taking a deep breath, Vritra controlled his excitement and reminded himself to be more careful.
"Woah!! This skill just became a hundred or even thousands of times bigger cheat. You could literally dominate an entire battlefield with this skill and your creativity." Yasmine spoke in awe.
Vritra imagined all the ways he could use it—alter orientation laws, perception laws, bodily functions, other concepts, and so much more.
The more Vritra thought about it, the more baffled he became.
"Just to make sure, let’s try something that Forbidden couldn’t do before." Vritra thought, and after adjusting the targeting distance he muttered—
"Forbid Writ: Stones attract water!!"
[Forbidden Activated.]
SKRRRAAACK
Just as the skill was activated, within a range of ten meters everything became chaotic. All the stones turned into super magnets that attracted water towards them.
Vritra wasn’t affected by any of it in the least, but the moisture in the air and the water present in the trees were instantly pulled towards the stones.
The trees became dry instantly, the bark and veins split apart, and the sky faintly became clear within that range.
"Oh!! This is so fucking great, haha I want to fight someone so badly." He was truly happy, even more than with Dust Manipulation.
After reeling in the wonderful feeling for a while, Vritra shifted his focus away from the OP Forbidden skill and focused on the status panel once again.
"Heh, now which skill should I upgrade?" There was a big smile on his face as he scanned the status panel and finally selected the next skill.
Blood Lock!!
Vritra immediately used 20 million sin points to upgrade the Blood Lock skill, another of his deadly abilities that could allow him to kill opponents a lot stronger than him.
[Upgrading Blood Lock.]
[Process: 0%]
A bloody scent and mist filled the air, the darkness itself started to look red.
It didn’t take long for the skill to finish its upgrade.
[Upgrade Complete.]
[You have obtained the skill...]
"Mmm, so this is the scent of richness." Vritra said as he breathed in the sweet smell that surrounded him out of nowhere. It was quite pleasant to breathe.
"Huh, what smell?" Yasmine asked as she sensed that something was wrong, but before she could react, a big change occurred.
Yennefer wanted to follow Vritra but she had recently found leads about the demon lord she had been searching for so long, so she headed out to the Night Forest.
No matter how much she tried, there was just no clue about the demon lord’s current whereabouts.
The case was quite similar to the king of the White Kingdom—that was one of her reasons to stay in the kingdom.

She had sent away Han to search another place. She didn’t really like having him or the emperor around. Just while she was searching, she sensed some sort of commotion from the distance in the Night Forest.
After a moment, she decided to head there. For some reason, she had a strange feeling about going to this place.
She carefully observed the forest while flying, but even she failed to notice the trap set up by the Bone Blood Cult and demons for her.
Just as Yennefer was about to arrive at that place, something huge appeared in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: ACCHOOOOO!!
paragraphs: [Upgrade Complete.]
[Blood Lock]
(Skill Description): A Death Sentence. Once you draw or touch even the smallest amount of blood from your opponents, they would be marked by Blood Lock.

From that moment onward, with each passing minute, 1% of their combat power would be reduced until the effect is broken or the opponents are dead. You can use Blood Lock on up to five people simultaneously.
Once the health of the opponent reaches 15% or lower, you could detonate their blood from within.
Vritra read the skill description in astonishment, there were several great changes and even an addition.

The percentage of reduction of the opponent’s combat power and health had increased from 0.5 to 1, number of targets from 1 to 5 and even the option to detonate the opponents when the condition is met.
"Damn this is too dangerous, doesn’t it mean I can kill most of the opponents in less than 100 minutes, even making them explode!!"
Vritra muttered in excitement, he really wanted to try it so badly.
"That’s... a really great upgrade." Yasmine said, all the sin points so far were well spent.
"Haa so this is the scent of success." Vritra mumbled as he breathed in a sweet aroma, that pulled his body forward on its own.
"Huh, what smell?" Yasmine questioned, but before she could warn him, Vritra picked a flower from the ground and took a long whiff.
"Wait that’s the Dragon Enchant Flower!! Throw it away now." Yasmine warned but she was too late, Vritra had already inhaled its scent at such a close range.
He threw it away and in the next moment, he drew in a quick breath, shoulders hunching as his eyes shut tight and his hand involuntarily moved up to his mouth and then...
ACCHOOOOO!!
Whooosh
Several of the trees around Vritra broke apart as his body transformed into an enormous black dragon, which was easily visible even from a long distance.
Vritra had no time to make sense of the situation as Yasmine warned.
"Two people are approaching."
Vritra tried to return to his original form, but just as his body size started to reduce he sneezed again and was back to his complete dragon form.
’Fuck, what’s going on?’
Vritra cursed and was about to enter the fourth dimension when out of nowhere Yennefer appeared in front of him, she stared at him for a second before waving her hand.
Vritra was startled, thinking that she was finally here to take her revenge but then a strange layer surrounded him, making him disappear completely.
Not a moment later Vritra had disappeared, another person arrived there, Vritra couldn’t see what was going outside that protective layer but he could hear clearly.
"Human empress." A heavy voice of a man sounded, as he greeted Yennefer.
"..." There was a brief silence, then the man spoke again.
"By any chance do you happen to see a dragon around here? I am searching for a particular dragon who had run from the kingdom after committing an unforgivable crime.
I have heard a lot about you, empress, it would be a great help if you could tell me if you know anything about him." The dragon said.
Despite his polite words, his tone was full of pride, though he was still wary of Yennefer.
"I don’t know." Yennefer said and gave no other explanations, her voice sounded as chilly and emotionless as ever.
"I am sure I sensed the presence of a dragon from here, I had planted a Dragon Enchant Flower here as a trap, so please tell me if you know anything about this dragon."
The man persisted, his voice full of suspicion.
"Oh, do you think I am lying?"
A frightening aura surrounded a large part of the Night Forest, even Vritra could feel the suffocating pressure, it was like someone was trying to strangle him.
"Ah... calm down empress, that’s not what I meant.
How can someone of your position lie about something like this, please forgive me if my words were even a little offensive.
Maybe I felt wrong or maybe he was trying to play some trick on me." The man said, fear evident in his voice.
Even if he still suspected Yennefer, there was no way he would say that out loud in front of such a dangerous woman.
"Then leave!!" she added.
The dragon, who was about to speak further and about the destruction of the trees around her, paused and then nodded. It seemed he won’t be able to get any clue here.
With a slight whooshing sound he flew away, then there was complete silence.
Vritra waited for a while and after a minute or so the invisible layer disappeared, as his enormous dragon form came into view, while the empress turned to face him.
Vritra hurriedly returned to his normal form and hovered in the air, wiping away sweat from his forehead as he almost got caught by such a powerful enemy.
"Haa thank you, empress..." he spoke, heaving out a sigh of relief.
Yennefer fixed her eyes on him as her lips curled into a faint smile, then she spoke each word slowly: "Vritra, so it really was you!!"
Surprised, he finally remembered that he had forgotten to put on the appearance of Ben Tennyson just now. Clearing his throat, he spoke hesitatingly:
"H- Hello, Yennefer, it’s been long. Hmm what do you mean by that?"
"Heh, come here, I will explain in detail what exactly I meant."
The smile on her face widened, she really enjoyed scaring him, it felt like revenge for the time when she felt frustrated.
Vritra flew back as he landed on the ground at full speed, even with all his upgraded skills there was just no way he would be able to fight against the empress, so his best option was to try to run.
"Y- You know, I read in the horoscope today that people whose name starts with Y should not kill anyone today." Vritra said, while taking slow steps back.
"Okay, then I will just kill you half to death today and kill the remaining you tomorrow, that’s fine right?" Yennefer asked, as she slowly approached him, flying in his direction.
"..." Vritra was at a loss of words, wondering when did the empress became this talkative.
From a long distance away, Blunder who was responsible for trapping the empress shivered when he saw Vritra’s face, his whole body seemed to have tensed up.
Blunder, Faceless and Slave, the leader of Slave Beast Gang, were hiding far away in the Night Forest so they wouldn’t get caught by the empress, while trying to lure her towards their trap.
But unfortunately, Vritra was the one who was getting closer to the trap rather than Yennefer.
"Tch, who the hell is that boy? Where did he pop up from? If we fail this, then all of us are doomed, Blunder make it work somehow.
We only need to trap the empress— Blunder?" Slave looked to the side upon receiving no response from the crazy man.
And he was shocked to see that Blunder’s entire body was shivering violently as if he was watching the worst nightmare of his life on repeat mode, and his eyes had turned blood red.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: CHAK-CHAK
paragraphs: "K- Kill him, I have to kill him!! I have to kill him, Vritra, he has to die!! KILL KILL KILL DIE DIE KILL DIE!"
Blunder seemed to have gone crazy as he kept muttering the same thing over and over.
"What’s wrong with him now?"
Slave frowned and didn’t know what to do, he could only look at Faceless who seemed to contain some fear in his eyes.
"V- Vritra is here?!! Why is he here?" Faceless muttered, his first reaction was to stand up and flee but Slave held him in place.
"What’s wrong with the two of you?" Slave shouted, glaring at the two. They were so close to achieving their goal and getting rid of Yennefer forever.

"Uh... Sir, haven’t you heard? In the Dunshire kingdom, the two of them were beaten like dogs by someone named Vritra, they had no chance but to flee for their lives and Blunder was the one who was beaten until his body was in pieces.
I even heard he hadn’t healed yet even after so many weeks." One of the men from his gang approached Slave and muttered in his ear.
"Haa these uncultured bastards, and this is exactly why I don’t like working with humans, they can’t ever focus on the bigger picture and always have to cry about spilled milk."
Slave slapped the two men, bringing them back to their senses.
"Blunder, don’t let your personal feelings hinder our mission, if anything goes wrong then we will show you why everyone fears the demon’s torture." He said threateningly.
"But I can’t control that thing, the most we were able to do was relocate that entrance, if Vritra is the first to get close then he would be trapped there."
Blunder added, but from his tone it was obvious that he really wanted Vritra to be the one to get trapped for eternity.
"I- I suddenly remember something, let’s meet some other time, I have to leave for now." Faceless desperately tried to flee, but Slave held him down.
"Stop, don’t disturb at such a critical moment, our entire plan depends on trapping Yennefer then using the protector and emperor." Slave said, throwing his hair back.
"Yes, I will see what I can do."
Blunder sighed, he really wanted to kill Vritra immediately, because of him he had become slightly hunched back, it was quite painful to get your spine ripped out of your body after all.
Vritra was moving back feeling like a mouse caught in a trap while Yennefer was slowly devouring the sweet taste of victory, their reunion was better than she expected.
"Haa Sorry hubby, I can’t even teleport you away right now, since she had already sealed off the space around here, so escaping this time is impossible."
Yasmine spoke, though there wasn’t much worry in her voice for some reason, after all she knew there was no chance of the empress killing him.
She was most probably taking her revenge for the frustration she felt all this time.

"Look empress, isn’t it wrong to kill an innocent person? I didn’t even do anything—oh and sorry for cursing at you when I left, how about we just forget about all that and go our separate ways? I have three wives waiting back at home, and—"
Vritra was trying to calm the empress but for some reason his last words seemed to have the opposite effect as the tension in the air rose.
Yennefer suddenly increased her speed as she flew towards him, Vritra turned as he activated shift and ran forward at full speed, his mind working at full speed.
’Only Fourth Dimension can save me at this moment, but because of the locked space, I can’t get out even with that.
Hmm should I try upgrading it?’ he thought and regretted not upgrading Fourth Dimension first.
SPLASH SPLASH
Just as Vritra was about to upgrade the Fourth Dimension and Yennefer was about to catch up to him, Vritra found himself walking into some sort of fluid.
"It’s a trap!!" Yasmine was shocked that even she didn’t notice this before the trap was activated.
The dry land was suddenly filled with a river of blood in a small region and for some reason at this moment, Monk Shitless’ warning reverberated in his mind that he had almost forgotten about.
Be careful of the blood!!
In an instant, the blood had reached up to Vritra’s waist as he continued to climb up, holding extremely tightly onto him.
Yennefer was shocked as well, countless thoughts passed through her mind in an instant and from his expression it didn’t look like an escaping technique Vritra had prepared.

Sensing that flood of blood, Bone Blood Cult was the only thing that came to her mind and they wouldn’t have set up this level of trap for someone with such a low level, the cost of preparing it was just too high.
’So this trap was set up for me?!’ she quickly realised.
Yennefer didn’t waste a moment as she gritted her teeth and rushed towards Vritra at her full speed.
Vritra struggled against the blood but it was of no use, none of his skills worked against this liquid, in just a second the blood had climbed up to his shoulders.
Yennefer appeared close to Vritra in the next moment, without caring about the danger she grabbed his hand and tried getting him out, for some reason she felt desperate to protect him.
Just like how she protected him against that dragon just now, without knowing why she was going so far for him.
Yennefer exerted strength in her grip, trying to pull him up and even used her energy but in a short time it was just impossible to break that trap, at least without hurting him.

And with a sudden surge the blood sea swallowed them both as darkness enveloped the two and they disappeared into some sort of spatial rift, leaving no trace behind as the blood sea evaporated completely within moments.

"..." Blunder, Faceless and Slave, all three of them stared at this scene in bewilderment, unable to believe that the inhumane and ruthless empress really got devoured into the trap while trying to save someone.
"Uh... Is this an illusion or was that not the empress?" Slave questioned, they wouldn’t believe in a thousand years that the empress could actually do something like that.
"W- We succeeded!!" Blunder was overjoyed, he stared in shock for a while and then jumped up and down like a madman.
"We did it!! We killed the empress and Vritra, the future demon lord!!" Faceless was just as happy as he hugged Blunder and jumped along with him.
Slave was overjoyed as well but he didn’t act like the two. It was impossible to believe they had actually killed someone like Yennefer just like that.
"Our first and biggest step has succeeded, but don’t let this news spread, if the emperor were to hear then it would result in an endless war."
Slave said, a twisted smile on his face and after a moment, he started jumping along with the two.

Vritra and Yennefer lost their consciousness for a couple of minutes and lost any awareness of their surroundings, the two drifted through the dark and unknown rift before landing over some sort of floor.
CHAK-CHAK
CHAK-CHAK
Woooo-wooooo

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Back to One
paragraphs: CHAK CHAK
CHAK CHAK
Woooo Wooooo
Loud sound and the shaking of the floor stirred Yennefer and Vritra out of their slumber.
Her eyelids fluttered, feeling the continuous rustling of the floor, the two finally woke up.
"Mhmm What’s... going on?" Feeling a slight headache, Yennefer opened her eyes but couldn’t remember anything for a few seconds.
"Haa It feels nice but can you get up? I can’t breathe..."
Vritra muttered with difficulty; the poor boy’s head was buried under the empress’s heavy and soft melons.
{Sin Point Gained: Suffocated +1,+1,+1...}
Yennefer finally came to her senses, she looked down and found herself lying on top of Vritra, his face sinking into her tender flesh and she could even feel his warm breath on her skin.
Her large boobs had completely covered his entire face, he could feel her warmth even through her clothes.
"Oh!!" Yennefer quickly got up, feeling a bit flustered and looked around, she finally remembered that the two were swallowed into some sort of trap.
"Ughh My back hurts slightly, just from what height did we fall?" Vritra stretched his back as he got to his feet.
The two looked around and were stunned, they were actually inside a train.
There were no seats and no other passengers, it looked like an old train, like from the time of steam engines.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}
"Where are we?!! How did we end up in a train?" Vritra questioned to no one in particular, he walked close to the window and glanced outside.
It seemed to be the time close to evening, the sun was slowly setting and the train seemed to be moving over a bridge as there was only endless darkness below.
CHAK CHAK
"Do you know anything?" Vritra turned to Yennefer who was also looking at the outside in shock.
"...Just that this trap was set up by Bone Blood Cult and probably even demons for me, sigh I don’t have any idea about this place."
She answered in a frustrated tone, only greenery and mountains were visible in the distance.
It was impossible to know where they were exactly, the two had a strange feeling as if something had changed but they couldn’t tell exactly what it was.
"What? You mean I got dragged in it for no reason?"
Vritra said, looking at her while cursing his luck who always brings him to the wrong place at just the right time.
CHAK CHAK
{Sin Point Gained: Got stared at +1}
"No, I got careless because of you and we ended up here, haa..." Yennefer retorted.
"Hah! But if it wasn’t for the trap that was put there for YOU, then none of this would have happened." Vritra replied with a shake of his head.
"Hmph I was just trying to sav— to catch you, right I was trying to catch you, so Vritra where are you going to run this time?
Did you forget why you were hiding from me?" Yennefer spoke and Vritra finally remembered that it was the empress, the deadly and inhumane woman.
CHAK CHAK
"Ah Haha Sorry, it was all my fault, empress, I was just joking now." He said, taking a step back.
"..." Yennefer raised her right hand slightly to scare him a bit, but then froze, she looked down at her hands and then mumbled in a daze.
"I- I can’t sense any mana in my body or anything, it almost feels like..." she started speaking but Vritra was the one to complete her sentence.
"Like we have returned to level 1!!" Vritra too felt weak, there was no way his back would have hurt like that, even if he fell from a few kilometres’ height.
They instantly tried to open their status window but nothing happened, it was like they were normal humans, exactly like before they had started leveling.
Yennefer was panicking as if she had just heard the worst news of her life, there was nothing more dreadful for her than being powerless.
"Hubby, ughh my head hurts... this place huff I can’t stay awake for too long..."
Just then Yasmine’s slightly pained voice sounded in his head.
Vritra’s heart was instantly filled with worry as he asked: "What’s wrong? Are you alright?"
"Huh? Uh... No, I am not." Yennefer was surprised at the sudden question, but then she frowned and tried to do all sorts of things but nothing worked.
"Y- Yes, I just need to sleep for a while, and no I don’t have any idea a- about this place. I- I should be back in a few hours probably."
Yasmine spoke, knowing what his question was going to be, then she fell asleep.
’Wifey? Wifey?’ Vritra called out but received no response, but at least he could feel that she was fine.
’Nothing is working, my inventory, my physiques, mana, not even the Mythic Halos, what the hell is going on?!!’
Vritra took several long breaths to calm himself as not even tranquil mind skill was working.
"Glyphs, skills, nothing is w- working. How can this be?!!"
Yennefer seemed too shaken, almost like someone had just stolen her several lifetimes of savings.
Vritra’s stats were only slightly higher than what they were when he was transmigrated into this new world by Diana, he was now a completely normal human or not?
’Wait, the Sin points messages, why are they still popping up then?’ he wondered, then turning his back towards Diana, he used Fourth Dimension.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra’s right hand instantly disappeared, he deactivated the skill instantly, so only the skills he had obtained through the Divine Sin Wheel were working.
He decided not to tell her about it and tried to open just the panel of his Sin skills and upgrades and it actually did open.
’Yes, so these things are still working, that’s good. Could this land be related to Divine or maybe the rules here couldn’t affect the Divine?’ He decided to think about it later.
All of this was too strange after all, from the trap to this train and the seemingly normal place surrounding them.
Finally, Vritra turned to face Yennefer and spoke: "First, calm down, we have to find a way out of here."
Yennefer closed her eyes for a few seconds and soon calmed down, she nodded and replied: "Yes, let’s look around and see where we exactly are."
The two immediately began to check their surroundings, they tried opening the door to the next compartment but the door wouldn’t budge, while the train continued to move.
They tried everything but there was just no way of getting out, Vritra even tried to punch the windows but he couldn’t break the glass.
So the two could only wait inside, they sat opposite to one another with their backs pressed against the metallic surface that had a rough old paint on it.
"Is your strength really so important to you that even you lost your composure like that?"
Vritra asked, now that his body was that of a normal human, he was starting to feel a bit hungry.
"Yes." She answered simply, sitting there with no emotion on her face.
"... I am curious, why did you try to save me when I fell in the trap?" He questioned, missing Yasmine and the three other women a bit already.

sentences.text: CHAK CHAK
CHAK CHAK
Woooo Wooooo
Loud sound and the shaking of the floor stirred Yennefer and Vritra out of their slumber.
Her eyelids fluttered, feeling the continuous rustling of the floor, the two finally woke up.
"Mhmm What’s... going on?" Feeling a slight headache, Yennefer opened her eyes but couldn’t remember anything for a few seconds.
"Haa It feels nice but can you get up?
I can’t breathe..."
Vritra muttered with difficulty; the poor boy’s head was buried under the empress’s heavy and soft melons.
{Sin Point Gained: Suffocated +1,+1,+1...}
Yennefer finally came to her senses, she looked down and found herself lying on top of Vritra, his face sinking into her tender flesh and she could even feel his warm breath on her skin.
Her large boobs had completely covered his entire face, he could feel her warmth even through her clothes.
"Oh!!" Yennefer quickly got up, feeling a bit flustered and looked around, she finally remembered that the two were swallowed into some sort of trap.
"Ughh My back hurts slightly, just from what height did we fall?" Vritra stretched his back as he got to his feet.
The two looked around and were stunned, they were actually inside a train.
There were no seats and no other passengers, it looked like an old train, like from the time of steam engines.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}
"Where are we?!!
How did we end up in a train?" Vritra questioned to no one in particular, he walked close to the window and glanced outside.
It seemed to be the time close to evening, the sun was slowly setting and the train seemed to be moving over a bridge as there was only endless darkness below.
CHAK CHAK
"Do you know anything?" Vritra turned to Yennefer who was also looking at the outside in shock.
"...Just that this trap was set up by Bone Blood Cult and probably even demons for me, sigh I don’t have any idea about this place."
She answered in a frustrated tone, only greenery and mountains were visible in the distance.
It was impossible to know where they were exactly, the two had a strange feeling as if something had changed but they couldn’t tell exactly what it was.
"What?
You mean I got dragged in it for no reason?"
Vritra said, looking at her while cursing his luck who always brings him to the wrong place at just the right time.
CHAK CHAK
{Sin Point Gained: Got stared at +1}
"No, I got careless because of you and we ended up here, haa..." Yennefer retorted.
"Hah!
But if it wasn’t for the trap that was put there for YOU, then none of this would have happened." Vritra replied with a shake of his head.
"Hmph I was just trying to sav— to catch you, right I was trying to catch you, so Vritra where are you going to run this time?
Did you forget why you were hiding from me?" Yennefer spoke and Vritra finally remembered that it was the empress, the deadly and inhumane woman.
CHAK CHAK
"Ah Haha Sorry, it was all my fault, empress, I was just joking now." He said, taking a step back.
"..." Yennefer raised her right hand slightly to scare him a bit, but then froze, she looked down at her hands and then mumbled in a daze.
"I- I can’t sense any mana in my body or anything, it almost feels like..." she started speaking but Vritra was the one to complete her sentence.
"Like we have returned to level 1!!" Vritra too felt weak, there was no way his back would have hurt like that, even if he fell from a few kilometres’ height.
They instantly tried to open their status window but nothing happened, it was like they were normal humans, exactly like before they had started leveling.
Yennefer was panicking as if she had just heard the worst news of her life, there was nothing more dreadful for her than being powerless.
"Hubby, ughh my head hurts... this place huff I can’t stay awake for too long..."
Just then Yasmine’s slightly pained voice sounded in his head.
Vritra’s heart was instantly filled with worry as he asked: "What’s wrong?
Are you alright?"
"Huh?
Uh...
No, I am not." Yennefer was surprised at the sudden question, but then she frowned and tried to do all sorts of things but nothing worked.
