chapters.title: Chapter 311: The Abandoned
paragraphs: "I didn’t, I was trying to catch you and how can I allow someone else to kill you when it should be me who kills you." The empress said, looking at him with a threatening look that looked rather cute.
"Oh, so you wanted to finish me off with your hands and get the kill, well we are all alone so why don’t you try your hand at it again? I can’t even run now." Vritra chuckled, leaning backwards.
"Sure, would be a great start to this new adventure." Yennefer nodded in agreement as she crawled forward and sat in front of him over her knees, leaning onto him and getting dangerously close.
"So how do you want to die?" She questioned, resting her hand over his shoulder for support.
"Why don’t you try suffocating me like earlier?" He joked.
The empress was no longer wearing her veil, and her face looked even more beautiful from up close, the milky skin that looked absolutely delicious and those pink lips appeared so sweet and savoury.
CHAK CHAK
WOOOOOO
"How about- mmph?!!"

Just as her lips parted, the train shook violently as if someone had forcefully applied brakes all of a sudden and the empress accidentally fell forward, as her warm and tender lips pressed against Vritra’s.
Even Vritra was surprised at the buttery sensation of her lips, the previous time he helped her with the inheritance, they hadn’t kissed so this was their first kiss.
Mwaah~
’So things like this happen outside of anime too, huh.’

Vritra thought, as the two remained in that position for a few seconds, before Yennefer finally pulled herself back with a faint, wet sound—her moist lips clinging to his for just a moment longer before parting, before lightly bouncing back.
She sat back and could still feel the sensation of his lips on hers.
"Oh well, I wouldn’t mind this method of suffocation as well." Vritra spoke as he stood up, and extended his right hand towards her.
Yennefer tried her best to maintain her cold behaviour, though it was badly falling apart.
’So that’s how a kiss feels, my first kiss but he must have kissed a lot of times before this...’
After thinking this, she pushed his hand away and stood up, an unknown feeling of jealousy slowly rose into her heart.
"Looks like the train is about to stop." Vritra held the door handle and looked outside, and the endless darkness on both sides was slowly turning into land.

’I should check that map I received as soon as possible, I have a feeling that the two things are related to one another.’ Vritra thought but he couldn’t access his inventory, thinking of this he had a headache.
Vritra was in his normal form right now, thankfully internal shuffle was still working so he could hide his demonic appearance or the empress might really have tried to kill him.
CHAK CHAK
Woooooo Wooooooo
Releasing loud horn sounds, the train slowly came to a stop and the sight outside surprised the two.
It was a town with more than thirty or so houses, which was around at a distance of three hundred meters from the railway track.
They could even see several people who were talking and watching the train, so they weren’t the only ones stuck in this trap.
"Yennefer..." For some reason, whenever he called out her name, the empress’ heart jumped in surprise.
She looked at him with her practiced apathetic face and spoke: "Yes?"
"I think it would be better if you hide your status for now and while you are at it, cover your face as well.
We don’t know what kind of people live here, or if there are any anomalies, who could still use their mana—hey, are you listening to me?"
Seeing the dazed look on her face, Vritra tapped over her shoulder as the empress came to her senses.
She shook her head, just now her eyes and mind were stuck to his lips and she kept staring while recalling the feeling.
"What did you say?"
Vritra sighed and repeated himself.
"Why should I?" Yennefer asked, she didn’t like playing weak at all.
"It is not playing weak, you are actually weak right now. You can’t even overpower me, so it’s better to be cautious at first." Vritra said, sometimes women could be so difficult to talk to.
"...Okay." She nodded and picked up her veil from the floor; after cleaning it she wore it back.
THUCK
KRRRRRRR
Creating loud noises the doors of the train opened, Vritra and Yennefer walked out, and the people who seemed to be sightseeing outside were surprised.
"Oh, more people had arrived again, recently the number of people arriving here had increased." One of the men spoke.
There were around twelve men and women with their ages ranging from twenty to forty.
"Hello," Vritra greeted and then asked the question he had been so curious about: "Where are we?"
"Ah, here we go again, but they are quite peaceful compared to the red cloth ones that had been arriving here lately." Another boy said, gazing curiously at the two.
"Well, it would be faster if you just meet the town head, he should already be explaining things to the new entries that came hmmm around two hours ago." The blonde guy said.
The eyes of all the guys were attracted towards Yennefer, even with her face hidden, she looked way too hot.
While the women were staring at Vritra, it was his real appearance and he looked like a charming devil of lust or an incubus.
Yennefer frowned upon seeing the gazes of all the women and thought in annoyance: ’Hah, you should be the one to hide your face, the flies would always linger around the sweet.’
"Okay, so where is your town head?" Vritra asked, while observing the surroundings, it looked like a perfectly normal town.
There was absolutely nothing out of the ordinary.
"Right in that town hall." A woman with short black hair said, as she walked towards Vritra and said with a smile:
"We will bring you there, well it’s okay to be confused for now, you will understand everything soon."
While talking the group started walking.

Just as they entered the town Vritra noticed faint marks of blood over the ground at several places, one of the houses was completely wrecked; the windows and doors were broken as if several wild beasts had attacked.
There was a well near the entrance of the town which didn’t seem to be working, and a signboard was placed at the entrance, the name of the town was written there with big bloody letters.
"The Abandoned..." Vritra read it out, all these things made the town more mysterious.
"Oh, don’t worry, you will get used to all that." The girl with short hair said as she moved close to him, and just couldn’t tear her gaze away from him.
"Tch." Yennefer clicked her tongue, before saying: "How far is this town hall?"
"That building is the town hall." One of the guys said, while pointing.
There was a building in the middle of the town that almost looked like an old-style police station, with dozens of wooden houses made on each side.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Chopped
paragraphs: As the group walked further, the people who seemed to be going about with their normal life paused and stared at them.
For some reason, Vritra found it all quite strange, like he was in some sort of a horror movie that was in the beginning phase.
After arriving at the entrance, the blonde guy turned around, then he looked at the others and spoke:
"Alright guys, I will show our guests inside, you don’t want to get scolded by Chief Chopper for crowding the place, right?"
The others grumbled while giving sideways looks to the eye-catching couple, and finally almost all of them walked away, leaving only the blonde guy and the girl with short hair.
"Ah, in the excitement of meeting you, we even skipped over the introductions."
The blonde guy said, tapping on his head, then he looked at Yennefer and spoke while extending his right hand: "I am Mark, may I know your names?"
"..." But the empress acted as if she hadn’t heard anything, standing beside Vritra and observing the surroundings.
"Hello, I am Ben Tennyson. And well, nice to meet you." Vritra said as he shook hands with the blonde guy, who had an awkward smile on his face.
"Hello Ben, I am Lisa, it’s always a pleasure meeting handsome guys." She smiled and extended her own hand before asking: "Are you two...?"
Vritra was about to speak when Yennefer interfered: "Yes, we are married, now can you bring us to this chief of yours?"
’What’s gotten into her all of a sudden? Sigh wifey, when are you waking up? I can’t understand this woman at all.’ Vritra sighed, wondering if she really started liking him or something.
"Oh alright, haha, let’s head inside." Mark said, sensing the tension in the air.
The group of four headed into the town hall.
As the wooden door was pushed open and they walked a little into the small building, the sound of screams came out from inside.
"Don’t mind that, handsome, not all people who come to this place are as peaceful as you two."
Lisa said, chuckling upon seeing the look of curiosity on Vritra’s face.
’Haa, he looks so good and innocent, I bet he hates violence, just look at those eyes... thank you god for sending him here.’ She thought while secretly glancing at him.
After arriving inside, Mark opened the door to a room and spoke:
"Hello chief, it seems you are going quite hard at your interrogation. Like I said, just let me handle those guys, I will make them speak in less than a day."
"Mark, how come you are already back, don’t tell me—" The voice of a man sounded from inside the room, and just from the heavy voice the man seemed to be a giant.
"Yes, we have gotten new guests, meet Ben and uh... his wife." Mark introduced as the group finally walked inside.
There were four men tied to the chairs in red clothes, their bodies bruised and battered, and they barely seemed conscious.
Beside them stood a man with nearly seven feet height, tools of torture in hand and wearing clothes dirty with blood.
’Oh that’s the Chief? No wonder people decided to follow him even in such a place.’
Vritra and Yennefer had the same thought. In a place with no mana or skills, he would definitely be the strongest.
"And this is our town chief, Chopper S. Riles." Mark added, pointing not at the giant man but somewhere behind him.
"Duffus, move out of the way, you are blocking me." The same heavy voice came from behind the giant, surprising Vritra and Yennefer.
"Oh haha, sorry chief." The giant called Duffus laughed dumbly before stepping aside as a man a bit over four feet in height walked out.
"That... is the chief?" Vritra asked in a surprised tone.
"Haha yes, that’s all of the chief. Oh, and don’t mind his height, since he is wearing high heels he might look a bit too tall." Lisa laughed at the expected reaction.
"Uhm... Hello Chief Chopped— I mean, Chief Chopper, I am Ben." Vritra said with a nod.
"Hmph, how rude Lisa, I am not wearing any heels right now. Anyway, welcome to the Abandoned Town. Since this is your first day here, there is a lot you need to know."
Even with his small height, the chief had a strong presence, his body was quite well-built and he seemed to be in his late forties.
’His name sounds a bit familiar...’ Yennefer thought, but she barely knew anything about the Topaz continent.
Gazing at the two, he asked further: "And who is she?"
"She is Yenni, my wife." Vritra replied, making the empress’s heart skip a beat hearing that cute nickname.
"Oh right, I forgot to introduce the guests that arrived here before you two.

This bunch of small dicks are from the BBC, and well, they were acting quite violent before, so now they are receiving their fix. Sigh, naming themselves BBC and having such small members." Mark spoke.
"Heh, you speak as if you have checked—" Vritra joked.
"Yes I did check it personally, you see I am into men, so if you want we do a comparing compet—"
Before Mark could finish, Vritra stepped to the other side of Yennefer and replied: "Don’t you dare even think, my wife here will beat your ass."
"Cough... So Ben and Yenni, let me introduce myself. I am Chopper S. Riles, the king of the White Kingdom."
Chopper spoke, then paused to see the slightly surprised expression of the two before continuing: "First of all, let me ask, how did you end up here? And what you used to do outside?"
"We were travelling together towards the White Kingdom, and all of a sudden it felt like we were swallowed by darkness.
Then we found ourselves in a train. And as you can see, I am a member of the Golden Moon." Vritra replied while pointing to his badge.
"Oh, so you are an agent. Well, I welcome you to this town. It is good that nice people came this time, otherwise only these bastards dressed in red have been arriving here lately."
Chopper said while pointing to the men in red.
"So what exactly is this place?" Yennefer spoke. She didn’t like being powerless one bit.
"All of us are trapped here. I arrived more than a month ago. There is little we know about this place, but our strength and skills are useless here.
All of us arrived the same way as you, and we haven’t been able to find a way out.
This place is too mysterious, and going into the forest to look for an exit is too dangerous." Chopper explained with a long sigh, then he added:
"There are a couple of rules that everyone must follow here, like not hurting or disturbing others, and do not leave the house after it gets dark."
"Why?" Vritra asked curiously.
"There are things here that come out at night, and if you meet one, you will die in a really, really miserable way."
Chopper said in a solemn tone, before continuing: "In just a month or so, I have already seen enough deaths, so I would be happy if you could survive here."

"Mark, how come you are already back, don’t tell me—" The voice of a man sounded from inside the room, and just from the heavy voice the man seemed to be a giant.
"Yes, we have gotten new guests, meet Ben and uh... his wife." Mark introduced as the group finally walked inside.
There were four men tied to the chairs in red clothes, their bodies bruised and battered, and they barely seemed conscious.
Beside them stood a man with nearly seven feet height, tools of torture in hand and wearing clothes dirty with blood.
’Oh that’s the Chief?
No wonder people decided to follow him even in such a place.’
Vritra and Yennefer had the same thought.
In a place with no mana or skills, he would definitely be the strongest.
"And this is our town chief, Chopper S.
Riles." Mark added, pointing not at the giant man but somewhere behind him.
"Duffus, move out of the way, you are blocking me." The same heavy voice came from behind the giant, surprising Vritra and Yennefer.
"Oh haha, sorry chief." The giant called Duffus laughed dumbly before stepping aside as a man a bit over four feet in height walked out.
"That... is the chief?" Vritra asked in a surprised tone.
"Haha yes, that’s all of the chief.
Oh, and don’t mind his height, since he is wearing high heels he might look a bit too tall." Lisa laughed at the expected reaction.
"Uhm...
Hello Chief Chopped— I mean, Chief Chopper, I am Ben." Vritra said with a nod.
"Hmph, how rude Lisa, I am not wearing any heels right now.
Anyway, welcome to the Abandoned Town.
Since this is your first day here, there is a lot you need to know."
Even with his small height, the chief had a strong presence, his body was quite well-built and he seemed to be in his late forties.
’His name sounds a bit familiar...’ Yennefer thought, but she barely knew anything about the Topaz continent.
Gazing at the two, he asked further: "And who is she?"
"She is Yenni, my wife." Vritra replied, making the empress’s heart skip a beat hearing that cute nickname.
"Oh right, I forgot to introduce the guests that arrived here before you two.
This bunch of small dicks are from the BBC, and well, they were acting quite violent before, so now they are receiving their fix.
Sigh, naming themselves BBC and having such small members." Mark spoke.
"Heh, you speak as if you have checked—" Vritra joked.
"Yes I did check it personally, you see I am into men, so if you want we do a comparing compet—"
Before Mark could finish, Vritra stepped to the other side of Yennefer and replied: "Don’t you dare even think, my wife here will beat your ass."
"Cough...
So Ben and Yenni, let me introduce myself.
I am Chopper S.
Riles, the king of the White Kingdom."
Chopper spoke, then paused to see the slightly surprised expression of the two before continuing: "First of all, let me ask, how did you end up here?
And what you used to do outside?"
"We were travelling together towards the White Kingdom, and all of a sudden it felt like we were swallowed by darkness.
Then we found ourselves in a train.
And as you can see, I am a member of the Golden Moon." Vritra replied while pointing to his badge.
"Oh, so you are an agent.
Well, I welcome you to this town.
It is good that nice people came this time, otherwise only these bastards dressed in red have been arriving here lately."
Chopper said while pointing to the men in red.
"So what exactly is this place?" Yennefer spoke.
She didn’t like being powerless one bit.
"All of us are trapped here.
I arrived more than a month ago.
There is little we know about this place, but our strength and skills are useless here.
All of us arrived the same way as you, and we haven’t been able to find a way out.
This place is too mysterious, and going into the forest to look for an exit is too dangerous." Chopper explained with a long sigh, then he added:
"There are a couple of rules that everyone must follow here, like not hurting or disturbing others, and do not leave the house after it gets dark."
"Why?" Vritra asked curiously.
"There are things here that come out at night, and if you meet one, you will die in a really, really miserable way."
Chopper said in a solemn tone, before continuing: "In just a month or so, I have already seen enough deaths, so I would be happy if you could survive here."

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Living Together
paragraphs: "What things?" Vritra asked. This land was becoming stranger by the second.
"I don’t know, those creatures. It’s hard to describe, but if you really want to know so badly, then try looking out of your window.
But do not open the windows or the doors at any cost." Chopper warned.
"Chief, it isn’t safe. Don’t you remember what happened with the last few people who saw them?
Either they went crazy or ended up opening the door. All of them are dead now." Lisa interrupted.
"It’s his choice whether he wants to see or not. I am just explaining things here. Do you have any more questions?" Chopper replied with a shrug of his shoulders.
"Has anyone been able to find anything that could help us find a way out? And how long have people been trapped here?" Yennefer questioned. She could still perfectly maintain her calm.
"Hahaha." Chopper laughed hard for a few seconds, though only misery could be heard in his laugh.
"A way out? Forget about that, there is no way out. We are only here in a competition against death, proving how well we could survive in this hellhole.
Anyone who has ever gone out to search for an exit has never returned alive. Pieces of their bodies could be found across the town the next day.
And there are even people who had been here for a decade. We are trapped here forever." The town chief spoke in an almost maniacal voice.
"And those creatures, can’t they hurt us inside the house?" Vritra asked.
If these things were as strong as he made them sound, then how could those fragile windows and doors stop them?
"Yeah, they have worked so far. Each of the houses has a strange drawing made on them, and we believe it is that strange drawing that stops them.
Though no one is willing to test its authenticity by paying the cost with their lives." He replied.
"..." Vritra and Yennefer fell silent as they glanced at one another. It seemed this place was a lot more dangerous than they had imagined.
"Oh, it is getting late, so unless you want to spend the night in this town hall along with these Bone Blood Cult bastards, you should go find a house for yourselves.
There are a few empty ones." Chopper said, as he glanced at the darkening sky and then walked out of the room before leaving a message:
"Let’s talk tomorrow, and I hope you don’t end up dying on your first day here."

"I will show them to a house, and don’t mind his words. He just doesn’t want the people here to die." Lisa said, smiling sweetly as the group walked outside, leaving only the captives in the town hall.
After walking out of there, Chopper pressed a button that made a loud siren ring out across the town.
"So, what kind of house do you want? I suppose you would be living together?" Lisa questioned, bringing them deeper into the town.
"Yes. Anything is fine, as long as it’s not broken." Vritra said before Yennefer could speak.
"Oof, that’s a request hard to fulfil, but how about you use this house? This was previously used by the former town chief.
This house should be the closest to your high demands, haha. And as for your clothes and food, you will have to wait until tomorrow.
Oops, I need to leave immediately. Remember, lock the doors and windows and also cover the windows."
After speaking, she blew him a flying kiss before hurrying in the direction of her own house.
The sun had nearly disappeared. It was past evening, and darkness had started to spread.
"Let’s go inside." Vritra spoke and took the lead. He was sure the chief wasn’t lying about the danger here, or his Sin Points messages would have warned him.
Yennefer followed behind silently.
She was the type of person who spoke less. After entering, they closed the door behind them. The house looked a bit dirty but it was usable.
After looking around, Vritra found a switch that was in the form of a lever. Upon pulling it down, several lights turned on.
"This will be our home for the time being. You can look around and I will check the windows and doors." Vritra said.
"Do you really believe them?" she questioned.
There was a lot on her mind right now: her growing feelings for him, the feeling of powerlessness, and the unknown danger lurking in the town.
"Yes, so I hope you don’t think you are still the same powerful empress and decide to challenge whatever is outside." Vritra warned.
"I am not stupid. I will help you check them."
The two quickly got to work as they checked all the windows on both floors and then the doors.
After locking everything up and covering the windows, they cleaned up one of the rooms a bit and sat on the only usable bed.
"So—" just as Yennefer started to speak, her belly let out a weak sound of hunger.
"Ah, it’s been so long that I felt hungry like this." She mumbled while rubbing her belly.
"Mmm, wait here. I will go check in the kitchen and see if there is anything edible."
He said and walked out of the room. He didn’t trust the empress completely yet.
After entering the kitchen, Vritra checked all the drawers and shelves.
There were rotten vegetables there and some spoiled food, and after looking through that mess, he found a packet of dried fruits and a few packets of honey.
After taking them out and putting them on the counter, Vritra thought hard about the map he had gotten from his recent quest, and it actually appeared in his mind.
Though this time it wasn’t empty.
’I was right, so this is the realm of the Divine.’ Vritra thought, then he quickly focused his attention on the map.

There he saw the houses, the town hall, the well, and a big villa that seemed to be slightly broken. The whole place was surrounded by forest, and in the forest there were several things that were hard to recognize.

"Haa, looks like I will have to go to these locations and check them out myself. I am getting such an eerie vibe here." He shook his head and remembered the several locations in the forest that he planned to check later.
After grabbing the packets, he washed a bottle and filled it with fresh water, then headed back to his room.
Yennefer was sitting on the bed in silence and seemed deep in thought. She had taken off her veil and now looked extremely beautiful.
"I only found these things. You can eat these for now, we will get more food tomorrow." Vritra said as he passed the packets to her along with the water bottle.
Then he lay back on the bed, relieved that at least he left most of his Soul Wraiths with the three women, so they should be safe.
"Thank you..." Yennefer opened a packet and started eating them hungrily. Only when she had eaten nearly half did she remember Vritra.
"Here, you can have the remaining." She offered.
"It’s fine, you can eat them. I am not that hungry." Vritra replied.
Just then, a faint rough sound of something being dragged against the road filled the creepy silence of the night.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Warm and Comfortable
paragraphs: While going through the house, Vritra did see the drawing that Chopper had mentioned.
It was carved onto the wood and was more like a circular complex pattern used in witchcraft.
There were faint traces of blood and flesh around that place, as if someone had done a very bad job at cleaning. It really felt like he had entered some horror movie.
Vritra and Yennefer covered their ears. The screeching sound felt like it was directly cutting into their brains.
The faint sound of the insects died down and all of a sudden a light sound of tapping started sounding from the windows.
Tak Tak
It was slow and light, like someone knocking there. But the two of them were currently on the first floor, and there was nothing to climb up to the windows, especially so without any abilities.
"What’s happening?" the empress frowned as she shifted closer to Vritra.
She unconsciously clutched his clothes while looking cautiously at the windows that were covered by cloths.
TAK TAK TAK
"Wait, I will go check." Vritra patted her hand and stood up, surprised that something could actually scare the scary empress.
"No, don’t go." She held onto his clothes even tighter, looking a bit shaken.
"Uh... Are you afraid of ghosts by any chance?" Vritra asked.
It didn’t really make sense that she could be afraid of anything.
"No... uh, a little bit, so just stay here."
The empress said, trying her best to appear calm and collected, but Vritra could sense her body tremble slightly under the constant tapping sound from the window.
’Sigh this day keeps getting weirder, first this town and now a Yennefer, who looks cute.’ Vritra sighed before speaking:
"Don’t worry, I am not opening the window or anything. I am just going to have a look outside."
He was sure that if Yasmine was awake now she would have commented something like:"Hehe, it is the curious people like you that get killed first in the movies."
Reluctantly, Yennefer let go as she held the dry fruit packet tightly and kept her eyes locked onto him.
Vritra got off the bed and walked closer to the window. After glancing back, he slowly pushed the cloth aside, just enough that he could peek outside.
Zrrrrrrr...
TAK TAK
There was a rather big fly that kept hitting the window again and again, and then Vritra’s eyes fixed on the thing that was dragging a half-eaten human body on the road.
’What the hell is that thing?’ His eyes widened in shock at the grotesque sight in front of him.
The creature had a height of more than seven feet and it was walking on all fours.
Its hind legs were of normal size like that of humans, while its hands were at least twice the size.
It had a long neck and on top of that, something so disgusting that just couldn’t be described by words — a creature that shouldn’t exist.
There were dozens of slits for eyes on its head and sharp long teeth present from the top of its head down to its shoulders in a disorderly manner.
It was completely yellow as the pus on its body kept exploding into tiny bubbles that flew into the air, giving birth to large flies.
This creature was moving in such an absurd way, as its arms bent forward at an impossible angle, and with each step its body was releasing the noise that resembled grinding of teeth.
That disturbing sound wasn’t coming from the dead body, but from the constant wriggling of those disgusting teeth that were moving in a hideous way.
While the eyeballs kept shifting around, almost looking as if they were about to pop out.
This was certainly one of the most disgusting things Vritra had seen in his life. The longer he looked, the more twisted that monster appeared.
TAK-
All of a sudden, the insect hitting the window stopped and flew back towards that creature, as it plunged into one of its eyes, making a greenish-yellow pus leak out and burn the ground.
In the next moment, all the pupils constricted and focused on Vritra.
The moment his eyes locked with the monster’s, Vritra found it difficult to shift his gaze or move his body.
Slowly the world around him began to twist and he felt as if his entire body was becoming limp.
SCRIEEEEEEEEEEK
Terrifying scenes that could put primal fear in any living creature started playing in Vritra’s mind.
The loud piercing voice of the creature shook the wooden houses and seemed to almost break the window.
A trickle of blood leaked out from Vritra’s right eye as intense pain flooded his brain.
Right before he could completely lose his senses, Yennefer held his hand and pulled him away from the window, before covering it back.
She helped Vritra sit on the bed, then she cupped his face and spoke in a hurry:
"Are you alright? Can you hear me? VRITRA!! Here, have some water."
The empress hurriedly brought the water bottle close to his mouth and fed him some water, before wiping the trickle of blood with her sleeve.
"Haa... I am f-fine..." While breathing heavily, Vritra replied.
He felt like something just broke in his mind. Maybe this was really a bad idea, but he didn’t expect that just looking at it could deal so much damage.
"Just what did you see out there? Uh, why don’t you lie down first." Yennefer spoke as Vritra nodded and leaned back onto the pillow.
"It was a monster, that’s... all I can say." Vritra massaged his temples.
Just remembering the image of that thing made him feel a stabbing pain in the head.
"Everything is alright now, would you like to have some of these?" Yennefer’s voice was full of worry as she brought the packet of dry fruit close to him.
"No, I just need to sleep..." Vritra said as he yawned and pulled her hand, and before Yennefer knew it, she was wrapped tightly in Vritra’s embrace.
"..." Surprised at first, she tried to move but hearing his even breathing, the empress paused and gently lay her head over his arm and stared at his face.
’This isn’t all that bad, so warm and comfortable...’ Yennefer thought as her hands rose with slight hesitation, before sliding onto his body and pulling him closer.
As she pressed her body against him tightly, her heart steadied as his warmth consumed her.
The empress closed her eyes while lying intertwined in such an intimate position.
The two were stuck so close and tightly that they barely covered a small part of the bed.
Yennefer’s heart was beating like war drums and she found it hard to sleep.
His familiar scent and the feel of his muscles completely consumed her.
Soon even the noises from outside stopped bothering her as she fell asleep while clinging onto him with desperation.
She finally understood why those three women always crowded around him at night on the bed.
An hour or so after the two had fallen asleep, distant screams broke out from the outside that continued for dozens of minutes before finally dying down.
Almost everyone woke up from their sleep and knew that the town had lost more members once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Dimensions
paragraphs: It wasn’t until the sun rose pretty high into the sky that Vritra finally stirred out of his sleep.
He could still feel a headache, though it wasn’t as severe as the previous night.
Hugging a soft body, Vritra felt quite comfortable, but as his eyes opened, he was shocked to see the empress in his arms.
They were facing each other, with their legs intertwined and arms wrapped around each other’s bodies tightly.
He could feel her soft lips pressing against his neck while her warm breath caressed his skin.
’Wait, how did we end up like this? Did I pull her or something? Sigh, she is going to be so angry about this.’
He sighed and closed his eyes, but even as he tried to loosen his arms, the empress was clinging to him so tightly that there wasn’t even space for air to pass between them.
Sighing, Vritra decided to pretend to be asleep a little longer, as he tightened his arms around her voluptuous body once again.
’I should upgrade whatever I can for now, this place is too dangerous, and we have to get out of here as soon as possible.’
Vritra thought and opened the status panel, which only displayed things related to his sin system.
He had already upgraded the Blood Lock and Forbidden, so now only Fourth Dimension, Nether Eye, Elegy Parasite, Intra Shuffle, and Suck! Suck! Suck! remained.
’So many skills are still left, thankfully I have got enough sin points.’ Vritra thought and decided to upgrade them, wishing to get nice things.
He took a long breath, which was filled with Yennefer’s sweet scent.
She looked so innocent and cute while sleeping—no wonder she was one of the most gorgeous women in the universe.
Shaking his head, Vritra focused on the skills, and first of all, he decided to upgrade the Fourth Dimension; a skill that could instantly increase his defense by countless times.
Without wasting a moment, he spent twenty million sin points and upgraded the skill.
[Upgrading Fourth Dimension.]
Vritra waited for a few minutes while listening to Yennefer’s even heartbeat as her chest rose with each breath, overloading him with softness.
[Upgrade complete.]
[You have obtained the skill Book of Dimensions.]
"Hmm, what a surprise." Suddenly Yasmine’s voice sounded, surprising him.
’You are finally awake?!! Wifey, are you alright now? And yeah, this skill looks like such a good surprise.’ Vritra spoke.
"Yeah, I am a little better for now. This place surely isn’t good for a soul; the more I stay awake the more of my energy keeps getting drained.
So I would have to sleep more often. Anyway, I wasn’t talking about the skill but you. I left for a few hours and you already replaced me with another woman—sob, poor loyal me.
I can’t believe you are embracing another woman even after I woke up." Yasmine spoke playfully in a dramatic tone.
’This is not the time to joke, all of us are just stuck in this place and... well, I am stuck in her arms right now. So, in this town I even met the king of the White Kingdom and...’
Vritra explained all the events that took place after arriving in the Abandoned Town, even the strange creature he saw the previous day.
"So this is the realm of the Divine. What about that map you received?" she questioned, now speaking in a solemn tone.
’It did work, but I would have to go and check those places out.’ Vritra replied, though who knew what more dangers this place was hiding.
"Sigh, and I can’t help you at all here. Just staying awake is taking so much of my energy. Hubby, be careful." Yasmine said in a worried tone.
’It’s fine, I will soon get us out of here. You should rest more.’ He added. He could tell from her voice that she was still quite exhausted.
"Hmm, and that’s a good skill you got there. I will come out to check the other skills later.
Hubby, be safe and don’t put yourself in danger... as much as you can." After finishing, Yasmine once again drifted off to sleep.
’Haa, yes wifey, don’t worry.’ Vritra added and finally glanced at his new skill, which sounded quite good just from the name.
[Book of Dimensions]

[Skill Description]: Few dimensions aren’t enough to contain you, so create, destroy, control, store, or do as you wish. A book consisting of countless dimensions, to which you are free to do as you please.
The description was short and simple, but just like the previous time, it didn’t give him much detail about the actual skill.
But he decided to give it a try.
Just as he activated the skill, an ethereal book that seemed transparent and was only visible to Vritra floated in front of him, consisting of countless pages.
The book had such a special and magical feeling to it; on the cover, the name of the skill was mentioned along with Vritra’s name.
[Book of Dimensions activated.]
The book flipped open and shimmered with a faint light. After thinking for a few seconds, Vritra gave it a try.
After a moment, Vritra found himself in the same room, lying over the same bed, inside the same house that previously belonged to the former town chief.
But he had shifted himself and Yennefer into one of the pages of the book, copying everything to the last detail.
It was way more powerful than the Fourth Dimension; he could literally copy reality into his dimensional book.
He could bring people inside, bring even the house or his surroundings inside, and no one would even know that they were already trapped in his space.
’Dang, each upgrade is so powerful. This time again, the upgrade is better than I expected.’ He needed to do a lot of experiments with this skill, just like with Forbidden.
With just a thought, he returned to reality.
He could create countless small realms in his book, could use them to make extremely powerful explosions, and so much more.
In his excitement, Vritra hugged Yennefer’s body tightly, squeezing her soft body unconsciously as the empress stirred awake with a soft "Mmm..." sound.
Vritra’s body tensed up as he did his best sleeping act, preparing his body for the attacks she might be delivering soon.
"Mhmm~" Yennefer woke up, and she slowly opened her eyes. She had such a nice sleep that even after sleeping for more than ten hours she still felt sleepy.
The empress blinked her eyes open and then looked at the face of the peacefully sleeping man.
For a moment she was surprised upon finding their bodies intertwined in such an intimate and passionate manner.
But then she relaxed. Even though her strength had gone away, her senses had developed over countless battles, so despite his near-perfect acting, she could tell he was already awake.
’So he doesn’t want to get out of my arms...?’ Yennefer wondered.
This seemed the only possible reason—after all, there was no way he would still be cautious towards her when she was even weaker than him.
Therefore, the empress once again closed her eyes and buried her face into his neck, giving a soft kiss to his warm skin.
She decided to go along with these new strange feelings that made her want to stick to him forever.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: The Perfect SUCK! SUCK! SUCK!
paragraphs: Vritra waited for the attack, but even a couple of minutes later she didn’t react in any way.
He wondered what was going on in her head, but using this peaceful time he made the dimensional book disappear and decided to upgrade his other skills.
’Hmm, let’s upgrade Internal Shuffle now.’ He thought and spent another twenty million coins on Internal Shuffle.
As he waited, the same messages appeared in front of him and the process started.
[Upgrading Internal Shuffle.]
[Upgrade Complete.]
And soon new messages popped up.
[You have obtained the skill Intra Shuffle]
[Intra Shuffle]
[Skill Description]: This skill allows the user to transcend their flesh and assume any form they imagine whether living, non-living, or abstract.
Flesh, bone, and spirit seamlessly adapt — from stone to wood, from steel to rubber — the user’s body rewrites itself into the chosen state while retaining full awareness.
The size and form have certain limitations.
’OH!!’ Vritra stared at the skill description in excitement.
After understanding its working, he straightened his right arm slightly, the same one the empress was using as her pillow, and focused.
Even though the name had remained the same, the skill itself had a complete evolution.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Instantly, his fingers transformed into long vines, stretching several meters in an instant before turning into stone and then into wood.
As long as he imagined, Vritra could turn himself into it.
’I would have to try it later on and see what its limits are, but overall it’s a great skill.’ He thought, but still felt like something was missing.
All the skills he obtained from the sin wheel were great and increased his battle prowess by a lot, giving him means to escape or turn the tides at any time, but something was still lacking.

’Aside from the Demon Lord’s core and the other core in my body, I don’t have a very destructive skill, like some sort of trump card or anything.’ He thought, but he would have to think about it later.
While he still had some time, he decided to upgrade his next skill, which had an absurd name but was quite powerful.
Suck! Suck! Suck!
’I wonder what sort of changes this skill will have, so far all the skills have been better than my expectations.’
[Upgrading Suck! Suck! Suck!]
After a few minutes of waiting, the message of the skill being upgraded popped.
[Upgrade Complete.]
[You have obtained the skill Suck! Suck! Suck!]
Without wasting a moment, he opened the description.
[Suck! Suck! Suck!]
[Skill Description]: Just like before, what’s there to understand? Just start — SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Anything that is energy, even attacks, are meant to be sucked and swallowed.
Vritra read the skill description. The name was the same, and even the description was nearly the same, so he wondered if there was even any change in the skill.
’This skill was great and all before, but don’t tell me I ended up wasting 20 million sin points... though I doubt it. Alright, let’s give it a try.’
He parted his lips ever so slightly and activated the skill, thinking maybe its effect and radius got bigger. That would be a nice upgrade too, though a little less than he expected.
[SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Activated.]
In the next instant, a tiny, barely visible black hole appeared behind Vritra’s body just a few inches away from his skin.
With just a slight pull, an extremely powerful suction force was released instantly, making the room devoid of most of the energy as the temperature immediately dropped and became chilly.
The closest and biggest source of energy to Vritra was Yennefer, so the moment the suction force appeared, her face tilted upward and her lips parted as if something was about to leave her body.
Vritra was startled as he hurriedly turned the skill off, but Yennefer was no longer as strong as before.
That strong of a pull was enough to push her towards him — or rather, his mouth.
Chuuu~
Their parted lips were pulled towards one another like magnets being attracted, and they smashed with a soft sound against each other.
Both were frozen as they felt the soft, familiar feeling of each other’s lips.
As a moment passed, Yennefer opened her eyes in surprise, their lips interlocked in a seal-tight kiss unlike the previous kiss in the train.
As he got over his shock, Vritra slowly broke the kiss before giving a peck on her lips again and saying: "Good Morning, Yenni." He smiled faintly, acting as if this was perfectly normal.
Then he moved out of the empress’s arms and sat up. Getting off the bed, he stretched before walking out of the room, leaving Yennefer completely confused and flustered.
’W-What was that?!!’ She touched her lips, the feeling of his still lingering on hers.

"Is that... a morning kiss? From what I have read, I am sure he really does love me a lot!!" Yennefer concluded. From her observations, she was completely sure that he had strong feelings towards her.
She patted her chest, feeling like her heart was about to jump out. Even getting stronger or killing demons never gave her this sort of excitement or joy.
’But what is this tightening feeling in my chest, did I fall for him too...?’ Yennefer didn’t know much about feelings.
She didn’t even know exactly what love is.
Shaking her head, she got off the bed, her mind still filled with complex thoughts, but all she could think of was Vritra.
The bathroom was a bit dirty but usable. They both took baths but had no other clothes to change into, so they wore the same ones.
Both of them were feeling pretty hungry by now. After getting ready, they walked out of the house and looked around the town properly.

"Seeing all these people, this place feels perfectly normal. They are just living their daily life as if... they have already accepted it." Yennefer spoke, watching dozens of people carrying on with their lives.
"Maybe they have already given up on finding a way out. Let’s go meet the chief, we have to get more information before we can try anything." Vritra said.
Yennefer nodded and started walking along with him. She was already wearing her veil. As the two walked towards the town hall, all the people stopped and looked at the new entries.
"Hello, so you two came here last night?" One of the old men, reading a book and sitting on a wooden chair outside his house, spoke.
"Well, hello." Vritra nodded, and without stopping, he continued to walk.
Maybe it was just the eerie atmosphere, but even the people looked at each other with such serious expressions.
"Hey Ben, how was your first night here? Guess you didn’t try your luck last night as Chopper had suggested, by seeing that thing, I mean."
From the distance, across the town hall, Mark called out with a wry smile.
"...Yeah, anyway, what’s going on here?" Vritra asked, seeing a small crowd of people gathered outside one of the houses.
"Sigh... Hubert. He had been here for nearly three years. Last night he got too drunk and didn’t close the door of his house. H-he died." Mark said, his brows furrowing in sadness.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Sick?
paragraphs: "Oh... that’s sad to hear." Vritra said as he glanced over and saw the brutal scene, blood, flesh, bones and pieces of organs were scattered right outside the house’s door.
Although it seemed random, a faint, almost non-existent pattern could be seen.
’Hmm, that pattern, it looks a bit familiar.’ Vritra thought and walked towards the crime scene along with the three.
"He was a good friend of mine, sigh... I- I heard his screams last night, yet all I could do was hide inside my room.
It is so frustrating and frightening, is death our only escape from this place?" Mark continued, even though Vritra was barely paying him any attention.
They were about to start cleanup, a few people were crying while the blabbermouth Mark wouldn’t stop speaking about his pain and fears.
"Have you ever wondered if dying is truly the way to get out of here?" Vritra spoke suddenly, interrupting Mark and surprising him.
"Uh... Yeah, we did think of such a possibility, but seeing such death made us believe otherwise." Mark replied, looking a bit shaken and confused by the question.
Finally, he fell silent.
Vritra observed the pattern carefully, it was so vague that it looked completely random.
But the way those things were scattered and the faint marks in the blood, he definitely had seen something similar.
’Oh right, that map, one of the locations had a similar mark. But I wonder what it would mean...’ Vritra thought and finally turned around.
The smell was so bad there, as if the corpse had been rotting for days.
"By the way, where is Lisa?" he questioned, turning to look at Mark.
But before Mark could speak, Yennefer asked with a slight frown: "Why do you want to meet her?"
"We have to get some food and clothes from her, remember?" Vritra answered. The empress had been too strange lately.
"Yeah, she must be in the town hall, you can find Chopper there." Mark said and led them towards the town hall in silence.
Vritra was deep in thought when he suddenly saw an insect fly in his direction.
It was completely white in colour with countless small spikes coming out all over its body.
Before he could react, the insect struck the inside of his forearm, just below the elbow, plunging the spikes into his skin.
And in the next instant, it started to rotate and go deeper into his flesh.
Startled, his first reaction was to pull it out but it had instantly entered his flesh, sending waves of pain as it rotated within, tearing apart and going upwards towards his shoulder.
"Ughhh..." Vritra let out a mild groan as he squeezed his arm with all his might in an attempt to stop the insect, that even seemed to be cutting his bones.
"Vr- Ben, what’s wrong?" Yennefer was surprised when Vritra suddenly stopped and bent forward, letting out a groan. She held his shoulder and became nervous.
"Ben, are you alright?" Mark hurried to his side and asked, supporting Vritra from the other side.
"T- This insect..." Vritra could still feel the cutting pain inside his arm, how the spikes slashed at his bones and flesh.
"Insect?!! Let me see." Yennefer touched his clenched fist gently and looked all over his arm, but there was nothing.
"Uh... There is no insect? Is it on your shoulder?" Yennefer asked, as Vritra let go of his arm in bewilderment and looked up and down at his own hand.

’Huh? There is nothing, that insect clearly entered my arm, what’s happening? Was I hallucinating?’ Vritra frowned, there was not even a drop of blood on his arm, and even the pain had disappeared completely.
"Look at me, are you okay?" Yennefer cupped his cheek, speaking in a hurry.
"Yeah, I am fine now. I think some insect just bit me." Vritra said as he straightened.
"Don’t tell me you actually tried looking at the abomination, sigh... that’s why Chopper should have been careful with his words. Why don’t you just return to your house and rest?"
Mark said, sighing loudly.
"No, I am fine, let’s go." Vritra started walking ahead, he was starting to feel slight pain in his head as the line between reality and illusion became thin.
Soon the three entered the town hall that was filled with the light sobs of a woman and painful groans of several men.
Upon walking through the door, they saw Lisa sitting on a bench and crying.
"Lisa... The man that died was like a brother to her, they came to this place together, this must have saddened her quite a lot." Mark said.
They didn’t disturb her and walked straight into one of the rooms.

"I am glad you are still alive. Seriously, last night when I heard those screams I was almost sure that curiosity killed the cat."
Chopper said as he hopped off his chair and walked up to the group.
"He did see the abomination last night, that’s why you should have informed about the consequences clearly." Mark said in a frustrated tone, he really didn’t want more people to die.
"It’s fine, I would have tried looking anyway. So what information are you trying to bring out of these guys, or is it just to take out your frustrations?"
Vritra asked, all of a sudden feeling as if his face had started to burn from inside.
"Haa... These bastards, there were lots of them when they came here, many had died already. We caught this bunch while a few are still hiding somewhere here.
As you know, Bone Blood Cult just loves to create trouble.
We lied to the town folks to maintain the peace, but Hubert, he never drinks. I am sure they are behind it somehow." Chopper said angrily.
"Oh, then they should be hiding in one of the houses, have you checked yet?" Yennefer spoke, standing close to Vritra, observing him closely.
"They just hide outside during the day and maybe use those empty houses at night, or maybe they found some other place in the forest." The short man said helplessly.
"These people have been living for so long here, seriously no one has found anything?" Vritra said doubtfully, his breathing becoming quicker.
"...Hmm." Chopper hesitated slightly before finally speaking: "Yeah, we did find a way to contact the outside world. Just a few days ago I spoke to some people."
’Oh, don’t tell me he is talking about...’ Vritra thought, remembering something.
"Our luck was just bad, from the countless voices I think the other point of communication opened in the Night Forest and near a lot of Howlers.
I asked for help several times but a person cursed me instead of helping me, damn just let me find him." Chopper spoke in determination.
"Ah, haha, that’s too bad. So you haven’t been able to find anything else? And where is the place from where you contacted the outside?"
Vritra’s head was spinning already, his body burning and heart beating wildly.
His entire body started shivering, his senses stopped working as all the people around started to look weird, the voices blended into deafening sounds, and then he fell and became unconscious.

’Hmm, that pattern, it looks a bit familiar.’ Vritra thought and walked towards the crime scene along with the three.
"He was a good friend of mine, sigh...
I- I heard his screams last night, yet all I could do was hide inside my room.
It is so frustrating and frightening, is death our only escape from this place?" Mark continued, even though Vritra was barely paying him any attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: A Caring Wife
paragraphs: "So where is this place that allowed you to contact the outside wor—" while speaking, Vritra suddenly lost consciousness and fell to the floor, surprising the others present in the room.
Yennefer, who had been closely observing Vritra, instantly tried to catch him but her speed was way slower, so she failed to catch him in time.
THUD
He fell, but thankfully his head didn’t hit the ground as Mark cushioned it with his hand just in time.
"Ben!! BEN!!" Yennefer seemed quite shaken as she knelt beside Vritra and tried to wake him up, but when she touched his skin she was shocked to feel how hot his body was.
"H- He is sick, why is his body so hot?" she spoke, this high of a temperature was certainly not normal.
Mark frowned as well. Chopper touched Vritra’s forehead and cheek before checking his pulse: "Oh my god, his heartbeat is so fast, this—this is not normal at all.
Even the people who had seen that abomination before, at most saw hallucinations and they did get sick but not to this extent. What happened exactly?"
"We have to bring him to our house first, do you have any medicines here?" Yennefer hugged Vritra’s body tightly, the fear of losing him piercing into her heart.
"Yeah we do, let me help you first." Mark said, as he and Yennefer soon brought Vritra back home. They laid him on the bed.
"Here, these were the medicines you asked for." Lisa said as she passed several medicinal fluids to Yennefer.
"Thanks." Yennefer said, sitting at the corner of the bed, close to Vritra.
She touched his forehead and his body temperature was so high that it almost felt like her skin might start burning, and his heart was beating so loudly that she could clearly hear it.
"What’s wrong with him all of a sudden?" Lisa questioned. Mark had just told her to bring several medicines, and she looked worriedly at Vritra.
"Can you bring me a spoon and a few bowls?" Yennefer said, before adding: "Ah, and we need to bring his temperature down, so..."
"I will get some cold water, and check if I could get some ice as well." Mark said as he rushed out of the room.
Although generating ice is nearly impossible in the town, the climate there is quite random—it would start snowing then the next day it would be a hot day.
Both Mark and Lisa got to work. Chopper sighed and said: "The people here had suffered from all sorts of illnesses but I have never seen one like this, anything out of the ordinary happened?"

"No, he saw that thing yesterday from the window, he seemed quite exhausted after that. And today, he said... an insect bit his hand, maybe it is because of that." Yennefer answered, as she massaged his head.
"Oh, yeah that might be it. Sigh, let’s see if his condition gets better for now. Tell me if you need anything else." Chopper said before making his way out of the house.
Soon, Lisa brought the utensils. Placing them on the bed she asked: "Do you need my help?"
"No thank you, I will call you if I need anything." Yennefer gave a nod, as she picked up the medicine and spoon, then began to feed him carefully.
In an endless dark space, a white insect’s body kept pulsing and rotating. It was the same insect that had torn Vritra’s flesh the previous day.
Its body kept enlarging at an alarming rate, the spikes on its body becoming larger and larger, becoming hundreds of meters in size within a few seconds.
Upon reaching a certain size, the white insect finally stopped growing.
It stopped rotating as well and fixed its two beady eyes to the front, looking into the darkness as two figures soon appeared.
One was an enormous dragon which was smaller in size than the insect, even less than half its size, but despite the difference it showed no fear and let out a deafening roar.
Some distance away from the dragon was a creature much larger than the dragon but still smaller than the insect.
It was surrounded by purple energy and had a really strong presence.
After a few moments of silence, the two of them shot towards the white insect, releasing all of their energies and shaking the space around.
Instantly, a terrifying battle took place.
Despite being the weakest, the dragon was the most persistent, and no matter how much damage it received it would continue to charge forward, striking the insect relentlessly.
The enormous demon fought with all its might as well, but even with their combined efforts they could barely deal any damage to the spikes.
They couldn’t even reach its body.
The battle continued to go on and on, yet as time passed the condition of the two entities got worse while the insect was almost without any injuries.
When Mark brought some ice and cold water, Yennefer put a wet cloth over Vritra’s forehead.
"Tell me if there is anything else you need, I live in the house next door." Mark said, then he left the two alone.
’Please wake up...’ Yennefer thought in desperation.
She hesitated for a moment then started removing his clothes.
She didn’t feel strange; after all they had already seen each other’s body very closely once before. Then she started to clean his body with a clean cloth.
Vritra was sweating a lot, and the temperature just wouldn’t go down.
She carefully and gently used the cloth to wipe his smooth skin, not letting her mind wander off. After she was done, she kept changing the cold wet cloth over his forehead and fed him some water.
"Vritra, can you hear me? Please get better, I don’t want to lose you. I still don’t know my exact feelings for you, but ever since meeting you again, my emotions haven’t been under my control.
Vritra..." Yennefer whispered in a sad tone as she sat with Vritra’s head resting over her lap.
After a moment she leaned down and pressed her lips against his, feeling his burning lips, then she hugged him tightly.
Hours passed by as Yennefer stayed by his side, taking care of him with every bit of her strength. Mark and Lisa would come to check up on Vritra a few times but there was no change.
"I didn’t expect her to be such a caring wife, based on her earlier attitude, but he sure is lucky to have her." Lisa muttered as she walked out of the house.
The sky had already started to turn dark and now they needed to return to their houses.
"Yeah, she looked quite exhausted herself. I hope nothing happens to Ben." Mark sighed, he could tell that Yennefer would be very sad by his death.
The two went their separate ways as a loud siren rang out, indicating that it was time for everyone to lock their houses properly.
Yennefer was feeding Vritra some soup so that he wouldn’t feel hungry. After the food she cleaned his mouth and fed him medicines.
Then she checked the house and locked the door, before returning to Vritra’s side and lying beside him, hugging him closer, not caring that she might also catch his illness.
"Please get well before the morning, I am missing you even though I am so close to you." Yennefer said.
She didn’t know why, but such words kept coming out of her mouth unlike her usual silent and stone-like attitude.
She cleaned the wet cloth again. Mark had just delivered more ice, so she continued to change it.
The empress continued to take care of him until exhaustion finally caught up to her, and before she knew it, she fell asleep while hugging Vritra even tighter than the night before.
His body heat didn’t bother her one bit.
Early in the morning, Yennefer woke up and, feeling the burning sensation coming from Vritra’s body, she sat up and touched his cheek.
’His condition just keeps getting worse, what should I do? These medicines aren’t working, his temperature isn’t going down.’
Yennefer felt her heart sink. If things continued like this then he really might die.
Seeing the bright sky, Yennefer hastily walked out of the house and went to meet with Mark. Then she asked him for more ice so Vritra could take a cold bath.
Thankfully, no other incident had taken place. Chopper and Duffus were busy trying to find the members of Bone Blood Cult that were still on the run.
Most people were just minding their daily life; they seemed to have accepted the town completely.
After returning, Mark filled the bathtub with ice and water then helped Yennefer bring Vritra to the bathroom.
"Let him soak there for a while and see if his body temperature goes down."
Mark said, before adding: "I am just outside, so I will return when you need my help."
"Okay, thank you." Yennefer nodded, before gently using the cold water to wash Vritra’s neck, shoulder and face. She sat close to him and waited.
Her belly rumbled in hunger but it was like she had lost all other sensations.

Inside the dark space, the battle between the two sides continued to rage on. After a fight that lasted for dozens of hours, the insect finally devoured the other two entities and then it started to mutate.
With a jolt, Vritra opened his eyes as he felt the cold water against his skin. He looked around and found himself in the bathroom.
"Vritra, you are finally awake!!" Yennefer sprang to her feet and shouted in joy as she hugged him, getting wet in the process herself.
"Uh... Who are you?" Vritra questioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Hunger
paragraphs: "Uh... Who are you?" Vritra questioned, while pressing his forehead, feeling the ice-cold water against his skin.
"Huh? You don’t remember me?" Yennefer asked in shock, as she pulled back from the hug.
"Yeah, how rude to barge into the bathroom of a man with three wives. What would the people say if they knew the empress is such a perv?" he replied with a shake of his head.
"Sigh, stop joking around. I really thought you were going to die. How are you feeling now? Do you feel any pain?"
Yennefer questioned, touching his cheek and forehead, and felt relieved that his temperature seemed to be returning to normal.
Vritra looked down at himself and after a moment he replied: "I am perfectly fine. Now can you go out for a moment? I will be out soon."
Yennefer nodded, and after taking one long look at him, she walked out of there and started to prepare food for him. Even though she had never done such things in her life, she was quite efficient.
’Haa, what was all that? It was like I was stuck in that dream that just won’t end, the fight of those creatures...’
Vritra massaged his temples and wondered if it was all just psychological, a drawback of taking a look at that abomination. But he had a feeling that this was different.
As he closed his eyes, he could still remember the image of that insect, which had mutated and transformed into something completely different.
It had taken on the characteristics of the dragon and the demon it was fighting after devouring them.
He even wondered if such a thing actually happened and if his physiques were somehow related to that dream, but there was no way to confirm it currently since he couldn’t even open the status panel.
’Wifey, it would have been good if you were awake.’
Vritra thought, as he finally got out of the chilly water, then wiped his body and dressed into the new clothes that Yennefer must have left there.
Pushing the door open, Vritra walked out of the bathroom and found Mark and Lisa standing there.
"Are you completely fine now? You should just rest," Lisa said in a worried tone.
"I am feeling better than ever," Vritra answered. Though he was still feeling a bit weak, his health and strength were recovering at an extreme speed.
"You must be hungry. I have prepared some food for you," Yennefer came out of the kitchen and called out, her tone seeming rather warmer than usual.
Grrrrrr...
Vritra’s belly let out a faint sound as if it was just waiting for her reminder. More than the weakness, it was the hunger that was bothering Vritra.
"Yeah, I do feel quite hungry," he replied, then looked at the two. "Where is Chopper?"
"He is still interrogating those guys. Those bastards from Bone Blood Cult are just getting out of control," Mark replied, gritting his teeth in frustration.
"Did something else happen?" While walking towards the kitchen, Vritra asked. He sat down at one of the chairs and found several dishes prepared by the empress.
"Yeah, we found something—well, you should eat first. Let’s talk about it later. Come to the town hall if you want to know more."
Mark paused when Lisa lightly hit his arm and gestured at the food, since it wasn’t something a person would want to hear while eating.
"Okay, I will come to the town hall later. And why don’t you join—" Vritra asked, but Mark and Lisa refused politely and made their way out of there, leaving the couple together.
But before leaving, Mark walked closer to Vritra and whispered: "Man, you sure are lucky to have such a caring wife.
Even though I am into men, you make even me feel jealous haha. Be good to her, okay?"
Vritra nodded, a bit surprised that the cold empress could actually do all that. He glanced at her and saw her gaze already fixed on him.
"Mmm, I didn’t know you could cook. The food is delicious," Vritra said, as he started devouring the food hungrily.
"I did learn it from my mother, but it’s been so long since I tried cooking anything." Yennefer sat beside Vritra and watched him eat with an unreadable expression.
There was a brief silence before Yennefer spoke out: "Lisa and Chopper helped me a lot while you were unconscious, and a few other people too.
They provided us with food and clothes even though there is a slight shortage of food."
"Oh—GULP—I will thank them personally later. And is there more?" Vritra asked. Within just a few minutes, he had already almost emptied all the bowls and plates.
"Yeah, there is some extra." Nodding, Yennefer stood up and served him more food. Even though she showed no expression on her face, she seemed quite happy.

Just as Vritra was about to climb onto the cliff, he noticed something. The cries he had just heard were filled with pain and panic.
It didn’t seem that the pack of creatures was looking for food, but that they were running from something so they wouldn’t end up as its food.
In the next instant, several dozens of those creatures jumped down from the cliff, and they ran so fast that they even ignored Vritra, running for their lives.
Inside such an environment, it was impossible to even know whether it was night or day, or to keep track of time.
GRhhkkhhhh
Suddenly, Vritra heard loud wet, gurgling sounds as distorted shrieks and bone-grinding crackling noises came closer.
"!!!" Vritra instantly recognized those sounds. It was the same abomination that he had seen at night not long ago.
KHRAAAAAAAHH
Vritra felt a shiver as he saw a faint towering figure at the top of the cliff. His body reacted instinctively as he turned to his right and ran at full speed.
BOOOM
With an explosive sound, it landed on the ground. Ignoring those creatures, the abomination started following Vritra, running in such a strange manner with its twisted limbs.
’Fuck! Why did I jinx myself? I don’t want any ghost or creature or mad killer!! And doesn’t it only move during the night?’ Vritra felt like slapping himself for what he’d said a few minutes ago.

He could clearly hear the sound of its countless teeth striking one another, the bone-cracking sound of its front legs that were twisted forward, and the screeching sound that made even the trees jerk.
’Right, I need to calm down first.’ Vritra removed the instinctive fear his mind had developed towards that creature because of last time.
"Forbid: Sight, agility, gravity, strength, sound!!" Vritra shouted out loud, running at maximum speed for his dear life.
[Forbidden activated.]
Thankfully, the familiar message of the skill activation popped. Vritra glanced back when he stopped hearing the noises of the creature; all its sounds had gotten really low.
Its speed had decreased to some extent and it had lost more than sixty percent of its sight, while the weakening of the gravity made its movements even more difficult.

Vritra changed direction, and after creating some distance he stopped and turned to have a look at the creature that was madly charging into the trees, breaking all the surrounding trees as if they were made of paper.
All of the eyes on its body were covered by something, so it couldn’t use that mental torture attack again.

sentences.text: BANG
As his fist collided with the thick tree, it simply exploded from the force and flew away, breaking a few more trees along.
"Hmm, it is nowhere near my full strength but well, beggars can’t be choosers." Vritra thought.
He decided not to waste time figuring out how he got that ability.
Taking out a packet of white powder from the book, Vritra chose a direction and shot forward at his current full speed, leaving behind marks over the trees and stones.
His speed was similar to what it was around level 300.
As Vritra headed deeper into the forest, the atmosphere around him started to turn eerier by the moment.
The air was filled with a bloody stench and looked slightly reddish.
The trees had veins on their surfaces that were filled with red blood and seemed to pulse.
Faint distant cries that didn’t sound like any animal continued to ring out.
The ground was covered with knee-length black grass.
’I wonder if all my sin abilities could work against those abominations and other creatures here.
I sure hope they do.’ Vritra thought.
Even while running at full speed, he was observing his surroundings for any sign of danger.
After running for a couple of kilometres, Vritra found himself surrounded by thicker bloody mist.
He could only see a few meters ahead of him.
But thankfully, he could depend on the perfect map of the place that pinpointed even the small rocks.
Wherever he was present on the map was especially highlighted.
First, he planned to check the contact point that Chopper had told him about, which was supposed to be nearly four kilometres deep.
The strange cries of the creatures in the distance seemed like dozens of drilling machines boring into his brain at the same time.
It was so annoying.
Running at full speed, it wasn’t long before Vritra finally arrived at the location of the contact point.
He finally paused and started to look around carefully.
Soon, he located a small dot on the map.
Vritra was wearing leather boots that could protect him against the bites of snakes and other small creatures.
HISSSSSS
Vritra heard the faint sound of a snake.
He stopped and looked around, and soon found the 2-meter-long snake with a black and red pattern on its body.
It appeared quite venomous, though Vritra wasn’t really sure.
He walked closer to the snake but maintained some distance from it.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
In an instant, Vritra teleported the snake into his book.
It was more of an experiment.
He left the snake there to see if it could somehow find a way out.
Once again, he resumed walking towards the dot on the map, and when he arrived at the destination, he was quite shocked.
"..." Vritra stared at the thick pole that seemed to be going high into the sky and disappearing.
He couldn’t see its top point.
Then walking close to it, he saw the old-style phone with the circular dial pad.
For some reason, Chopper or others couldn’t remember what they had found upon arriving here.
They just remembered that Chopper was able to contact the outside world.
Vritra picked up the telephone receiver and tried dialling several random numbers, but it showed no signs of working.
"How can I make it work?" he thought.
Even his intelligent waifu wasn’t here to give him any advice since she had wasted so much of her energy watching him in action.
Sigh...
Placing it back, Vritra decided to check it later.
He had just heard sounds of several growls that seemed to belong to some animal.
Taking out two big knives that normally only a butcher would use, he started walking forward carefully.
Unfortunately, the map wouldn’t show the beings that were alive.
Heading forward, he could barely see anything because of the bloody mist and the blackish trees.
A chilly wind was blowing, creating strange sounds like that of a child crying.
"Haa, looks better than any VR game I played.
Such a horror vibe.
All that is missing is a scary ghost or some deadly beast or maybe a mad killer?" Vritra spoke to himself in a low tone.
He had a feeling that if he couldn’t maintain his sanity, he really might end up getting lost in the forest forever—or until his death.
Grrrrrrrr...
Awwoooooooo
Several sounds rang out as Vritra saw a small cliff in front of him.
It was climbable, but on top of it he saw faint figures of dozens of creatures that resembled wolves but were nearly twice the size.
