chapters.title: Chapter 327: Half the Hands, Double the Trouble
paragraphs: Vritra paused as he observed the abomination that was more than twice as tall as him, it seemed to have gone mad as all the eyes on its body burst out suddenly, with dozens upon dozens of disgusting insects pouring out.
BUZZZZZ
The insects flew in all directions, and finally they located Vritra.
They let out strange buzzing sounds that seemed to calm down the abomination.
The creature adjusted its body in a strange way, twisting it so that the abomination’s height was reduced to nearly 7 feet.
Its skin was torn by its own teeth, then it wriggled and, like worms, the skin began to connect.
It seemed that the creature was changing itself according to the circumstances.
{Sin RipMaw: An experiment that failed to give satisfactory results, and was dumped into the abandoned realm. Cleanse the dumping realm and obtain Sin Coins!!}

Suddenly a message flashed in front of Vritra’s eyes. Just while he was watching the changes in the abomination’s body in bewilderment, the creature had started to look a bit more humane in terms of body structure, though a lot more disgusting.
’What the hell? Such a creature is just a failed experiment? And what is this Sin Coin now?’ Vritra thought, but he was startled when all the insects charged in his direction.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]

Vritra just threw all the insects into the book, then he wondered if he could just do the same with this RipMaw-named creature, but just as he was about to try, the creature’s body flashed and it disappeared.
{Sin Point Gained: Ambushed +1}
The abomination’s speed had increased all of a sudden by several times and even the forbidden skill seemed to have stopped taking effect.
Vritra soon formed a link — these creatures were probably also created by the Divine, things that could adjust to any situation, so there was little chance that his skills could work for long.
WHOOOSH
SCCRRIIIIIRRRRRRR
A deafening sound suddenly echoed just beside Vritra.
He glanced to the side and saw countless eyes of the creature focused on him.
He didn’t even have the time to activate any skill as the abomination opened its mouth to a twisted degree before biting down hard on his left hand.
SCRUNCH
Splish
With the sound of bone crunching and flesh being torn, the abomination’s teeth sank deep into Vritra’s arm as it tore his flesh, ripping his arm away from a little above the elbow.
"Aaaah!!" Unbearable pain shot through his body as blood splattered and poison entered Vritra’s body.
Tiny insects wriggled into his arm through the wound.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Vritra endured the pain as he jumped back and used Intra Shuffle to close the wound and push all the tiny insects out, even stopping the flow of blood to prevent the poison from spreading.
In an instant, the veins in his left arm had turned black. He might have died within a few seconds if he had not stopped the blood flow.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
As the third eye appeared on his forehead, Vritra could finally follow the speed of the abomination, but it was still too fast for him to react in time or flee from.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength + Endurance → Agility]
His best chance at killing the creature, despite the power difference, was Blood Lock, but for that he needed to make it bleed.
’But will the Blood Lock even work on it?’ Vritra wondered, but he had no choice but to try it.
KRIIIIIEEEEEEEEEKKKK
The abomination let out another furious roar as it shot towards Vritra, attacking him from behind. There were sharp teeth all over its body and those creepy eyes.
[SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Activated.]
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
The hybrid skill Intra Shuffle was activated on its own just in the nick of time as his body twisted in a way that the chances of the abomination hitting his vital parts decreased.
HISSSS...
Getting desperate, Vritra threw the long snake at the abomination to create even a tiny disturbance, but the moment the snake came in contact with its body, it was just ground into minced meat.
Then he used SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Vritra had hoped to absorb the RipMaw’s energy, but it was like there was no energy in its body, so he failed.
But he still succeeded in making the abomination stumble with this skill.
Holding the long knife in his left hand, Vritra charged forward at just the right moment, and before the impact he shifted all the points to strength.
CHIIIIIII
Thankfully the knife was able to pierce through the skin of the creature, plunging deep inside it, but...
’Why is there no blood?’ Vritra felt a shiver. Just as he had expected, the Blood Lock was useless as well.
The abomination let out a loud angry screech, but before it could rip Vritra’s body to pieces, the person in front of it disappeared.
’Fuck, killing it is going to be really hard.’ Vritra moved at the fastest speed, creating some distance. He just left the knife buried in its body.
The abomination raised its twisted head towards the sky and let out a strange cry that made Vritra pause in his tracks and clutch his head in agony.
Even his disappearing state began to flutter. The mental attack was affecting him even though he was in a separate dimension.
It was an attack several times more dangerous than the eye one. Vritra began to bleed from his eyes and ears.
’Forbidden: This scream attracts beasts.’
Just when Vritra felt his consciousness slipping away, he used the only chance of his survival.
[Forbidden activated.]
Whrriiiiiiieeeesshhhhhhk!!
While releasing that strange scream, the abomination began to close in on Vritra as he fell back, panting heavily and with darkness consuming his vision.
Just when the creature was ten or so meters away from the helpless Vritra and about to find his exact location...
THUD THUD
Wooooo
Dozens upon dozens of beasts ran towards the scream, charging madly without even caring about the danger.
The RipMaw paused suddenly and saw the beasts, then it tried to search for Vritra but failed.
So, it changed the target and ran towards the beasts, which finally came to their senses and started fleeing.
Vritra rested in his dimensional book, letting out heavy breaths and feeling intense pain in his head.
He took some of the medicines that Chopper had given him before leaving. At least they could reduce the pain slightly.

"Ughhh, well that was quite... intense. How am I even supposed, haa haa, to kill a creature like that?" Vritra muttered in frustration. It was stronger than him in every aspect and had the perfect countermeasures for all his skills.
He cursed again upon looking at his severed left arm. It was quite a shitty feeling, losing a limb.
"Sin System, at least give me some hint damn it, even huff huff with upgraded skill I am no match for that thing. Haa, I miss Mutamorphis so much..." he spoke, sitting in that separate dimension.
He stared into the bloody mist for a while. He didn’t want to just return like that, not without paying back that creature.
Otherwise, there would be no point and they would never be able to leave this realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Payback
paragraphs: "At least the physical defence of that creature isn’t too high. If I can get the chance, I could easily cut its body apart. But how do I create that opportunity?
Even when getting stabbed, the creature didn’t even flinch." He pondered, all sorts of thoughts flashing through his mind.
Right!! Its eyes — those seemed to be the only weakness on its body that could make the creature go mad. If all those eyes pop at the same time, then how would the creature react?
"Okay, so my first target would be its eyes. Sigh, now how do I pop them and what after it?" The more answers Vritra found, the more questions emerged.
After thinking for more than twenty or so minutes, he finally formulated a plan in his mind, but for that he needed to collect several things.
After his condition had become a little better, Vritra came out of the dimensional book and, with his Nether Eye, observed the surrounding area.
’That thing isn’t around. Now let’s prepare for the final showdown.’ He thought and began to search through the surroundings for several things.
He moved at his fastest speed while going through the blinding forest.
After an hour of searching and collecting material, Vritra, who was seated on top of a tree, paused.
’There... is another abomination here.’ A wry smile appeared on his face. He wondered how many of these creatures there were.
While avoiding the danger with his Nether Eye, he continued to efficiently collect the material.
Thankfully, the RipMaw had no way of sensing his Nether Eye.
He even set up various traps but was confused whether the abomination would return to its original form or would still be in that fast and dangerous form.
Pausing the setup in the middle, Vritra searched for that abomination.
Finding them was rather easy because of their loud screeches.
The knife was still embedded in the body of the abomination, and it had reverted back to its giant form. It was a good thing.
Vritra returned to his selected position and continued with his setup. It took him a few hours to finish everything, and finally he was done.
’Now let’s drag that damned thing here and see if I can tear it apart with just one arm.’ Vritra thought as he ran in the direction of the abomination, determined to kill it at any cost.
He moved a little deeper into the forest. In just a short time, he had seen more than four abominations. The idea of getting out of this place seemed more difficult by the second.
After going around the forest, Vritra soon found his target as it was ripping the wolf-like beasts’ bodies to pieces and devouring them.
Vritra pulled a heavy object from the book and aimed it at the head of the creature, where the eyes were located, and then, pouring all his strength, he threw it at the RipMaw, disturbing its meal.
BANNGGG!!
The move was so sudden that the abomination noticed a second too late. The stone smashed into its head, hitting several of its eyes.
URRIIIEEEEEKKKKKK
’Hah, a different type of noise this time. I like this sound.’ Vritra reveled at hearing that painful cry. A couple of its eyes were squished by the stone.
The creature seemed to go mad as it suddenly rose to its feet and let out a thundering scream. Vritra let out a laugh and spoke: "Yo Bug, did you like my return gift?"
The sound of bone cracking and teeth grinding rang out as the creature rushed towards Vritra in rage, planning to devour him directly.
Vritra took a deep breath as he turned and rushed forward at full speed, but even with Shift he was not even half as fast as the creature.
’Forbid: Short legs move faster than the larger.’ Vritra said and made it so that this skill would affect him too.
[Forbidden activated.]
Instantly his speed increased. Although matching the abomination was difficult, it was just perfect for his plan.
The RipMaw was breaking apart all the trees in its way, letting out such a twisted voice that could scare anyone.
It even sent lots of insects flying in Vritra’s direction, but he just stored them away in his dimensional book.
Vritra had learned its attack patterns.
The only problem now was those screams that were very strong mental attacks.
But he just endured the pain in his head and soon arrived at his destination.
Jumping down from the tree, Vritra paused exactly a couple of meters away from a big cross mark he had drawn on the ground.
"Now come here, ugly bug. I have a surprise planned for you." Vritra said as he raised his right hand and held a rope that was hanging down a tree.
KRAAAAAAAARRRRRRR
The deafening roar made Vritra wince in pain, making him feel dizzy. But just as the abomination was about to land on the mark, he pulled down the rope with all his strength.
THUMP
RipMaw landed exactly over the mark as it raised its long front limbs to tear apart Vritra’s body, but the ground under its feet suddenly crumbled as half of its body got buried in the land.
Before the creature could react, a strange liquid with a very foul smell rained down upon its head and body, creating a greenish fog.
Vritra had poured all sorts of things in this liquid — poisons of dozens of snakes, acidic liquid from the plants, poison from herbs and whatnot, turning it into a deadly acidic poison.
URRIIEEEEEEKKKKKK
The same painful scream rang out again, but that was nowhere near the end. As the acidic fluid covered the creature’s eyes, most of them burned and burst.
Suddenly, round creatures with long sharp spikes covering their bodies like sea urchins or hedgehogs, but more deadly, rained from the top as Vritra pulled another rope.

Several of those creatures hit exactly at the head of the abomination, plunging their spikes deep into the eyes and getting locked there. Finally, the RipMaw seemed to have gone mad as it began to thrash all over the place.
It made the ground explode and broke the nearby trees to bits and pieces, letting out painful wails.
Vritra enjoyed the loud music as he pulled yet another rope and charged towards the abomination while entering his disappearing state.
"Forbid: All teeth are soft."
[Forbidden activated.]
The creature stood over its hind legs and raised its hands high, letting out painful screams towards the sky. Just then, a heavy wooden log came crashing down from behind.
The angle was slightly off, but it struck the side of its head, making the large creature stumble forward in pain.

Right at that moment, Vritra jumped at the back of the creature. Normally those sharp long teeth that were present all over the abomination’s body would have torn his body, but now they had turned quite soft.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility + Endurance]
Taking out a knife from the book, Vritra plunged it into the creature’s hind leg, pushing as deep as he could and tearing apart the leg, making the creature fall backwards.
GRRRAAAAAAAHHHH!!
Vritra moved with haste as he jumped over the chest of the abomination.
The body of the RipMaw began to twist. It seemed to be going through another transformation, which would increase the danger exponentially.
"Huff Fuck-"

Vritra returned to his selected position and continued with his setup.
It took him a few hours to finish everything, and finally he was done.
’Now let’s drag that damned thing here and see if I can tear it apart with just one arm.’ Vritra thought as he ran in the direction of the abomination, determined to kill it at any cost.
He moved a little deeper into the forest.
In just a short time, he had seen more than four abominations.
The idea of getting out of this place seemed more difficult by the second.
After going around the forest, Vritra soon found his target as it was ripping the wolf-like beasts’ bodies to pieces and devouring them.
Vritra pulled a heavy object from the book and aimed it at the head of the creature, where the eyes were located, and then, pouring all his strength, he threw it at the RipMaw, disturbing its meal.
BANNGGG!!
The move was so sudden that the abomination noticed a second too late.
The stone smashed into its head, hitting several of its eyes.
URRIIIEEEEEKKKKKK
’Hah, a different type of noise this time.
I like this sound.’ Vritra reveled at hearing that painful cry.
A couple of its eyes were squished by the stone.
The creature seemed to go mad as it suddenly rose to its feet and let out a thundering scream.
Vritra let out a laugh and spoke: "Yo Bug, did you like my return gift?"
The sound of bone cracking and teeth grinding rang out as the creature rushed towards Vritra in rage, planning to devour him directly.
Vritra took a deep breath as he turned and rushed forward at full speed, but even with Shift he was not even half as fast as the creature.
’Forbid: Short legs move faster than the larger.’ Vritra said and made it so that this skill would affect him too.
[Forbidden activated.]
Instantly his speed increased.
Although matching the abomination was difficult, it was just perfect for his plan.
The RipMaw was breaking apart all the trees in its way, letting out such a twisted voice that could scare anyone.
It even sent lots of insects flying in Vritra’s direction, but he just stored them away in his dimensional book.
Vritra had learned its attack patterns.
The only problem now was those screams that were very strong mental attacks.
But he just endured the pain in his head and soon arrived at his destination.
Jumping down from the tree, Vritra paused exactly a couple of meters away from a big cross mark he had drawn on the ground.
"Now come here, ugly bug.
I have a surprise planned for you." Vritra said as he raised his right hand and held a rope that was hanging down a tree.
KRAAAAAAAARRRRRRR
The deafening roar made Vritra wince in pain, making him feel dizzy.
But just as the abomination was about to land on the mark, he pulled down the rope with all his strength.
THUMP
RipMaw landed exactly over the mark as it raised its long front limbs to tear apart Vritra’s body, but the ground under its feet suddenly crumbled as half of its body got buried in the land.
Before the creature could react, a strange liquid with a very foul smell rained down upon its head and body, creating a greenish fog.
Vritra had poured all sorts of things in this liquid — poisons of dozens of snakes, acidic liquid from the plants, poison from herbs and whatnot, turning it into a deadly acidic poison.
URRIIEEEEEEKKKKKK
The same painful scream rang out again, but that was nowhere near the end.
As the acidic fluid covered the creature’s eyes, most of them burned and burst.
Suddenly, round creatures with long sharp spikes covering their bodies like sea urchins or hedgehogs, but more deadly, rained from the top as Vritra pulled another rope.
Several of those creatures hit exactly at the head of the abomination, plunging their spikes deep into the eyes and getting locked there.
Finally, the RipMaw seemed to have gone mad as it began to thrash all over the place.
It made the ground explode and broke the nearby trees to bits and pieces, letting out painful wails.
Vritra enjoyed the loud music as he pulled yet another rope and charged towards the abomination while entering his disappearing state.
"Forbid: All teeth are soft."
[Forbidden activated.]
The creature stood over its hind legs and raised its hands high, letting out painful screams towards the sky.
Just then, a heavy wooden log came crashing down from behind.
The angle was slightly off, but it struck the side of its head, making the large creature stumble forward in pain.
Right at that moment, Vritra jumped at the back of the creature.
Normally those sharp long teeth that were present all over the abomination’s body would have torn his body, but now they had turned quite soft.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility + Endurance]
Taking out a knife from the book, Vritra plunged it into the creature’s hind leg, pushing as deep as he could and tearing apart the leg, making the creature fall backwards.
GRRRAAAAAAAHHHH!!
Vritra moved with haste as he jumped over the chest of the abomination.
The body of the RipMaw began to twist.
It seemed to be going through another transformation, which would increase the danger exponentially.
"Huff Fuck-"

chapters.title: Chapter 329: The Divine Evolution
paragraphs: GRRRAAAAAAAHHHH!!
The abomination let out a screech as its body began to twist and transform, its skin ripping and limbs bending unnaturally, its body once again adapting to the current danger.
[Intra Shuffle activated.]
Vritra’s left hand grew again though it was temporary and would disappear if he deactivated the skill.
Just as the big butcher-like knife was about to come loose with its skin wriggling and ripping, Vritra gripped it and pushed it deeper.
Using every bit of his strength he plunged his fingers into the small hole that was created and let out a thundering shout, while ripping the thick skin of the creature.
The abomination continued to transform, it started to break out of the writ that Vritra had set and slowly its teeth began to return to their dangerous form.
The sharp teeth plunged into his feet and hands, cutting into his flesh, but Vritra endured.
While stopping the poison in its tracks, he pushed his fingers deeper into the flesh—or whatever that disgusting wriggling thing could be called—and kept pulling it apart.
"Damn, just rip already..." Vritra cursed, this thing was too thick-skinned and inside the skin all he saw so far was flesh, no organs or anything.
The rush of adrenaline made Vritra push his limits, ignoring the pain, his heart beating extremely fast.
KRIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIRRRRRR
The abomination began to stand, its body already returning to better than its peak state. Vritra knew he would be in really serious trouble if he couldn’t do anything.
"Fuck!" Cursing again, he gave up on defence and changed the forbidden writ.
"Forbid: the life source is luminescent!!"
Instantly the teeth of the creature returned to their original state and buried deep into Vritra’s hands and legs. Intense pain shot through his body, and poison again entered his bloodstream.
But his idea worked as a strong light shot out of the abomination’s body, it was present near the throat area, half a meter above the place where Vritra had ripped its body.
Throwing caution to the fire, he pushed his left hand into the RipMaw’s body and aimed for the glowing object.
The abomination had almost transformed, it brought both of its now shorter hands towards Vritra in a dangerous manner, about to crush his skull.
Vritra felt a slimy sensation against his fingers. Without a thought, he gripped the head-sized object and pulled it out despite the strong resistance.
UUAAAAAAAAAARRRRRR!!
The abomination’s body arched backward as if suffering immense pain. Along with the deafening scream, the sound of something like nerves breaking also rang out.
A fountain of black liquid shot out of the abomination’s chest as soon as Vritra pulled out the glowing organ, and he jumped away from its body, the sharp teeth finally coming out of his flesh.
"Huff... Ughh... It hurts so b-bad... haa haa..."
Vritra muttered under his breath as he moved away from the RipMaw, and only stopped when there was some distance between the two.
Then with his nether eye he observed the creature, the entire body of the abomination was shivering violently.
KIIIIEEEEEEEKKKKKK
While spasming, it fell back and its body began to break apart. Within a couple of minutes, it had broken into countless tiny bugs that writhed in pain and rolled all over the ground before dying.
Vritra maintained the distance and just observed the scene for a while, and only after he was sure that the RipMaw was finally dead did he let his body relax.
He fell back and panted heavily.
"Haa... T-That was a bit tough, but I won!!"
He pulled out a couple of potions and gulped them down. Unfortunately, there were no healing potions here that could help him.
Even the poison-toxifying potions were weak and could barely do anything against such dangerous poison.
Vritra removed the tiny insects that had entered his body along with the poison but were stopped by him.
After a short rest, he looked down at the head-sized thing which had already stopped glowing.
"This was the root... haa haa... of it a-all... huff..."
Just then a message popped in Vritra’s mind from the sin system.
{You have cleansed one RipMaw!!}
{You have obtained one Sin Coin!!}

{Sin Coin: The Divine’s creation of life, it is powerful enough to create new sorts of life forms. Each sin coin could result in utter destruction if used in the wrong manner and can result in countless new inventions.}
{1 Sin Coin → 1 Level.}
{Would you like to devour the Sin Coin and start the evolution of your Divine Physique and Bloodline?}
"I knew it, that fight wasn’t a dream after all, so some sort of changes did happen to my physique and bloodline.
But I am sure the two original physiques are still there." Vritra pondered, then focused his attention on the new messages.
What was there to think about, everything related to the sin system and divine was better than everything else.
But he wondered what it meant by the word ’Devour’. Looking at the heart-like thing he thought maybe he would have to eat it...
"Yes!!" he answered. It’s not like he hadn’t eaten anything strange before, so even though it didn’t look edible he could still do it.
{Devouring the Sin Coin!!}
{The Evolution of Divine Physique and Bloodline has begun.}
Instantly the heart transformed into viscous liquid, that clung to his skin and then entered through the pores, spreading throughout his body.
Some sort of changes started taking effect within his body, giving him a relaxing feeling.
The process continued for around ten minutes and then more messages flashed before him.
{Sin Coin → 1/2500}
{You have levelled up!!}
Vritra: "..."
"Ha! I need how many more of these coins? 2499?!! How am I supposed to kill so many of those abominations?"
Vritra touched his head, but he could feel that after absorbing that heart his overall strength had grown quite a bit.
He didn’t even know where he would be able to find so many of those creatures, but he was just happy with such a sweet victory.
Vritra’s healing ability had improved, so his wounds began to heal slowly, but it was nowhere enough to regrow an entire arm.
"I guess I will have to do with this for now, but I also need to find a way out of here."
After the rest he finally stood up and calculated the time he had spent in this forest.
It was impossible to know about it from the sky, but from the time he had left the town he should have spent around six or so hours.
"Let’s go a bit deeper, that first location isn’t far from here."
After making up his mind, Vritra began to run, though his speed was slower because of the injuries.
Keeping the nether eye and Intra Shuffle active at every moment, he made sure to avoid the danger and after running for more than thirty minutes he finally appeared close to that place.
The mist made it difficult to see exactly what was in front.
But as Vritra got close to the location, he raised his head and stared in bewilderment at the gigantic temple, nearly two hundred meters high and spread over a few kilometres.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: The Divine Temple
paragraphs: A large temple covered by the bloody mist stood in the middle of nowhere, completely filled with silence and a majestic presence.
"That’s the same symbol as I saw before." Vritra mumbled; it seemed to be the symbol of some god.
Vritra tried to scan the insides of the temple, but even his nether eye failed to work there. After entering the disappearing state, he decided to check it.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]

’Hoo, let’s do this. I have to go out as soon as possible. The demon war might have already started outside, and mom, Fiona, and Diana would have no choice but to participate just to keep themselves safe.’
Vritra thought, his resolve strengthening.
He slowly began to walk towards the old temple.
It was probably white originally, but because of the bloody mist, the entire temple was now painted red.
The place was too quiet. Vritra climbed over fifty stairs and finally arrived at the entrance of the temple.
The doors were already open; even though it had gotten dirty, not even a single scratch could be seen on the walls. It stood tall.
Observing his surroundings closely, Vritra finally entered the temple.
There were strange patterns on the walls, but Vritra couldn’t decipher them, so he continued to move slowly.
Strangely, the insides of the temple weren’t dark; it was like the walls had light of their own.
After walking through a long corridor, Vritra arrived at the entrance of a large hall. He observed it from the top, as it was around 5 meters down.
The seats that were originally supposed to be present there were either broken or thrown to the side.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Got Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Got Bewildered +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +1}
Several messages popped at once as Vritra froze at the sight in front of him.
A large statue of the same insect that had entered his arm a couple of days ago was present at the forefront of the hall. It was enormous and extremely detailed.
The statue was glowing with a strong white light and had a terrifying presence.
A few strange characters were written near its feet that Vritra could recognize even without the Language Mastery.
’The Divine!!’ A feeling of reverence rose from within him, but that wasn’t exactly what had surprised Vritra.
In front of the statue, hundreds upon hundreds of abominations were lined up as if prostrating themselves in front of their god.
There were so many of these terrifying creatures. At the front of the thousands of RipMaws, there were three red creatures that were twice the size and looked even more horrifying.
’Ah, so this is where I was supposed to get the Sin Coins...’ Vritra, even in his disappearing state, didn’t dare make a single noise.
If they all attacked him at once, then he would be killed in moments without the chance to fight back.
But then he wondered if they would move upon hearing any sound; they seemed to be deep in slumber.
"..." Just to check, Vritra pulled a large stone—changing the stone, he took out a pebble, and aimed at one of the abominations present at the end of the ground.
There were definitely more than 2500 abominations, but Vritra didn’t know how he was supposed to kill them.
Just killing a single one almost killed him; he lost his arm and received such severe injuries.
TUK!
Gathering his courage, Vritra finally threw the pebble towards the back of the abomination.
As it hit, the creature opened its dozens of creepy eyes and turned to look around, but after a moment it returned to its original state.
’Haa.’ Vritra finally relaxed, releasing the breath he was holding unconsciously. Thankfully all the abominations didn’t wake up.
’Wait, I can use this scenario. Though it would take more time at the start, when my strength grows I will be able to kill them easily.’
He thought, but for now he decided to leave the dangerous place.
Turning around, he walked out of there slowly. He had enough adventure for the day. He was completely exhausted and just wanted to return home.
Walking out of the temple, Vritra started running towards the town. He would continue the abomination hunt from the next day.
When he had arrived near the forest, Vritra paused and scanned the surroundings and soon located a group of beasts.
Taking out the big knife from the dimensional book, he decided to hunt a little and bring some meat.
’Sigh, I just noticed it, but I no longer feel hungry. So I need to devour that Sin Coin for my hunger... I just hope this isn’t a permanent thing.’ Vritra thought.
Hunting the beasts was even easier now with the increase in his strength.
Vritra killed over five beasts efficiently and tied them with rope before throwing them all into the dimensional book and once again started moving.
He also changed his clothes. He wouldn’t want to go back in those blood-drenched clothes and washed himself slightly.
It was nearly four when Vritra arrived close to the town. Everything seemed as usual; the townsfolk were all busy with their daily lives.
Vritra was surprised when he entered the town and got close to his house.
Yennefer was sitting in a small group of middle-aged women and was chatting with them normally.
"Yenni..." he called out and paused, putting down the beasts’ corpses and the material he had carried.
"!!!" Yennefer’s ears perked up as she turned, and her sparkling eyes met with Vritra’s. She scanned him from top to bottom.
His clothes were slightly dirty, but there was no blood, and only slight injuries were visible.
"You are back!!" Yennefer exclaimed as she rose to her feet in a hurry, but before she could take a step forward one of the women coughed, giving some sort of signal.
Yennefer looked back, then at Vritra, before speaking: "...Welcome back, husband, I was waiting for you."
Those women seemed to have been tutoring Yennefer about becoming a good wife. After hearing her, they nodded in satisfaction.
"Oh, thanks... I guess." Vritra said, finding the empress quite cute compared to her cruel nature.
She smiled before walking up to him and embracing Vritra tightly, letting out a long breath as her body finally relaxed.
"You didn’t get hurt, right?" she whispered, clinging to him possessively.
"Just a little, but it’s nothing serious." Vritra replied, hugging her back. It felt quite nice to be welcomed like this by this dangerous yet cute woman.
"You killed quite a few beasts. Let’s go back and have a bath together. I need to thoroughly inspect your body.
And if I find you were lying, then I will punish you even more severely than yesterday." Yennefer said in a sultry tone as she bit his earlobe.
"Haha, yeah, let’s go. I certainly do need a bath." Vritra chuckled, as he picked up the material with one hand and Yennefer hugged his other arm.
The two started walking towards their house.
The group of women showed thumbs up towards Yennefer; they were sure she was going to be a good wife.
Upon entering the house, Yennefer pushed all the things aside and pulled Vritra directly into the bathroom.
Then she threw their clothes away, getting into the shower together.

"Right after entering the town, they started to cause chaos.
They attacked and almost killed several people, we killed around eleven of them and captured four, while five managed to run away.
I wish they get devoured by those monsters." Mark replied, a cold expression on his face.
"I am not sure, but this time they certainly had a mission in coming to this place, but I don’t think torturing them would give us any result." He added.
’A mission huh.’ Vritra thought, and it wasn’t hard for him to guess what missions they could have other than unlocking secrets of this place.
’Maybe they just sent those people to confirm the empress is dead, but that’s a dumb decision unless they have found some way to send their messages to the outside world...’
The more Vritra pondered about it, the clearer it all became to him.
Those five men must have already grouped with the other members of the Bone Blood Cult.
So, Blunder and others knew some things about the abandoned town, and they wished to kill the empress while she was at her weakest using these men.
"Are those people kept in the town hall?" Vritra asked.
He wanted to confirm a few things with the brave men who had come to kill the empress.
"Yes, they are inside and Chopper and Duffus are questioning them." Mark answered.
Vritra nodded and headed straight into the town hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: The Short Interrogation!!
paragraphs: "...You want to interrogate them? In private?" Chopper asked in surprise at Vritra’s sudden request.
"Yeah, just let me interrogate two of them. Even if they die, you would still have two others left," Vritra said, pointing to the four newly captured men from the Bone Blood Cult.
"Uh, you interrogating them and even torturing is fine with me, but can’t you do it in front of us?"
Chopper asked, while Duffus, the giant man, scratched his head, wondering what was going on.
"No." Vritra just refused and didn’t give any explanation.
Chopper stared at him for a whole minute, then he sighed helplessly and shrugged.
"Fine, do as you wish, just try to leave them alive."
"Alright, I will do my best to not kill them, but no promises," Vritra said, a faint smile on his face.
"Sigh... Duffus, come with me."
Soon, Chopper and Duffus made their way out of the room, leaving Vritra along with five Bone Blood Cult bastards.
"Now, shall we get started?" Vritra spoke as he snapped his fingers and checked the torturing tools in the room.
"Ha! You are not going to get anything out of us, no matter what you try. And soon everyone in the town is going to die, hahaha..."
"Huh, isn’t it that bastard the boss told us to kill?" one of the men spoke out loud.
"Oh right, he is Vritra. Blunder especially told us to make sure he is dead and in the most painful ways, kekeke— we found him so easily, so the emp—"
The other man suddenly paused while speaking.
Vritra listened to them without saying anything as he chose a weapon while humming a song to himself.
Picking up a hammer with two sharp and pointed hooks on its back, Vritra approached one of the men.
"Hahaha, look, Mr. Scary is here to bring questions out of us. We have been tortured several times more in our cult than what you people could ever do—" a horse‐faced man spoke.
Without saying a word, Vritra swung the hammer lazily.
The hooks connected with the side of the horse‐faced man, cracking his skull and ripping his skin, as Vritra sliced and scooped out the upper part of both his eyeballs.
Instantly, loud and painful screams filled the room; all the others shivered at this brutality.
Duffus’ torture was child’s play compared to Vritra’s; he didn’t even ask anything and began to strip their skin mercilessly.
Jerking the skin and eyeballs off the hammer, Vritra nodded in satisfaction and then picked a peeler.
Again, without any question, he pulled the arm of the horse‐faced man and began to mercilessly pull his skin.
"Ughh— Aaaggghhhhhh— S-Stop— Uwaaaaaaaah!" Just the screams made the other men shiver; it was such a bloody scene.
Vritra continued to hum the song while continuing to peel at the same place as even his flesh began to come off.
Outside, all the people fell silent as they felt their hearts tremble upon hearing those inhumane screams.
They gulped and thanked God that they didn’t have to go through such a thing.
"Will it be okay?" Lisa asked, worried that the other Bone Blood Cult members might try to take revenge for this.
"Yeah, it should be... probably." Chopper shrugged.
As minutes ticked by, the screams only became louder and more broken.
Vritra didn’t leave a single torture tool unused in the room; he even crushed the crotch of the horse‐faced man with the heavy, ball‐crushing metal ball.
Just after ten minutes, one of the four men couldn’t take it and spoke out loud:
"J-Just ask whatever you want. Why aren’t you e-even asking anything?"
Vritra ignored their pleas as he picked the bowl of burning hot fluid and poured it on the horse‐faced man’s body.
Then, with a big scissor, he cut off each of his fingers before chopping flesh off his arm slowly.
The entire torture only lasted nearly twenty minutes, and finally the screams died down.
The people outside were sweating heavily, their hearts thumping as if they could almost feel the pain themselves.
Finally, the door opened and Vritra walked out, covered in blood. Wiping his hands with a cloth, he looked at all the people.
There was a small smile on his face; traces of blood were present on his clothes and cheek, and his handsome face suddenly looked so terrifying.
"O-Oh, are you done already? It seems you have quite the experience in torturing people," Chopper said, wiping his forehead.

"Not really, I was just trying all the tools you have kept inside. Anyway, those guys were quite tough; they wouldn’t open their mouths no matter what I did, so I gave up in the end," Vritra said, releasing a sigh before adding:
"But I found out that they could contact the outside world rather easily. Haa, I am feeling a bit hungry, so I will be returning home."
Then he turned and started walking towards his home; there was no change in his behavior.
After he left, all the people walked into the town hall and then into the torturing room.
The moment they entered, their bellies churned with disgust, and all of them felt goosebumps.
Only one person was dead; there was blood all over the ground, side walls, and even the ceiling.
Pieces of bones, flesh, and organs were scattered around. The horse‐faced man’s corpse was in such a bad condition that more than half of the people vomited.
"Ughh, h-how could he even think of eating after doing something like this? I can’t eat anything for a few days now..."
One of the boys muttered. Suddenly, Vritra seemed quite frightening, like a psycho; thankfully he was not an enemy.
Vritra arrived at home. Yennifer had already prepared food for them and was waiting for him.
As soon as Vritra entered, she came to the front door to welcome him but paused, seeing the blood.
"A-Are you alright? Did you get hurt?"
She hastily got close, her heart thumping faster, and an uncomfortable feeling spread in her chest.
"No, I am fine. This isn’t my blood; I was just interrogating a member of the Bone Blood Cult," Vritra said, walking into the house.
"Oh! You mean the ones they captured earlier? Did you find anything?" she asked, getting close and wiping the blood from his cheek.

"Yeah, they had found some way to easily contact their organization, and also something that allows them to walk around at night for a little time; that’s why they weren’t attacked by the abominations when they broke the windows," Vritra explained.
Then he continued, "And as you might already be thinking, they especially came here to kill you. Though they probably don’t know where exactly you are, or if you are still alive."
Yennifer nodded; after all, it was a good idea for her to still cover her face and identity.
If Vritra hadn’t suggested it, then with her attitude she would never hide her identity.
"Uh, but I am sure it won’t be hard for them to locate me if they just kidnap someone in the town and ask them about the newcomers in the town," Yennifer added.
Now, day and night were equally dangerous for her.
And she wasn’t arrogant enough to think that even without her strength she could defeat them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Red Ripmaw
paragraphs: "So far, the war against the demons has not started, but it might start in a few days. Those guys didn’t know anything more than that," Vritra said, as the two went directly into the bathroom.
"Haa, so they could attack as soon as they found out about me, and we can’t really do anything to them," Yennifer sighed, as the two removed their clothes.
Vritra thought for a moment, then he summoned the book of dimensions, though the Empress couldn’t see it.
He tore a page and then handed it to her, saying:
"If I am not here and you are in danger, then just tear this page and throw it at whatever or whoever is attacking you and run away from there as fast as you can."
Yennifer was surprised, wondering where he pulled out that page from or what this page could do, but without any questions, she accepted it and placed it near her clothes safely.
Soon the two started their bath while having a serious talk.
{You have cleansed one RipMaw!!}
{You have devoured one Sin Coin!!}
{You have levelled up!!}
{Evolution in process...}
Vritra panted lightly as he just finished absorbing another Sin Coin.
As his level grew, his speed at slaughtering the abominations had increased rapidly.
But when he had killed around two hundred or so abominations, it felt like he had hit a bottleneck, and even if he killed more abominations, his level wasn’t increasing.
This confirmed one of Vritra’s doubts: the levels he was gaining were the same as outside this realm.
So, after killing around two hundred abominations, he had reached the peak of the 2nd Legion rank.
At first, he was worried and confused; how was he supposed to get a Legion stone in a place like this, not to mention an empty stone? But the sin system showed him the way.
{Kill the Red RipMaw to level up.}
Around ten days had passed after the interrogation; thankfully, those men hadn’t made any move yet.
"That thing looks several times stronger than the normal abomination. How should I kill it...?" Vritra wondered. He had just killed two more abominations and now his target was the red one.
He couldn’t delay killing the red abomination, or his pace of killing the RipMaws wouldn’t increase, and it would take too long.
He wanted to return to the White Kingdom as soon as possible.
After killing so many of those creatures, his strength had undoubtedly increased by a lot.
He could even kill the abominations in a one-on-one fight without any traps and barely any injuries.
He knew that he would have to use traps and the surroundings to somehow kill it, but if the power difference was too much, such things wouldn’t work.
He designed new and deadlier traps, and then made his way into the temple.
In the disappearing state, he moved close to the statue of the large insect.
Right in front of the statue, the three red RipMaws were present.
’Should I try attacking one here? I will know whether my attack will work against it or not. If things go bad, I will just have to escape.’
Vritra thought, and these things don’t go into the town during the day, so he just needed to reach there.
Taking out the large knife, Vritra silently approached it.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility + Endurance → Strength.]
’Forbid: The knife becomes sharper when held upside down.’
[Forbidden Activated.]
Vritra turned the knife upside down and upon reaching close to the red abomination, he locked his eyes exactly at the place where the heart was present.
He had already seen the locations of the three’s hearts.
’Here goes nothing.’ Vritra thought and then he gathered all his strength and stabbed directly towards its heart.
CLANG
It was like the knife had hit against metal; sparks flew around and the first strike was utterly fruitless, but it did result in stirring the giant creature out of its sleep.
Vritra gritted his teeth and made his move in haste.
’Forbid: Everything that is red is inexplicably soft.’
[Forbidden activated.]
Before the red abomination could make sense of the situation, he struck again, stabbing with even more force.
This time, the knife did go a little deeper into its skin and got stuck, but as he tried to push the knife deeper, it was moving way too slowly.
URRRRRAAAARRRRR!!
The red creature finally woke up and let out a deafening roar, an oppressive feeling making all the other abominations shiver as they woke up and looked around.
’Haha, fuck...’ Vritra wasted no time as he disappeared and fled toward the exit at full speed, even using Shift and Forbidden to increase his speed to the max.
THUMP THUMP
The red RipMaw charged towards Vritra at an even faster speed, but thankfully, the other creatures soon returned to continue with their prayers.
’Why is it so fast and it saw through the disappearing state within moments? This creature is too dangerous.’
Vritra gritted his teeth as he absorbed all the insects that the abomination shot at him into the book.
He had put the trap very close to the temple this time; he had expected such a situation.
Just as the red abomination arrived on the cross mark, the ground broke under its feet and waves of acidic poison rained down on its head.
In the next instant, dozens upon dozens of spiky creatures hit its head and body.
Then several wooden logs struck its head, plunging the creatures deeper into its eyes.
KRRRRRRRIIIIIII!!
Letting out a slightly painful scream, the large creature didn’t seem as bothered by all this as Vritra had hoped. In an instant, the creature jumped towards Vritra.
Jumping back, Vritra activated all the traps he had prepared as all the things were launched at the red abomination which had been momentarily blinded.
And right at that time, he activated the forbidden skill, limiting the creature’s abilities.
Even so, the creature continued to charge at him, waving around its terrifying arms like large blades.
Vritra dodged them as he jumped forward and kicked again and again at the knife stuck in its chest.
And so the fight between the two beings began. It was several times more dangerous and deadlier than Vritra’s fight against the first abomination.
With each of the red creature’s moves, he barely dodged death. Within a few minutes, countless wounds had appeared on his body.
Vritra just had one target; he pushed the knife deeper and deeper into the creature’s body.
But things took a turn for the worse when the red creature underwent a transformation into something far more terrifying.
Within moments, Vritra had to sacrifice his fake left hand just to barely save himself from getting sliced into two.
Running away was not an option; it was do or die. Vritra felt his blood pumping and heart thumping wildly, his veins bulging as he pushed his body to the limit.
Battling the deadly creature several times bigger than him. The red abomination was better than him in everything—strength, agility, endurance.
Despite that, it couldn’t kill Vritra.
No matter how many attacks landed on Vritra’s body, he just won’t die.
BANG BANG BANG
The sound of Vritra kicking the knife again and again kept ringing far and wide as the battle continued to rage on for hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: The Dangerous Showdown
paragraphs: GRRAAAAARRRRRR!!
Land over dozens of meters was destroyed as the red abomination swung its long tail, leaving a deep cut on his chest.
Vritra barely managed to dodge the attack. After using the forbidden on it a few times, the skills stopped having any effect on the creature.
HUFF HUFF
On one hand, the strength of the creature was increasing with its transformation while Vritra was getting slower and weaker; even his skills were becoming useless against the monster.
Predicting the creature’s moves and moving his body to the limits, Vritra was just keeping himself alive; kicking at the knife at every chance he got.
Unless someone hurt the eyes of these RipMaws, these creatures don’t really care about their defense; otherwise, Vritra wouldn’t even have the slightest chance of defeating it.
But they were unsuccessful products after all.
SPLASH
More blood spluttered on the ground as Vritra coughed but didn’t let it hinder his movements.
He jumped high and twisted his body in the air before punching the knife with all his strength and then jumping away.
Vritra kept moving the stats rapidly between his three stats based on the situation.
His clothes and body were completely drenched in his blood. It’s already been four hours since the fight started, but even with his strength increased, Vritra was truly reaching his limits.
’Forbid: The ground under red abomination is sticky.’ Vritra ordered, observing the creature with his Nether eye and predicting its move through the movements of the abomination’s muscles.
[Forbidden Activated.]
All of a sudden, the abomination’s balance broke as the ground under its feet suddenly became very sticky.
Vritra made use of this chance as he pounced forward.
Adrenaline was rushing through his veins, making the exhaustion and pain effect-less.
BANG
Vritra once again kicked the big knife, pushing it slightly deeper into the creature’s body, but before he could create some distance, the abomination slashed at his right leg.
The cut was deep, but thankfully Vritra was able to move before his leg could be cut off completely.
He was barely keeping himself together, while using the intra shuffle to not die from blood loss.
"Hubby, how you doinggggg—What the fuck?!!"
Yasmine had just woken up after a two-day sleep, and she was simply shocked to see the scene in front of her.
Vritra was fighting such a dangerous creature, and the condition of his body was really, really bad right now.
The fact that he was still able to move was already a miracle.
’Well hello, as you can see—’ Vritra moved back to create some distance, then he entered his disappearing state, getting inside the dimensional book.
But by now, even the dimensional book was of no help.
The creature could easily locate him and forcefully pull him out of there.
It was the creation of the Divine after all, so it wasn’t a surprise that it could break all beliefs and rules.
After creating some distance, he added:
’As you can see, I am competing with this red thing to see which one of us dies first.’
"Sigh, why did you get in a fight with such a creature? Damnit, you got so many injuries... this ugly bastard, I am going to kill it."
Yasmine was so angry that she almost charged at the red RipMaw, but Vritra held her back.
’Wait, you know you can’t get out in this place, just let me handle this. I am not tired at all, I can keep going for days...’ Vritra muttered.
The red abomination didn’t even give him the time to breathe as it charged towards him and ripped apart the page of the dimensional book, forcing him to move away.
Another deep wound was inflicted over his shoulder as once again Vritra almost touched death.
The long fight had made the abomination even angrier.
"Ughh, this damned place, do you have any plans? O- Oh no, this fucking lizard!!"
Yasmine felt her blood boil, though she didn’t possess any blood, seeing the countless wounds on his body.
Her heart was aching so much that she really felt like crying and tearing everything apart.
’...Yeah, to push that knife deep enough, then I can absorb and take its heart.’ Vritra spat the blood in his mouth. He was holding two daggers that were in quite bad condition now.
KRRRRRAAAAAAARRRRR!!
The red abomination’s entire body was covered by sharp pointy teeth. Just a slight graze against them would result in serious damage, and it had transformed its entire body into a deadly weapon.
’...’ Yasmine felt frustrated as she watched Vritra fight against it.
A few minutes passed and his condition kept getting worse.
The defenses of the creature were just too damn high; despite hitting the knife so many times, it was still not close enough to the heart.
"Hoo, let me give you a boost. When you hit the knife the next time, I will create an energy blast. It will definitely be strong enough to do the job," she said with determination.

Vritra felt a burning sensation in his throat, his breathing coming out labored and his stamina almost depleted. Every part of his body, every muscle aching so badly, but the adrenaline kept his body moving.
’But will you be fine?’ he asked, blocking the teeth with the knives as his body was thrown back, and finally one of the knives broke.
"Yeah, I will be fine. Just need to sleep for a few more days to restore my energy. Hubby, we have no time to waste.
At this rate, both of us are going to die anyway!!" Yasmine raged, glaring at the abomination with hatred.
’...Fine, I will get close to it.’ Vritra agreed, left with no other choice. His chances of defeating it were close to zero; before long, he wouldn’t even be able to walk.
CLANG CLANG
Vritra pulled another knife from the book and used it to block the attack. He would just do his best at keeping himself alive while slowly moving towards the knife.
Nearly ten minutes passed when Vritra finally got a chance to strike the knife.
With the third eye, he saw one of the hands of the creature coming towards his back. But taking the risk, Vritra swung his leg at the back of the knife with all his strength.
’Hubby, let’s do it!!’ Yasmine was ready, wanting to kill this creature very, very badly.
KRRIIIIIIEEEEEEE!!
The creature let out a twisted sound. Its hand arrived close to Vritra’s back, and the long teeth plunged into his flesh, piercing through the side of his waist.
Vritra gritted his teeth, and finally, his feet made contact with the blade—
BOOOOOOOM!!
A powerful wave of force swept over the two.
The knife pierced directly through the heart of the large creature and threw its body back, as it began to release painful wails and wriggled on the ground.
Although Vritra didn’t face the brunt of the attack, the force also struck his body, throwing him even farther away, almost breaking all his remaining limbs.
Vritra’s mind drifted in and out of consciousness, waves after waves of pain flooding through his body.
Only after smashing into a few trees did his body finally come to a stop.
The two beings lay far away from one another, both in a very bad state.

Vritra barely managed to dodge the attack.
After using the forbidden on it a few times, the skills stopped having any effect on the creature.
HUFF HUFF
On one hand, the strength of the creature was increasing with its transformation while Vritra was getting slower and weaker; even his skills were becoming useless against the monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: KNOCK KNOCK
paragraphs: The sound of an explosion rang in the forest. The bodies of both fighters were thrown back, striking several trees before finally coming to a stop.
The knife had plunged deeply into the heart of the red RipMaw as it began to release painful wails, thrashing around on the ground before finally going limp.
Yet this was not enough to kill it.
The body of the abomination began to change slowly, the knife was being pushed away, and soon it would be back to its peak.
On the other hand, Vritra was barely conscious, all his accumulated injuries taking their toll on his body.
Most serious injuries were on his abdomen, chest, and back, though his arms and legs were also badly hurt with several deep cuts.
Each breath made his throat burn, excruciating pain shooting through his chest as the adrenaline rush finally ended.
Staring up at the misty sky, Vritra coughed blood, unable to gather any strength in his body.
’I’m... so tired.’ Vritra’s eyes were half-closed and covered with blood, making his sight even more unclear.
Taking a deep breath forcefully, Vritra used the Nether eye to see the red abomination and found that not only was it not dead yet, but very soon the creature would be back for another round.
’Damn. Should I give up?’
A thought appeared in his mind for a moment. Rather than enduring all this pain and suffering, it would be so much easier to just give up and get a faster death.
But there was no way he could ever do that; it wasn’t his own life that was at stake here.
Yasmine, Fiona, Vanessa, Diana, and even Yennifer—his disappearance would be disastrous for them all. Not to mention, Zengis and his girl.
Using pure willpower, Vritra gripped his fists tightly and bit his lower lip hard, pushing his body up with all his might.
Blood dripped down his body as he shakily rose to his feet, staggering and barely keeping himself up.
Dragging his body, Vritra began to move towards the immobile creature, passing by the rubble created from their hours of battle.
It took a couple of minutes for Vritra to just cross that distance.
Somehow, he managed to arrive in front of the red abomination, then he set his feet over the creature’s arm and climbed onto its chest.
Despite his effort to avoid those dangerous teeth, those sharp things still left more wounds on his body as Vritra got close to the knife.
Dropping to his knees, Vritra gazed down at the hole created by the blast earlier.
It was just a bit below the chest. Without wasting a moment, Vritra pushed his right arm into the creature’s wound, moving towards its heart, suppressing all the pain.
"D-Devour..." he muttered weakly as soon as his fingers pressed against the soft heart.
Instantly, the Sin Coin melted into thick liquid that climbed onto his arm and then covered his entire body, almost looking like a red suit before disappearing into his body.
GRRAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

The creature let out one last roar as its body began to disintegrate into tiny insects. Vritra fell down on the ground, gasping for breath, and his mind finally succumbed to injuries as he fell into an unconscious state.
In the next moment, several messages popped in front of him.
{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{Evolution in process...}
Instantly, strength and energy flooded his body—all his stats increasing rapidly.
This was such a big jump that Vritra was pulled out of his unconsciousness, feeling as if electricity was coursing through his veins.
It was a comfortable and strange feeling at the same time. He had successfully reached the 3rd Legion rank!!
Every aspect of his abilities increased; even his natural healing became several times better, but it was nothing like back in the outside world.
The critical injuries he had just received would need at least three days of rest to heal.
So he won’t be able to fight even a single abomination for three to four days. It took a few minutes for the changes to finish, his overall battle prowess had increased by several times.
If he fought against the red abomination now, then he probably wouldn’t be in such a miserable state, though defeating that thing would still not be easier.
He wiped the blood over his eyes with the back of his hand. At least now he could slightly move his body around, but moving even a bit was still just as painful.
’My fight against that creature had lasted quite long, it should be past nine by now. The night has arrived, but why can’t I sense any abominations around me?
Normally, they would all leave the temple when the sky turns dark...’ Vritra thought, scanning his surroundings.
Maybe it was his good luck that no other creature was here; otherwise, his chances of winning would be zero, even with Yasmine’s help.
’I will return home in the morning, I don’t even want to move a finger right now. Yennifer must be worried, but it is dangerous to move in the night.’
He decided, and with a single thought, his body was pulled into the dimensional book.
’Wifey...’
After entering the different realm, Vritra tried calling for Yasmine, but just as he expected, there was no response.
Sighing internally, he closed his eyes and decided to take some rest.
Even speaking felt like such a chore; nonetheless, he became the winner yet another time in a game where a defeat is permanent and no second chances would be given.
The bleeding had stopped thanks to his intra shuffle skill, but the severe injuries and a slight amount of poison remained.
A few minutes passed in silence. Unlike usual, the sound of the bugs and animals could be heard—he couldn’t spot even a single RipMaw.
After twenty or so minutes, he blinked his exhausted eyes open and for some reason had a bad feeling in his heart.
All of a sudden, Vritra sensed something in the distance as his eyes widened.
The dimensional book page that he had given to Yennifer had just been used, just as he had instructed her to.
Which definitely showed that she was in danger.
"Those Cultist fuckers!!" Cursing, Vritra pushed himself off the ground as he endured the pain and left the dimensional book, landing on the ground outside.
His eyes were filled with rage as a bloody aura spread through the surroundings, his killing intent seemingly even stronger than before, crushing the debris around him.
Pressing his feet against the ground, Vritra stomped with his right leg, forming a crater there as his body shot forward, his speed despite the injuries surpassing his limits.
Yennifer had prepared the food and had been waiting for Vritra. She decided to go out and have a chat with the group of married women.
Even after the evening passed, there were no signs of Vritra returning; she felt so worried about him, feeling really uncomfortable.
Even after the sky turned dark, Vritra didn’t return. The Empress felt her body go cold and her heart getting squeezed by pain.
"Where are you... husband?" In the past few days, she had really gotten used to calling him that.
KNOCK KNOCK
