chapters.title: Chapter 337: The Empress’s last regrets
paragraphs: KNOCK KNOCK
Yennifer’s ears perked when she heard the knock at the door.
Before she knew it, her body moved as she hastily made her way to the door.
But just as she was about to open the door, the empress paused and kept her hand on the doorknob.
She had already locked all the doors and windows and then covered them with layers of clothes, but she knew it had already gotten quite late and outside was extremely dangerous right now.
"Who is it?"
She asked, her heart pounding, wishing for it really to be Vritra.
"It is me, Yennifer, hurry up, open the door. There is an abomination close by, I am Vritra!!" came the answer from outside.
The empress frowned. Even though the voice was similar to Vritra’s, she had a feeling that something was off.
So instead of opening the door, she asked further:
"But my husband is inside with me, who the hell are you? I am Yenni, you got the wrong person."
She spoke and waited for the response, while taking out the page that Vritra had given her.
Though she didn’t know if it was just a symbol of protection or could actually do something, in the past few days, her trust in him had increased immensely.
"..." There was a momentary silence before the voice from the other side burst out, "Agghhh, Y-Yennifer, help me... cough... p-please open the door... ughhh... I am r-right here..."
BANG BANG
Yennifer was completely certain by now that this was definitely not Vritra.
She moved away from the door, glancing around, looking for any way to escape if those people or things tried to break in.
"Where are you, Vritra, please be safe..." she muttered, moving close to the back door; they usually kept it locked.
For a minute there was no sound from the other side, but all of a sudden a big stone struck the window, breaking it to pieces.
They had also installed wooden boards just in case, right behind the windows, but even that was destroyed within moments.
KRRIIIEEEE
The sound of an abomination could instantly be heard.
Just as the window broke, Yennifer saw the face of a man smiling in her direction, wearing the red robe of the Bone Blood Cult.
He didn’t linger around after breaking the window; within seconds, he disappeared into the darkness.
The empress’s heart was beating wildly. She had faced countless life and death situations before, but she had never found herself this powerless in a battle.

’Where can I go even after escaping from the house? There are several of those creatures roaming around the town at night. What should I do now?’ she thought long and hard but couldn’t find any way to save her life.
But in her heart, there was a feeling that if she could just hold on long enough then Vritra would definitely come to save her.
Gripping the knob of the door, she unlocked it but kept the door closed and stared into the darkness out of the broken window.
Finally, a terrifying looking creature appeared in front of her. Remembering the previous time, she didn’t dare look straight at it.
GIRRRIIIRRRII
The abomination let out strange noises as it slowly moved into the house through the window, twisting its body.
Yennifer waited for the right moment as she felt the terrifying aura of the creature.
She had never sensed such a feeling from anything before; she wondered what exactly this thing was.
THUD THUD
The abomination’s body towered over Yennifer, strange pus dropping from its body and the twisted sound of its teeth snapping ringing, as the creature walked close to her.
Yennifer glanced forward faintly and was shocked to see that right outside the window of her house, there were at least six or seven more abominations.
Without a thought, she tore the paper and threw it at them, before turning around and making her escape through the back door.
ROOAAAARRRRRRR
The people in their houses shivered upon hearing the noises of several RipMaws.
It was obvious that more people were going to die now, but they could do nothing but cower in their houses.

Just as Yennifer ran out of the house, several of the creatures pounced at her, but right at that moment the dimensional page exploded and created a strange force, locking them all there for a short time.
Huff Huff
The empress didn’t wait to see the effect as she ran with all her might. There was no way anyone was going to open their doors for her at this time.
She started rushing towards the town hall. Sometimes Chopper would spend the night there, so he was her only hope.
The creatures broke out of the shackles as they all let out a frightening wave of roars.
Within moments, the entire house was broken to pieces as the terrifying monsters chased after Yennifer.
Even though she was powerless, with just her experience, Yennifer could barely dodge them. Her body was still quite agile.
Jumping high, she barely dodged getting stabbed by one of the abominations as they quickly caught up to her.
Only now did she understand how bad the situation was; there were more than thirty or even fifty abominations focused just on her.
Now she wasn’t sure if even Vritra would be able to help her, and she was still not sure if he was alive or not.
BANG
GRRRRRRRRRR
They launched attack upon attack, and by the time Yennifer had arrived close to the town hall, all the abominations had surrounded her from all sides.
"Ughhh," despite her best efforts, she received a few deep wounds on her body, as blood started rushing out and poison entered her body.
"C- CHOPPER! Haa, ARE YOU THERE?! OPEN THE DOOR!!" she shouted. If the door didn’t open, then her death was imminent.
BOOOOOOM
Another creature landed right beside Yennifer after a big leap, creating a big crater.
The town hall wasn’t affected by it, but Yennifer’s fragile body was thrown back.
She coughed blood and could feel that a few of her ribs might be broken upon the strong impact against the town hall.
Gathering her strength, she raised her body and sat with her back against the wall, finally looking directly at the disgusting creatures.

’Haa, they certainly look very ugly, no wonder he reacted like that.’ Yennifer thought, wondering if the poison would kill her faster or these countless creatures, who were ready to tear her body to pieces.
A sudden sadness filled her heart; sad that she wasn’t able to fulfill one of the greatest missions of her life and that she wouldn’t be able to see him one last time before her death.
Who would have thought the great empress would die in a place like this and because of the Bone Blood Cult no less? All of a sudden, strength and all her struggle seemed so meaningless.
Vritra’s face appeared in her mind. She wished he was still alive, or how tragic would it be for both of them to die together, yet so far away from each other.
HRRRRRAAARRR
Yennifer watched as dozens of deadly attacks were launched at her. She closed her eyes as countless thoughts passed through her mind.
BOOOOM!!

sentences.text: KNOCK KNOCK
Yennifer’s ears perked when she heard the knock at the door.
Before she knew it, her body moved as she hastily made her way to the door.
But just as she was about to open the door, the empress paused and kept her hand on the doorknob.
She had already locked all the doors and windows and then covered them with layers of clothes, but she knew it had already gotten quite late and outside was extremely dangerous right now.
"Who is it?"
She asked, her heart pounding, wishing for it really to be Vritra.
"It is me, Yennifer, hurry up, open the door.
There is an abomination close by, I am Vritra!!" came the answer from outside.
The empress frowned.
Even though the voice was similar to Vritra’s, she had a feeling that something was off.
So instead of opening the door, she asked further:
"But my husband is inside with me, who the hell are you?
I am Yenni, you got the wrong person."
She spoke and waited for the response, while taking out the page that Vritra had given her.
Though she didn’t know if it was just a symbol of protection or could actually do something, in the past few days, her trust in him had increased immensely.
"..." There was a momentary silence before the voice from the other side burst out, "Agghhh, Y-Yennifer, help me... cough... p-please open the door... ughhh...
I am r-right here..."
BANG BANG
Yennifer was completely certain by now that this was definitely not Vritra.
She moved away from the door, glancing around, looking for any way to escape if those people or things tried to break in.
"Where are you, Vritra, please be safe..." she muttered, moving close to the back door; they usually kept it locked.
For a minute there was no sound from the other side, but all of a sudden a big stone struck the window, breaking it to pieces.
They had also installed wooden boards just in case, right behind the windows, but even that was destroyed within moments.
KRRIIIEEEE
The sound of an abomination could instantly be heard.
Just as the window broke, Yennifer saw the face of a man smiling in her direction, wearing the red robe of the Bone Blood Cult.
He didn’t linger around after breaking the window; within seconds, he disappeared into the darkness.
The empress’s heart was beating wildly.
She had faced countless life and death situations before, but she had never found herself this powerless in a battle.
’Where can I go even after escaping from the house?
There are several of those creatures roaming around the town at night.
What should I do now?’ she thought long and hard but couldn’t find any way to save her life.
But in her heart, there was a feeling that if she could just hold on long enough then Vritra would definitely come to save her.
Gripping the knob of the door, she unlocked it but kept the door closed and stared into the darkness out of the broken window.
Finally, a terrifying looking creature appeared in front of her.
Remembering the previous time, she didn’t dare look straight at it.
GIRRRIIIRRRII
The abomination let out strange noises as it slowly moved into the house through the window, twisting its body.
Yennifer waited for the right moment as she felt the terrifying aura of the creature.
She had never sensed such a feeling from anything before; she wondered what exactly this thing was.
THUD THUD
The abomination’s body towered over Yennifer, strange pus dropping from its body and the twisted sound of its teeth snapping ringing, as the creature walked close to her.
Yennifer glanced forward faintly and was shocked to see that right outside the window of her house, there were at least six or seven more abominations.
Without a thought, she tore the paper and threw it at them, before turning around and making her escape through the back door.
ROOAAAARRRRRRR
The people in their houses shivered upon hearing the noises of several RipMaws.
It was obvious that more people were going to die now, but they could do nothing but cower in their houses.

Just as Yennifer ran out of the house, several of the creatures pounced at her, but right at that moment the dimensional page exploded and created a strange force, locking them all there for a short time.
Huff Huff
The empress didn’t wait to see the effect as she ran with all her might.
There was no way anyone was going to open their doors for her at this time.
She started rushing towards the town hall.
Sometimes Chopper would spend the night there, so he was her only hope.
The creatures broke out of the shackles as they all let out a frightening wave of roars.
Within moments, the entire house was broken to pieces as the terrifying monsters chased after Yennifer.
Even though she was powerless, with just her experience, Yennifer could barely dodge them.
Her body was still quite agile.
Jumping high, she barely dodged getting stabbed by one of the abominations as they quickly caught up to her.
Only now did she understand how bad the situation was; there were more than thirty or even fifty abominations focused just on her.
Now she wasn’t sure if even Vritra would be able to help her, and she was still not sure if he was alive or not.
BANG
GRRRRRRRRRR
They launched attack upon attack, and by the time Yennifer had arrived close to the town hall, all the abominations had surrounded her from all sides.
"Ughhh," despite her best efforts, she received a few deep wounds on her body, as blood started rushing out and poison entered her body.
"C- CHOPPER!
Haa, ARE YOU THERE?!
OPEN THE DOOR!!" she shouted.
If the door didn’t open, then her death was imminent.
BOOOOOOM
Another creature landed right beside Yennifer after a big leap, creating a big crater.
The town hall wasn’t affected by it, but Yennifer’s fragile body was thrown back.
She coughed blood and could feel that a few of her ribs might be broken upon the strong impact against the town hall.
Gathering her strength, she raised her body and sat with her back against the wall, finally looking directly at the disgusting creatures.

’Haa, they certainly look very ugly, no wonder he reacted like that.’ Yennifer thought, wondering if the poison would kill her faster or these countless creatures, who were ready to tear her body to pieces.
A sudden sadness filled her heart; sad that she wasn’t able to fulfill one of the greatest missions of her life and that she wouldn’t be able to see him one last time before her death.
Who would have thought the great empress would die in a place like this and because of the Bone Blood Cult no less?
All of a sudden, strength and all her struggle seemed so meaningless.
Vritra’s face appeared in her mind.
She wished he was still alive, or how tragic would it be for both of them to die together, yet so far away from each other.
HRRRRRAAARRR
Yennifer watched as dozens of deadly attacks were launched at her.
She closed her eyes as countless thoughts passed through her mind.
BOOOOM!!

chapters.title: Chapter 338: DEVOUR!
paragraphs: Vritra ran at full speed, pushing his body to the limits even if his skin got torn or veins burst, using all the skills to boost himself.
He moved so fast that even the trees around him got destroyed, leaving a deep narrow lane on the ground.
Uncontrollable rage burst out of his body, his suppressed aura breaking out as the creatures in dozens of kilometers radius became silent and hid.
Whatever came in front of Vritra was destroyed, whether it be rocks or trees.
When he had covered half the distance, he heard the sound of the abominations, and he understood why the forest was so empty.
It seemed Bone Blood Cult had somehow directed those abominations towards the town.
He swore to give those cultists the most ugly death and wipe Bone Blood Cult off completely, but before that, he needed to cleanse this realm of each and every abomination.

Vritra crossed the large distance within a minute, and by the time he arrived near the town, he could clearly hear the loud banging sounds and those twisted roars along with the faint and helpless footsteps of his Yennifer.
Stomping the ground with all his strength, Vritra’s body rose high into the air and with his nether eye, he scanned the entire town.

"!!!" The moment he saw Yennifer’s injured and bloodied body, resting against the wall and barely conscious, the surroundings exploded with bloodlust creating an atmosphere similar to the bloody mist in the forest.
’Forbid: When I kick the air is solid.’
[Forbidden Activated.]
Vritra twisted his body in the air, facing the direction of the town hall as he pulled his feet slightly and then kicked the air, his body shooting forward like a rocket.
Right when the blade-like teeth of the abominations were about to crush her body, Vritra smashed himself into them.
His hands moved at extreme speed as he punched the limbs approaching Yennifer.
BOOOOOOM!!
A wave of air blew around, more than dozens of the abominations were pushed back, their teeth covered in Vritra’s fresh blood.
Yennifer’s body jerked as something warm dripped onto her face, she slowly opened her eyes and saw his broad back, facing all the abominations and alone standing in the way to protect her.
"..." For a few seconds, she was just speechless and couldn’t think of anything, just staring at Vritra’s back, her heart thumping loudly but not because of fear.
But then her eyes widened as she saw the countless severe wounds covering his body, his body swayed slightly, his hands trembling as he pulled two long knives out of nowhere.
"H- Husband..."
For a moment, it was as if everything had disappeared and only the two of them existed, she was sure that he had rushed back to protect her despite his injuries.
Yennifer felt even more pained, wanting to protect him, to relieve him of the pain he must be feeling but she felt utterly powerless.
"I... haa am fine, go inside." Vritra muttered without turning, he wiped the blood off his eyes and steadied his body.
Before the empress could say anything, Vritra muttered:
"Forbid: the air of the town becomes solid for all abominations."
[Forbidden Activated.]

Instantly the abominations who were ready to charge again at Vritra were frozen, even the hundreds of the abominations which were rushing towards the town hall, all of them froze as if they were stuck.
Vritra turned, then he gently grabbed her hand before pulling Yennifer to her feet.
Yennifer could feel the warmth of his blood as he gripped her hand, she wanted to speak but Vritra just pulled her towards the door.
He grabbed the knob and with a gentle push the entire door came off, then he pushed her inside and spoke: "Rest inside, I will be back in a few minutes."
"W- Wait just come inside with me-" Yennifer tried to speak but she didn’t know, now that the door of this place was broken, the sort of barrier had broken so this was no longer safe.
Vritra ignored her words and muttered: "Forbid: Poison."
[Forbidden Activated.]
The sight of her injuries, the blackening of her skin due to poison, all of it only fuelled his rage.
Then he struck the door back into its place, locking it there using a couple of his knives.
Finally, he turned around and gazed at the creatures who were starting to get free already.
"Forbid: the entire town is a prison, they can enter but can’t leave."
[Forbidden Activated.]
The air once again became normal while the entire town was locked up, and it wouldn’t be easy for the abominations to leave, not that he was going to just let them leave.
Turning to face the countless creatures, Vritra took a deep breath, his body was already very exhausted and each breath made his throat and chest burn.
He would kill as many as he could within a single breath and then take a brief rest.
GRRRRRAAAAAAHHHH!!
ROOOAAAARRRRRRRR!!
KRRRIIIEEEEEEEKKKKK!!
All the abominations let out terrifying screams as they rushed at Vritra, crowding him and throwing all sorts of attacks at him.
[Shift Activated.]
Vritra pushed all his stats to strength, planning to go all out and with brute force, tear them apart.

With his strength at the initial levels of the 3rd Legion rank, he could kill two or three abominations at the same time without much difficulty but facing so many in his condition was still very difficult.
BANG
CLANG CLANG
As the battle broke out, Vritra threw the two long knives at the bodies of the two creatures with all his might, while jumping high and kicking the head of one of them.

As the creature was pushed back, Vritra landed close to one of the stabbed abominations, he gripped the blade’s handle and easily tore the skin, before plunging his hand into its chest and pulling its heart out.
’DEVOUR!!’
Vritra let out a loud battle cry in his mind, not waiting for a moment and moving his body as fast as he could, delivering punches and kicks to any creature that came close.
Whenever the abominations struck any of the buildings, they ended up colliding with some sort of invisible barrier, stopping them and making their bodies burn.
Vritra dodged the attacks he could, parried the others he couldn’t and allowed few to land on his body only to deliver several times the damage in return.
A bloody scene broke out as the entire town was filled with deafening battle sounds, everyone shivered in their houses, feeling as if the end of the town was coming closer.
DEVOUR! DEVOUR! DEVOUR! DEVOUR! DEVOUR!
Vritra swung the big knives as he slashed off the long feet of an abomination and jumped towards its neck, with just his nether eye he could already guess the exact locations of their hearts.
Along with his level these skills also grew after all.
Vritra, panting heavily, gripped the sharp teeth around the neck of the abomination and ripped them apart, taking out its heart.
Another deep cut appeared on his back, but Vritra retorted with even more force, tearing one of the creatures in half with his bare hand.
He ignored the messages that kept popping up but his strength was undoubtedly increasing with each creature he killed.
Vritra slowly dragged the crowd away from the town hall, it was like he had returned to that cave where he had to face countless demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Speed Run
paragraphs: The entire town was filled with the sound of battle for the entire night, everyone hid in the deepest corner of their houses, praying to survive this frightening night.
No one knew exactly what was happening, but they could clearly feel the tremors that made their houses shake, hearing the continuous terrifying and twisted screams of the abominations.
Yennifer’s face was pale, she stood close to the window, trying to faintly see the battle in the distance.
Thankfully, Vritra had stopped the poison from spreading in her body, but she still felt quite weak.
She could barely see lots of big shadows in the distance that kept disappearing one after the other.
Her gaze searched for Vritra but he had disappeared in the crowd of abominations.
From a bit after nine, the battle continued on for hours, the explosive noises only intensified as more time passed.
At one point Yennifer’s body gave up and she fell unconscious for a while, waking up nearly five hours later, when the darkness had started to recede and the sound of battle had disappeared.
Now not a single abomination could be seen or heard in the town. Maybe since the morning arrived, they ran away.
Yennifer just wanted to go out and check up on him, but when she tried, she was unable to open the door.
Even the windows were covered by metallic bars, locking her inside the town hall.
She called for help and continued to pull the door. After a while, when the sky had brightened up, a few people finally had the courage to leave their houses.
Some of the men opened the door after removing the knives with some difficulty.
"A- Are you alright?"
One of the men asked, staring in shock at Yennifer’s face.
Since her veil was missing, her beautiful face was clearly visible, though it was covered by blood and dirt.
The empress ignored them all as she ran out of there, rushing towards the area where the battle had taken place.
More and more people started to come out, and they were just baffled by the scene.
Vritra was lying on top of a soft bed made of dead insects, countless of them.
His body was covered by way too many wounds and completely bloodied.
"H- Husband...!!"
Yennifer muttered, pausing as she saw Vritra’s leg hanging down from the high bed.
She didn’t even know if he was alive or not.
Mark looked at the countless dead insects.
After slight hesitation, he climbed onto the top and checked Vritra’s condition, and he was shocked to find that despite so many serious wounds...
"H- He is just sleeping." He spoke in shock.
By now most of the town had gathered there but they couldn’t understand what exactly had happened.
They wondered if Vritra really survived a night outside all by himself, but then what were all these insects?
"Oh!!" The empress was overjoyed hearing that, but her heart ached nonetheless, seeing those injuries.
She had never wanted to slaughter the Bone Blood Cult this badly in her life.
Vritra was quickly brought back to a different home.
Yennifer removed his bloodied clothes and then applied medicine carefully to all his wounds, bandaging his entire body with clean clothes.
He slept for the entire day, then the whole night, and finally woke up later in the morning the next day.
’Haa, where am I?’ Vritra thought as he slowly opened his eyes and saw a different ceiling. Slowly the memories of his fight returned.
His body was so exhausted and wounded that near the end of the battle, he didn’t even know what he was doing, but his body kept moving on autopilot.
’Ughh, I still feel so tired, but the pain has mostly gone away by now.’ Checking his body’s condition, Vritra was relieved.
All his wounds would be healed within a day or two.
He felt a slight weight on top of his body. Glancing down, he saw Yennifer’s slender arm resting over his chest while she slept beside him.
Her hair were a bit messy, but she just looked more beautiful.
She seemed perfectly fine now, the poison had completely disappeared and only a few scratches were left.
’I killed quite a lot of abominations previously, I wonder how much my level has increased.’ Vritra thought and glanced at the notifications.
{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{Evolution in process...}
Vritra read the messages.
He had killed more than seven hundred abominations in just one night, and now his level should be around 3,760.
That was such a big leap. In the outside world, increasing each level is so difficult, but because of the sin coins it was like Vritra was doing a speed run.
’Looks like my self-healing ability has also increased, but I had taken too much damage.
Now it won’t be long before I find a way out. I hope mom and the others are fine.’ Vritra thought. He called out to Yasmine but received no response.
He was really missing the constant teasing and advice of his dragon waifu.
Yennifer woke up again to check up on Vritra, but seeing that he was awake, she was overjoyed.
"Vritra, you are finally awake!! I- I was so worried. Do your wounds still hurt? Are you—"
In worry, the empress began to ask one question after another, but Vritra kissed her soft lips and silenced her.
"I am fine now, don’t worry. These wounds will heal quickly." He added and pulled her into his arms.
"..." The empress was silent for a few seconds, just loving being so close to him.
She didn’t care about anything else and was just happy that he was fine.
"It was those Bone Blood Cultists, right?" Vritra asked, his expression changing.
"Yeah, I did see one. One of the members first pretended to be you, even copying your voice and using your real name." Yennifer replied, not bothered by the smell of medicines.
"Looks like I will have to clean them up first." Vritra mumbled. He was sure that it wasn’t a coincidence that they chose to attack exactly when he was not home.
So, they most probably knew that he had killed abominations, which meant they had seen Vritra fight before and it greatly narrowed the search area.
"Just rest for now. Those cultists must have obtained something special here, which allowed them to move in the night and even attract so many abominations.
They could even talk to their organisation easily." Yennifer said. Revenge could be taken later, but first Vritra needed to get enough rest.
Suddenly a loud shout rang out from outside.
"What the fuck are you talking about? There is no way we could do that."
Vritra and Yennifer looked at one another. This enraged voice clearly belonged to Chopper.
"Let’s go check it." Vritra said as he pushed his body up with some difficulty.
"No, just rest, I will go—" Yennifer tried to stop him but Vritra sat up.
"As I said, I am feeling better now." He said.

{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have cleansed one Red RipMaw!!}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have absorbed the Red Sin Coin.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{You have levelled up.}
{Evolution in process...}
Vritra read the messages.
He had killed more than seven hundred abominations in just one night, and now his level should be around 3,760.
That was such a big leap.
In the outside world, increasing each level is so difficult, but because of the sin coins it was like Vritra was doing a speed run.
’Looks like my self-healing ability has also increased, but I had taken too much damage.
Now it won’t be long before I find a way out.
I hope mom and the others are fine.’ Vritra thought.
He called out to Yasmine but received no response.
He was really missing the constant teasing and advice of his dragon waifu.
Yennifer woke up again to check up on Vritra, but seeing that he was awake, she was overjoyed.
"Vritra, you are finally awake!!
I- I was so worried.
Do your wounds still hurt?
Are you—"
In worry, the empress began to ask one question after another, but Vritra kissed her soft lips and silenced her.
"I am fine now, don’t worry.
These wounds will heal quickly." He added and pulled her into his arms.
"..." The empress was silent for a few seconds, just loving being so close to him.
She didn’t care about anything else and was just happy that he was fine.
"It was those Bone Blood Cultists, right?" Vritra asked, his expression changing.
"Yeah, I did see one.
One of the members first pretended to be you, even copying your voice and using your real name." Yennifer replied, not bothered by the smell of medicines.
"Looks like I will have to clean them up first." Vritra mumbled.
He was sure that it wasn’t a coincidence that they chose to attack exactly when he was not home.
So, they most probably knew that he had killed abominations, which meant they had seen Vritra fight before and it greatly narrowed the search area.
"Just rest for now.
Those cultists must have obtained something special here, which allowed them to move in the night and even attract so many abominations.
They could even talk to their organisation easily." Yennifer said.
Revenge could be taken later, but first Vritra needed to get enough rest.
Suddenly a loud shout rang out from outside.
"What the fuck are you talking about?
There is no way we could do that."
Vritra and Yennifer looked at one another.
This enraged voice clearly belonged to Chopper.
"Let’s go check it." Vritra said as he pushed his body up with some difficulty.
"No, just rest, I will go—" Yennifer tried to stop him but Vritra sat up.
"As I said, I am feeling better now." He said.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Barking
paragraphs: With Yennefer’s help, Vritra walked towards the entrance of their new home.
Opening the door, they found that most of the people of the town were gathered outside and two groups seemed to have formed.
On one side was Chopper with the smaller group and on the other side a young man seemed to be the leader of the group.
Both the sides seemed to be in a heated discussion, clearing his throat, Vritra asked: "Chopper, what’s going on here?"
"Oh you are awake, what are you doing out here? Go inside, you need to rest." Chopper said, not wanting him to hear anything.
"Just tell us, what is going on?" Yennefer said with a frown, feeling so many unfriendly gazes focused on her.
"Hmph, he won’t say anything, let me tell you." The guy from the other group with a big beard stepped forward and said in a loud voice, as if declaring some new law:
"We have just received a threat from the Bone Blood Cult, that if you stay in this town then they will kill all the residents, using those abominations.
So, you have to leave, I don’t know or care where you two live but you can’t stay here any longer."
"..." Vritra looked around and soon saw the message written on the town hall in big letters, they wanted Yennefer to leave the protection of the town.
"Yes you have to leave, or do you want everyone in the town to die because of you?"
"Throw them out of the town, the Bone Blood Cult has become more active ever since they arrived."
"How can you say that? What is the guarantee that they won’t do it after they left?
What if those cultists want any of you to leave next time?!!" Chopper spoke in rage.
But most of the people wanted the empress and Vritra to leave.
"..." Yennefer was silent, not sure what to say. She didn’t really care about these people, but couldn’t just ignore them right now.
Vritra lightly tapped over Yennefer’s arm, taking a step forward.
He stretched slightly and then straightened, he wasn’t wearing a shirt since his upper body was covered by bandages.
Yennefer stared at his back, feeling butterflies in her belly, as she remembered the scene when he stood in front of hundreds of abominations.
He looked so hot, shaking her head she brought herself back to the present.
Vritra walked towards the bearded guy, pausing in front of him, he spoke: "And how are you going to make us leave? By barking outside our house?"
"What?!!" the bearded guy was shocked at first, he looked Vritra up and down and laughed.
"Do you want to die? Go and hide inside the house, if I sneeze too hard I might end up accidentally breaking a bone or two of yours—"
Before he could finish, Vritra raised his right hand and flicked a finger, just beside the bearded guy’s ear.
BANG
It was like a bomb had exploded, the bearded guy staggered and let out a scream, clutching his ear as blood began to leak out.
Everyone was shocked to see a several-meter-long and half a meter deep crater in the ground.
They stared at him in bafflement, finding it impossible to believe that someone could really be this strong in this town.
"Now, who wants me and my wife to leave this town, please step forward." Vritra said, his piercing gaze scanning the crowd.
They all shivered under his gaze and looked down, even the air seemed to feel suffocating all of a sudden.
Vritra decided to no longer hide his strength, he needed to instill some fear in their hearts.
"Good, now return to your work and if I find a single person trash talking about her, I WILL FIND YOU AND MAKE YOU UNDERSTAND WHAT PAIN REALLY IS!!"
No sooner had he finished, the entire crowd dispersed, leaving only a few people behind.
"Damn dude, how did you do that? Did your complete strength return?" Mark walked up to him and asked, looking awed.
"So I was right, you really had killed many abominations. Ben, did you find a way out of here?" Chopper said.
"Woah, so handsome..." Lisa stared at him with wide eyes.
As soon as the others were gone, Vritra walked back to Yennefer and leaned onto her, appearing very weak.
"Can’t you see how injured my husband is, keep your questions for now."
Yennefer said, calling him her husband made her feel all tingly inside, she loved claiming him and showing everyone who he truly belonged to.
"O- Oh, please forgive us, we just got a little too excited here." Chopper and the others apologized, they watched as the couple walked back inside.
"Didn’t Ben look ten times more handsome now?" Lisa muttered with a dreamy look.
"Yeah he did, but didn’t you have a lover waiting for you outside? And have you not seen Yenni’s face before, I have never seen a woman as beautiful, so give up."
Mark patted her shoulder before leaving.
Vritra and Yennefer lay on the bed, she hugged him even tighter.
It felt so good when he stood against everyone for her, and Vritra keeps making her feel it again and again.
"Ouch, are you trying to kill me by a hug?" Vritra said, though getting tightly embraced by her soft body only brought a pleasurable feeling.
"Ah sorry, I forgot about your injuries for a moment. You know, I have been meaning to say something to you..." Yennefer spoke, her breathing getting faster.
"What? Don’t tell me you are getting horny again, well I can’t really move much so—" Vritra joked, loving teasing this emotionless empress.
"Not that, I mean I can wait for a while. Anyway, I wanted to say that I think—no I mean..." taking a deep breath she spoke: "I love you!"
Yennefer wasn’t really as shy as other women and was quite straightforward with her feelings, and by now she was sure she wanted to always stay close to him.
"Oh, and what about that emperor of yours? And that Han that keeps following you? And you know, I am already in relation with other women, are you really fine with it?"
Vritra said, their relation couldn’t begin properly until a few things had been cleared.
"You don’t have to worry about Han or the emperor, they won’t be able to control my life for long. As for those women... you can keep them."
Yennefer said, though the jealousy could clearly be seen on her face.
"I see, okay I understand. But first let’s get out of here." Vritra added, it was impossible to completely understand a person in a short time.
He wasn’t sure if she would still be exactly the same after all her strength returns.
And he also wanted to know more about her, about her obsessions, why she hated demons so much.
Lying in each other’s arms, they started talking about different things.
"Can you tell me why you hate the demons so much?" Vritra asked after a while, he was sure it must be a sensitive topic for her.
"..." Yennefer fell silent, her mood clearly getting down.
After a moment she spoke: "I am sorry but I can’t tell you about it yet, it is sort of an... oath for me."

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Crazy Leveling up!!
paragraphs: Vritra rested for two whole days, and during this time no one dared to say anything to them or even complain to Chopper despite the threats of the Bone Blood Cult increasing.
By the third day, Vritra had mostly healed, almost all his injuries had disappeared by now.
He needed to finish up the task as soon as possible and also take care of those cultists.
Vritra left his house early in the morning, at that time those people didn’t have the courage to enter the town.
Using the forbidden skill creatively, he was able to fly.
Rushing at full speed, he soon arrived near the temple.
"Sigh I am so tired of sleeping, sob I can’t sleep anymore..." Yasmine spoke, sighing loudly.
"Don’t worry, I will get us out of here quickly. The demon war must have already started in the White Kingdom." He muttered, making his way into the temple.
"Yeah, but this place sure is great for leveling up. You have already entered the 3rd Legion rank, yet you could still level up so fast.

And normally, increasing a single level takes so long and so much effort." Yasmine said. If this Divine had left so much for his successor, then the challenges that he was going to face in the future were going to be infinitely dangerous.
Vritra paused after arriving in front of the large hall, the number of abominations praying this time was clearly a lot less compared to before.
"Forbid: All Sin Coins glows."
[Forbidden Activated.]
The hearts of all the abominations began to glow at the same time, but they didn’t seem bothered by it in the slightest.
Vritra quickly memorized the locations of all their hearts then he spoke:
"Forbid: There could not be any sound inside the temple."
[Forbidden Activated.]
"After we leave, the first thing I am going to do is kill those Bone Blood Cultists." Yasmine said.
Setting the crazy level up aside, it was all because of him that Vritra had suffered so much.
’Yeah don’t worry, this time I won’t let him escape.’ Vritra said as he rolled up his sleeves and casually walked closer to the prostrated abominations, who wouldn’t react easily.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility + Endurance → Strength]
As if pulling out vegetables from the ground, Vritra plunged his right hand into the neck of the first abomination, and then pulled out the head-sized heart of the creature before mumbling:
"Devour."
Feeling the cold liquid spreading across his arm and then getting absorbed into his body, Vritra moved onto the next target.
The injured RipMaw let out a loud scream and spasmed on the ground but no other creature in the temple noticed it.
’Now my strength has reached a level that I can easily kill these abominations, though killing the red ones will still be a challenge.’
While talking with Yasmine, Vritra began to pluck the hearts of all the creatures out one by one and absorbed the Sin Coins.
In just a minute he had killed more than ten abominations. If others were to know that picking levels was this easy, then they would be puking out blood.

"I can still remember the day when I had killed a demon general for the first time, and my father made the rule that anyone who wished to marry me in the future would have to defeat him." Yasmine said, remembering the memories of her father.
"Heh so he wanted you to stay single for a long time huh, how strong was he?" Vritra asked, pulling out one more Sin Cell.
"Except for the gods, there were only a very, very few that could even survive against him in a battle." Yasmine said, though at her peak, her strength wasn’t any less than her father’s.
"But don’t you know where your mother had disappeared off to?" Vritra asked, increasing his speed by several times as his level began to rise rapidly.
But it wasn’t long before he had met yet another bottleneck, but this time he just continued to absorb the Sin Coins, he could just deal with the red creatures later.
"No, she just disappeared one day, and despite searching for so many years I wasn’t able to find her until I received the news that she was killed by the demons." Yasmine replied, sounding quite sad.

"So, don’t you hate all demons as well? Like Yennefer, did even the thought of ever hating me appear in your mind?" Vritra questioned, it was quite normal after all, those demons had taken far too much from her.
"Hubby, don’t compare me with anyone. My love for you transcends it all, always staying with you is all that matters to me.
The only reason I want to return to the Dragon Kingdom is so that I could get my body back and we can finally be together.
Heh once she gets to know you are a demon, you will find out that her love isn’t even a tenth of mine." Yasmine said confidently.
"Oh." Vritra was surprised that she reacted so strongly, but on second thought, it was a bad decision to even mention one of his women in front of another, especially the Empress.
While chatting, in an hour, Vritra had devoured the hearts of all the abominations. Now only two red abominations remained.
But before that, he approached the statue and moved to the back side where he saw a brighter glow.
’Now what are these drawings?’ Vritra stared at the drawings curiously. It was like a story or maybe the process of evolution.
The first image was that of the same insect, after which it seemed to have eaten up the body of some creature that seemed a lot bigger than the insect.
Then the small insect began to change, Vritra found it hard to understand the things ahead of it.
"Hmm if I were you I wouldn’t try to understand it just yet, I can definitely say that this drawing contains one of the Six Truths." Yasmine said lazily.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Surprised +1}
"Oh, one of the Six Truths? The truth of Divine?" Vritra asked in surprise.
"Yeah, though it doesn’t seem to be complete. Maybe it is separated into different realms of the Divine.
Anyway, look at that hole below the drawing, I can confidently say that the key of leaving this realm has been stolen." Yasmine added, yawning.
"And Bone Blood Cultists must be behind it, right?" Vritra asked, he had found the way to escape.
"Yeah, so first you kill these red RipMaws and then those cultists, we can go out today!!" she said with excitement.
"Alright let’s do it, I am sure I can kill those two with my current strength." Vritra said, and he took out a knife from the dimensional book and walked towards one of the abominations.
Without saying a word he plunged the long knife near its left shoulder, bringing the abomination to its senses as it let out a deafening roar.
Vritra gave it no time as he rained down punches and kicks at the knife, while locking the creature in the same position with Forbidden for a minute.
GRRRRRRRRRRRRRR

The abomination’s body twisted as it tried to move its heart away but Vritra suddenly pulled out the sword and plunged his hand deep into the wound. The moment he felt the soft heart he muttered: "Devour."
The kill was so easy, previously Vritra almost died while killing one of these creatures. His strength had increased tremendously after entering this place.
The Divine was truly too powerful, these Sin Coins could bring disaster to the outside world if even words of them leaked out.
After the absorption finished and his strength shot higher and higher, Vritra approached the lone abomination, the only one praying in the big temple.
"Wake up, it’s time to die." Smiling, Vritra cut the body of the red abomination into two with a single strike, and before its body could heal back he picked the heart.
"Devour." Again that same overwhelming feeling returned, his strength increased rapidly once more.
And lots of messages popped in front of him.
{You have cleansed all the Red RipMaws!!}
{Would you like to undergo the complete evolution and obtain the Divine’s Bloodline and Physique?}

{Note: If you agree, drastic changes will take place in your body and in the world. So only start the evolution if you wish to walk the path of the Divine. But start it only once you don’t have any pressing matters.}
Vritra read the strange note. If it meant increasing his strength then of course he would choose it, but upon reading the last line he decided to start it after leaving this place.
{You have become the lord of the Abandoned Realm, you can exit or enter at any moment and can control anything inside the realm.}
Then another surprising but wonderful message popped in front of him, it was such a great place. Won’t most enemies be powerless after entering this realm?
"Well that sounds great, anyway first I need to deal with those cultists." Vritra said, and with a thought, he was able to find the exact locations of all the cultists.
"Wifey, you no longer have to worry about your energy getting drained by this place, I have taken care of it." Vritra said, as he rose into the air and flew towards the cultists.
All his strength had returned now, with a thought he could control almost everything in the realm.
Not far away from the temple, inside a cave, a group of men seemed to be planning something.
’So they were hiding here, now let’s see how much torture they can tolerate.’ Vritra thought as he landed at the entrance of the cave and walked inside.

"And Bone Blood Cultists must be behind it, right?" Vritra asked, he had found the way to escape.
"Yeah, so first you kill these red RipMaws and then those cultists, we can go out today!!" she said with excitement.
"Alright let’s do it, I am sure I can kill those two with my current strength." Vritra said, and he took out a knife from the dimensional book and walked towards one of the abominations.
Without saying a word he plunged the long knife near its left shoulder, bringing the abomination to its senses as it let out a deafening roar.
Vritra gave it no time as he rained down punches and kicks at the knife, while locking the creature in the same position with Forbidden for a minute.
GRRRRRRRRRRRRRR
The abomination’s body twisted as it tried to move its heart away but Vritra suddenly pulled out the sword and plunged his hand deep into the wound.
The moment he felt the soft heart he muttered: "Devour."
The kill was so easy, previously Vritra almost died while killing one of these creatures.
His strength had increased tremendously after entering this place.
The Divine was truly too powerful, these Sin Coins could bring disaster to the outside world if even words of them leaked out.
After the absorption finished and his strength shot higher and higher, Vritra approached the lone abomination, the only one praying in the big temple.
"Wake up, it’s time to die." Smiling, Vritra cut the body of the red abomination into two with a single strike, and before its body could heal back he picked the heart.
"Devour." Again that same overwhelming feeling returned, his strength increased rapidly once more.
And lots of messages popped in front of him.
{You have cleansed all the Red RipMaws!!}
{Would you like to undergo the complete evolution and obtain the Divine’s Bloodline and Physique?}
{Note: If you agree, drastic changes will take place in your body and in the world.
So only start the evolution if you wish to walk the path of the Divine.
But start it only once you don’t have any pressing matters.}
Vritra read the strange note.
If it meant increasing his strength then of course he would choose it, but upon reading the last line he decided to start it after leaving this place.
{You have become the lord of the Abandoned Realm, you can exit or enter at any moment and can control anything inside the realm.}
Then another surprising but wonderful message popped in front of him, it was such a great place.
Won’t most enemies be powerless after entering this realm?
"Well that sounds great, anyway first I need to deal with those cultists." Vritra said, and with a thought, he was able to find the exact locations of all the cultists.
"Wifey, you no longer have to worry about your energy getting drained by this place, I have taken care of it." Vritra said, as he rose into the air and flew towards the cultists.
All his strength had returned now, with a thought he could control almost everything in the realm.
Not far away from the temple, inside a cave, a group of men seemed to be planning something.
’So they were hiding here, now let’s see how much torture they can tolerate.’ Vritra thought as he landed at the entrance of the cave and walked inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: The Passage
paragraphs: Just a few seconds after Vritra had entered the cave, the screams of the Bone Blood Cultists began to ring out.
Now that his complete strength was back, he was able to give the worst kind of death they could have gotten.
The entire torture continued for nearly forty minutes, after which they just ended up dying on their own.
Vritra stood with his arms crossed in front of his chest, not even a single drop of blood on his body.
He gazed at the scenery in front of him, there were more than fifteen men who had just died.
Though now it was impossible to distinguish which limb and organ belonged to whom.
One person had his head split open like a blooming flower while his body was covered by molten lava.
Another one had a large spike going up from his ass and coming straight out of his mouth, their bodies were completely destroyed from inside and out.
"Haa That felt quite nice, now let’s leave." Vritra held a spherical-shaped stone-like object with intricate patterns covering it.
This was the object that allowed these men to walk out at night without any worry, and even attract the abominations.
Flying out of the cave, Vritra headed directly towards the temple.
"Finally!! I will be able to see my cute mother-in-law, just you wait hubby, I am going to complain that you completely ignored me for another woman. Sob Poor me, the first wife..."
Yasmine said, wiping away her imaginary tears.
"Heh What can I say, my naughty wife just loves seeing that sort of thing a bit too much." Vritra chuckled, as he soon arrived close to the temple.
"I don’t enjoy it, I just watched for research purposes, you know." Yasmine replied in an honest tone.
Shaking his head, Vritra approached the large statue, walking behind it he pushed the spherical object into the hole and waited.
Instantly the large statue began to move, and a cave opened behind it, which was spacious enough.
"Uh... That’s a rather strange place for a cave to be, but on second thought, it also seems normal?" Yasmine muttered, seeing the passage that opened beside the drawings.
"Will this passage bring us outside?" Vritra asked.
"Yeah it will, it’s time to return." Yasmine said, letting out a sigh.
This strange realm was quite a strange experience for them both although filled with countless dangers but the gains were really high.
Nodding, Vritra turned and flew away, he planned to bring everyone out of there.
Arriving in the town in less than a minute, Vritra decided to tell this news to Yennifer first.
It was still around noon and she was busy having a chat with other women, getting to know a lot of new things.
"Yenni" landing in front of the group, Vritra called out. The women were surprised that now Vritra was even able to fly.
"Husband!!" the empress exclaimed as she stood up and walked up to him and gave Vritra a tight hug.
"You finished hunting quite fast today." She muttered while holding him tightly, this sort of life was unimaginable for her just a few days ago.
"I found the way to get out of this place, we can finally leave." Vritra announced, surprising everyone who heard.
The sound of chatter filled the air, and it wasn’t long before the news spread across the entire town, everyone knew Vritra after all and no one doubted his words.
"Really?!!" Yennefer was really excited and happy by the news.
Soon most of the people of the town gathered, Chopper stood in front of the group and asked just to confirm: "You really found the exit from this cursed place?"
"Yes, so pack up, we are leaving." Vritra said, he and Yennefer didn’t really have anything to pack but other people wanted to bring a few things out with them.
Some because of the memories of the ones that had died here, while some had just gotten attached to a few things.
But it didn’t take long before they were all ready to leave. With a snap of Vritra’s finger, a large platform of dust was created.
"Everyone, climb on it." Vritra said as he jumped on the platform, Yennefer stuck close to him as if they had really gotten married.
"I had been here for so long that this feels like a dream." Lisa muttered, pinching her arm.
"Yeah, I had already given up hope of ever getting out of this place, just staying alive daily was our biggest fight." Mark spoke, walking onto the large platform.
As everyone climbed on top of it, the platform started flying, heading straight towards the forest.
The people were still afraid to even go to the forest, but none of them wanted to stay in this realm for a moment longer.
All the people were surprised when they saw the enormous temple, but Vritra didn’t let them waste any time in sightseeing, he wanted to return to the White Kingdom as soon as possible.
"Woah such a big statue, why would they build a temple for an insect?" someone in the crowd muttered.
Chopper who was seated on Duffus’s shoulder, looked around curiously and wondered who really was Vritra.
Without him they would never have been able to get out of there.
"Alright now hurry up and go into the passage one by one." Vritra said in a loud voice, as all the people formed a line and started walking inside.

"Thank you Ben, I am really very grateful to you, if we end up at different locations after leaving then make sure to come visit me. Remember, I am the king of the White Kingdom?" Chopper said gratefully.
"Sure Chief, now hurry up, the demons must be wreaking havoc in the kingdom." Vritra said and finally except for him and Yennefer, everyone had left.
"Shall we go?" he asked, taking her hand in his. The empress had a small smile on her face as she nodded, wondering if things would stay the same between them even outside.
They both walked through the passage, the deeper they went the darker it became and at one point, even the sensation of land beneath their feet disappeared.
It was like they were falling and kept falling for a while, but upon opening their eyes, the two found themselves in the Night Forest at exactly the place where they had fallen in the trap.
"We are back!!" Yennefer exclaimed, and she felt so much better as all her strength returned.
"Yeah-" Vritra was just nodding when his gaze moved towards the White Kingdom not so far away, and he was really shocked.
The big wall surrounding it had been completely destroyed, fire and smoke could clearly be seen all over the kingdom.
It was complete chaos.
"Oh, did the demons win the war?" the empress muttered, normally people with such high strength wouldn’t meddle in such things, after all a Demon Lord wasn’t attacking the kingdom.
Vritra scanned the area and felt that all the Soul Wraiths that he had left behind with the three women had been killed, so they returned to the inventory.
He flew higher and looked at the devastated state of the kingdom, there was no doubt, the demons had defeated and taken over the White Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: The Celebration
paragraphs: "Let’s go inside and check it." Yennefer said, as the two flew into the kingdom.
Right at its entrance, they saw a group of demons who seemed to be guarding the large gates.
Vritra and Yennefer ignored them for now and flew into the kingdom, wherever they looked they saw demons.
The human families were being treated as slaves, lots of houses were destroyed, wherever they looked it was complete and utter chaos.
Vritra flew directly towards the castle, if the soul wraiths were fine then he wouldn’t have to worry so much but now he really felt on edge.
Just halfway through, they saw a group of captured guards who were kneeling on the ground, and were about to get their heads chopped off.
"These demon bastards!!" Yennefer was barely holding back after seeing all these demons but finally she snapped at them.
With a wave of her hand, more than thirty demons were killed in an instant, a heavy pressure descended on the whole area.
"O- Oh, Empress?!!" the guards were shocked as they saw the veiled woman and a weak-looking man beside her.
"Tell me, how did the kingdom fall to this state?" she questioned, clearly sensing Vritra’s growing tension for his family.
"A- After the news of your death spread along with the God of Mercy, the intrusion of the demons increased and then one day they finally started the war.
They attacked the kingdom but we defended haa haa with all our might, not letting them enter through our boundaries.
After a long stalemate, it was the Slave Beast Gang that broke the power balance.
Those bastards attacked us from the inside a- and we quickly lost the war." The guard explained, while clutching his chest.
"I see, and where are all the people who were staying in the castle?" she asked further, even though she might break a rule or two, she would slaughter all the demons along with him.
"Everyone fought against those demons, many were killed and others were captured.
If you want to find them, then go to the castle, everyone must be there." Another guard answered, they stared at Vritra and finally recognized him.
"Y- You are the God of Mercy right? Your friends and those ladies that were with you were also captured."
One of them said hastily, it wasn’t long before all the people were captured so they were all still alive.
The sky was turning dark, all over the kingdom the cheers of the demons could be heard, the castle seemed especially bright.
Vritra didn’t waste a single moment as he flew at full speed.
Yennefer nodded at the guards and then followed behind him, with her being around, she would make sure that no one could hurt Vritra or escape.
’He had grown stronger compared to before entering that realm.’ Yennefer stared at his back before increasing her speed and flying beside him.
Inside the castle, whose walls were painted with blood, demons filled the entire large building.
Some could be seen dragging around humans, live and dead, some were partying, while many were just singing their tales.
Inside the once prosperous hall of the castle, few people could be seen seated on the chairs, while many powerful demons and humans stood around them.
On one seat was Faceless from the Nine Pacts, then Blunder from Bone Blood Cult. On another seat was Slave, the leader of the Slave Beast Gang, and the demon Beast.

"Hahaha This was ten times easier than any of us had expected. You should have seen the expressions of those humans Haha" Slave, the demon in human appearance, laughed hard while raising his glass of wine.
"Good job, I thought you were completely useless, living among the humans, but it wasn’t meaningless after all." Beast slapped his back, throwing more of the wine into his mouth.
The happiest of the group was of course Blunder and Faceless, not only had they successfully taken care of the empress but even that devil who had given them nightmares for weeks.
"kekeke Cheers, This is great Hic I wanted to kill that fool myself but hic this is good too, I was finally able to get rid of him."
Blunder just kept muttering the same thing over and over, like a maniac, he was happier about Vritra’s death than winning the war.
"I am going to score it big this time, everyone is going to know Faceless of the Nine Pacts!!" Faceless shouted, praising himself for the wonderful deeds he had done.
The humans surrounding them were from the Slave Beast Gang and they were hurriedly serving food and drinks to the four.
"Tomorrow morning, let’s publicly kill a few of the officials we have captured. It will greatly motivate our army." Slave said, gulping another glass down.
"Oh right, let me kill just three of those captives, the family of that devil. Even though I wasn’t able to kill him, I can at least kill them."
Blunder said, as he climbed onto the table, laughing even louder.
Just then, the sound of faint footsteps near the entrance of the hall attracted the attention of many, they looked over and were shocked to see an unfamiliar human enter the hall.
All of a sudden, a heavy pressure fell over the hall, the humans and demons surrounding the table were instantly crushed into the ground.
Their bodies burst out creating a bloody mess all across, with just the pressure more than twenty of those demons were killed, while others found it impossible to even raise their heads.
The celebration and laughter suddenly came to a halt, the four men suddenly became sober as they looked at the new entry that made even them feel shivers.
Blunder rubbed his eyes a few times and fell off the table, muttering in disbelief:
"H- How can this be?!! Am I too drunk? V- V- Vritra?!! How can he be here?"
Faceless wasn’t in any better condition, he stumbled back and looked horrified, seeing that sole figure near the entrance.
Slave and Beast frowned, their bodies tensing up, they couldn’t recognize him for a few moments.
"Who is he?" Beast asked, his face hardening as battle intent rose through his body.
Slave waited for an explanation from the other two guys but when he glanced at them he was shocked to see them spasming on the ground, they looked way too horrified.
"I heard he is Vritra, a demon lord in the making from the Dunshire kingdom." Slave said with a shake of his head. Vritra was right now in his original appearance.
TUK TUK
Vritra walked closer, with each step the pressure increased, cracks forming in the walls and pillars.
His gaze was focused on the four men, he stepped over the head of a demon.
With a crunching sound, his head exploded, even the soul was crushed in a seemingly casual step and just like that a demon in the 3rd Legion rank was killed.
"!!!" Blunder and Faceless were even more baffled, Vritra clearly wasn’t using any demonic energy right now but his strength had grown to such a level that they felt fear just by his presence.
"Well hello, mind if I crash your celebration?" Vritra scanned the four, looking at their levels, all of them were in the fifth Legion rank.
"Oh!! Wait hubby, let me grab my popcorn!!"
Yasmine spoke in excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Semi-Domain
paragraphs: Stopping beside the group of four, Vritra pulled the chair and sat down.
Placing his right arm on the table, he rested his chin on top of his arm, gazing at them with a small smile.
"Heard you were celebrating something big, mind if I join you?"
Vritra spoke, picking a glass half full of wine. He swirled it around and poured it down on Slave’s head.
"H- How can you still be alive?" Faceless finally managed to ask, while hugging Blunder, as the two stuck closer.
TIP TIP
"..." Slave was extremely angry, as the wine dripped from his head.
He glared at Vritra but held back. Before muscles, he always used his brain, and they knew nothing about this new enemy.
But Beast wasn’t as tolerant, he was instantly angered. He kicked away the table and let out a loud roar. His body increased in size as he towered over Vritra, letting out demonic energy.
"Sigh... Forget it, let’s just get it over with." Slave muttered, wiping away the wine. He stood up, and his human form began to distort.
His body grew to match Beast’s size at more than ten feet. He looked quite ugly with several tails and limbs growing randomly over his body and teeth that had absolutely no symmetry.
"Oh, no wonder you liked to stay as human, even mothers won’t love you with an appearance like that." Vritra said, throwing the empty glass away.
ROAARRRR
Slave let out a thunderous roar, enraged by Vritra’s words since his parents really did abandon him when he was young. Of course, both of them were already dead.
"You brazen human, how dare you be so vulgar in front of us!!" Slave shouted, but taking a deep breath he calmed himself, and with a loud menacing laugh he muttered:
"I heard you have your family among our captives, but do you know with just a thought I can make the bodies of all the captives explode. Wanna see it?"
"..." Vritra’s gaze narrowed at the two demons, who had suddenly started laughing out loud. He stood up and, while stretching, spoke:
"Sure, give it a try. You demons love to see others cry and beg, right? Well, I can really understand why that is the case."
A twisted smile spread across Vritra’s face.
All of a sudden the environment around them changed. All the people, even the ones pressed down, found themselves on top of an endless ocean, their feet slightly submerged in the water.
The entire sky was blood red, and a half moon, drowning into the ocean in the distance, could be seen, the air heavy with killing intent.
"!!!" The four people were completely baffled, they didn’t even know when exactly their location was shifted, and now they were inside the Book of Dimensions.
Vritra raised his right foot and took a step forward, his body blurring and flashing in front of Blunder.
"Hey Blunder, long time no see. I heard you got a little problem in your back, let me fix it for you." Vritra spoke.
He leaned forward as his smile became bigger and more demonic, scaring the shit out of the crazy psychopath.
"U- Uwaaaaaah h- Helppppp I didn’t do anything, it was t- them!!" Blunder shouted. Just the memory gave him shivers and pain across his spine.
Before even Vritra’s fingers could touch Blunder, Slave and Beast made their move, clenching their fists they shouted at the same time: "SEMI DOMAIN: RISE!!"
Instantly, the area surrounding the group was completely covered by two semi-spheres, one on top of the other.
"..." Vritra was quite intrigued by this. He halted his movements and observed the semi domain.
’Is this normal at the 5th Legion rank?’ he asked.

"Yes, I believe you might be the only anomaly who hadn’t made any progress towards your Field despite rising to such a high level. We need to work on it as soon as possible." Yasmine replied, but then added:
"Even the Semi Domain has several benefits, like they have greater control inside it, and they could also use a domain-related ability or two.
Even their strength will increase slightly, but this isn’t the full-blown domain so we don’t have anything to worry about."
The levels of the four were all at the initial levels of the 5th Legion rank, they were all below Vritra by many levels.
Blunder pushed himself back and collected his thoughts.
The courage of the two demons gave him motivation, and he knew that if he wanted to get out of this strange realm, then they would have to kill Vritra somehow.
Faceless and Blunder jumped back and held each other’s hand tightly, giving each other support while their legs shook violently.
"SEMI DOMAIN: RISE!!"
And so, Vritra and the group were now covered by four semi domains, all of them completely different from one another.
Blunder’s semi domain looked as if it was made of blood and even turned the air inside into bloody mist.
While Faceless had a strange translucent semi domain with twisted and broken faces appearing all over its surface, and spirit-like entities were floating inside.
Beast’s semi domain was just like him, just brute. It seemed as if it was made of iron as thick as one meter.

And lastly, Slave’s semi domain was invisible. It was certainly there but couldn’t be seen, though the insides were covered by countless sharp and pointy spikes that could deal heavy damage upon impact.
’Interesting, so I can create Dust Domain like that hmm...’ Vritra thought.
He had given up on Null, that skill was too complicated and dangerous. He would end up wasting too much time only to die at the end.
Vritra made up his mind to invest more time into grasping the understanding of his Field after this, but for now he focused on the battle ahead.
"What do you think his level is right now? I can’t sense any demonic energy coming from him, yet he possesses such heavy presence.
How could his level have increased so much in such a short time?" Faceless asked, ready to launch all sorts of attacks.
"He also seems to be at the 5th Legion rank, though I can’t tell what his level exactly is. Maybe he is using some skill or object to hide it.
And you mean to say he had grown to this extent within just a few months?" Beast asked in bafflement, staring at the unknown intruder.
"Yeah, just a few months ago he was summoned to this world by a goddess. When I first saw him he wasn’t even at the 1st Legion rank.
And in the Blue Kingdom he was only at the 1st Legion rank just a couple of months ago."
Faceless answered, terrified by such a fast growth rate. After reaching the 5th Legion rank, they would be stuck at the same level for years, but Vritra made it all look so easy.
"But when is he going to bring out his Semi Domain?" Slave asked, waiting for Vritra.
"Wait, don’t tell me he doesn’t possess any Semi Domain yet?!! Keke, he had grown too fast to properly grasp his Field, right?"
Slave spoke after a moment, as the four felt that victory might be easier than they had expected.

Placing his right arm on the table, he rested his chin on top of his arm, gazing at them with a small smile.

Vritra spoke, picking a glass half full of wine.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Blooming Flower
paragraphs: At the same time, the four activated their semi domain, throwing the men on the ground out of the fighting range before locking onto Vritra.
A semi domain was also like a mobile semi realm where they had a lot of freedom.
Various chains shot out of the walls, some red, some invisible, some iron-like while the remaining were made of faces biting onto one another.
The chains rapidly wrapped around Vritra, locking him in place, but the four of them didn’t stop.
They chose to use one of their strong attacks right from the start, their semi domains glowed and were filled with mana.
Vritra stood completely still, gazing at the domains with interest, while the others were satisfied that they had managed to lock him in place.

A bloody sea drifted and a crucifier-shaped strange red pole appeared right beside Vritra, an invisible blade grew and pierced right through Vritra’s chest and limbs from behind, pinning him to the crucifier.
KIIIEEEEEKKKK
YIIIIIIIEEEEEEE
The spirits floating around suddenly let out loud screams and charged at Vritra, biting down all over his body, making it impossible for him to even move a finger.
Large iron-like shackles formed all over his body, squeezing until his limbs burst into a bloody mixture.
After Vritra was completely locked into the place, the four shot their powerful attacks at him.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
The energy of the four domains was exhausted completely in a single attack, in an instant countless types of attacks were launched at Vritra, his skin was torn, his organs and body exploded.
Getting pierced by thousands of sharp spikes while those creepy faces entered his body and exploded.
The ground and air shook from the intensity of the attack and the realm formed inside the page of the book almost crumbled, tremors passing through even the bodies of the observers.
Pieces of limbs and flesh flew all over the place, and painful screams filled the area, making them feel overjoyed.
They had exhausted quite a lot of energy in this attack, but thankfully it had worked better than expected.
Although their target wasn’t dead yet, it was for the better since now they would be able to torture him slowly.
"Kikiki I knew it, when Slave and Beast get together, even the demon lord—no I mean, demon generals—uhh the weakest demon generals have to give them a little respect." One of the demons muttered.
"That guy was acting all high and mighty, and he couldn’t take a single attack from them pfftt how pitiful, I would die of shame if I were him."
"Zezeze Even I could have beaten that guy, but our leaders got to him first—tsk if I see him the next time then I will—"
The demons and humans were having loud chatter, feeling pride at the wonderful sight.
"Are you all already done? Keep on going, torture him more, let’s see how long he can hold on." Someone from somewhere spoke.
"Haa haa don’t tell us what to do, of course we are going to torture him unlike anyone has ever seen." Faceless said with a sinister laugh, he was going to make this devil feel all sorts of pain.

"Let’s torture him until he starts begging for mercy, I want to see him crawl as he eats up his own words, I want to see despair and fear on that arrogant handsome face of his." Slave said, imagining the worst types of tortures.
"YESSS!! I am going to break him until he cries and licks my shoes." Beast shouted, his blood pumping and rage building inside.
"Yes, yes I have waited so long for this day, just let me finish him up." Blunder said, his expression looking really ugly.
Not far from the group, there was a big throne and Vritra sat lazily on top of it, he held some snacks in his hand and spoke:
"Beat him up, use these, push it inside all his holes. I heard it hurts really badly when you open the blades after inserting in the body."
After speaking he threw several long and thick metallic locks with a strange pattern towards Beast who caught them and said gratefully:
"Thank you, I will use them and give him the most pain, haha these things are good where did you get them? Mind if I keep them for future uses? Again, Thanks Mr?"
Vritra shrugged and answered: "Just found them in a torture room, anyway you can keep them. You can call me Vritra."
Beast nodded and pressed the button below the heavy metal rod and like a flower blooming countless big spikes bloomed all over its surface and a flower on the top.

He got excited by just the thought of opening this thing after inserting it in his enemy’s body, the temperature of the blades was extremely high and there was even poison at the tip of the blades to give the maximum pain.
Vritra threw a piece of meatball into his mouth and enjoyed the sight of Blunder pinned to the crucifier.
With the help of Misty Essence mythic halo, even Blunder wouldn’t know that he was attacking himself.
Blunder kept screaming, one part of his mind was full of despair and was aware of what was happening while the other part kept launching more attacks at him, he was in such a strange state.

"Bravo!! The face, hit his face—Oh uh... Beast you shouldn’t have cut off—ugh that must have hurt, well good job, yes pop them both. Right, let the flower bloom inside and... haha you inserted it too deep."
Vritra passed comments and encouraged the three to torture Blunder, the three sadistic bastards weren’t really holding back in their torture.
Beast had inserted those thick metal rods in every hole he found on Blunder’s body, and when the holes were all filled, he even created more holes just to stick in the remaining ones.
Slave let out all his twisted desires, using the countless spikes to turn him into something that resembled a filter with countless holes.
Faceless wasn’t holding back either, inducing as much pain and injury as he could.
And Blunder, he kept making his own blood explode, cutting nerves and squeezing his organs.
Along with Vritra the others also cheered, as the torture continued for more than an hour.
Finally Vritra stood up from his throne and hovered in the air, then he spoke in a thunderous voice: "STOP!! He is already at his last breath, now let me do one attack as well."
"Sure, thanks for those tools, I will use them wisely in the future as well." Beast agreed and stepped back along with others, they got tired just while torturing the person they believed was Vritra.

"So Blunder, how does it feel to become a pawn in others’ game? Did you enjoy it? Oh right you can’t speak, but you can hear right?" Vritra spoke in a mocking tone, making the psycho feel even more anger.
It was a habit of his to drag anyone he found interesting into chaos, just like how he had done with Vritra.
But for the second time in his life, he regretted all his life choices and actions, he regretted the day when he had killed the king of Dunshire kingdom and met this Devil.
