chapters.title: Chapter 346: The Sweet Revenge
paragraphs: Filled with despair and immense pain, Blunder could only cry and scream, his entire body broken beyond repair.
But because of his high level, his regeneration that had slowed down greatly was still slowly healing him.
Vritra maintained the small smile on his lips and muttered:

"Haa. What a disappointment, and here I thought you were better than that. Why couldn’t you have entertained me for a bit longer? Looks like, in the face of death, even you are not as much of a psycho."
"Well, I have already wasted enough time. I can’t make my guests wait any longer, so let’s end this game right here..."
Vritra spoke, the same twisted smile on his face that Blunder had while saying the same things he did, before adding: "for now, that is."
As Blunder’s mouth healed a little, he spoke in a hissing tone: "D- Dare to ughhh cough have a f- fair fight ahhh?"
Vritra’s smile widened, he condensed a drop of his purplish blood and threw it towards Blunder.
The moment the drop of blood was absorbed into his body, Blunder’s body began to heal rapidly and in less than a minute he was almost back to his peak.
"Just watching was quite boring, we have quite a few things to settle after all," Vritra spoke.
"Huff huff You are going to regret this..." Blunder’s voice was a mix of anger and fear as he used his escape technique to make a run for his life.
His body broke into countless tiny drops of blood and spread in all directions. Getting out of the realm, he ran and ran without even caring where he was heading.
He ran for hours and days without stopping and ran until his body refused to move. Finally, while panting heavily, he stopped.
He really thought that he was going to die this time, although a new trauma seemed to have added to his already existing one but at least he got a third chance at life.
Internally he mocked Vritra for falling for such a trick, while still shivering by the degree of pain he had endured, Beast was definitely the most enthusiastic among all.
"Ughh My body still hurts so much, but I will make him regret this for sure. But how was he able to do all that? Even I was torturing myself—"
Blunder was just speaking but suddenly his body trembled as he found Vritra standing right in front of him, looking at him with a bored expression.
"Are you done?" he asked, then his body blurred and moving at extreme speed Vritra arrived to Blunder’s left.
WHOOOSH
BANG
Swinging his leg, Vritra delivered an explosive kick to his leg, as the crunching sound of bone breaking rang out.
BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG
Without giving Blunder any time, Vritra’s hands moved at full speed delivering hundreds of deadly punches each second.
Blunder could no longer tell what was happening, as pain kept shooting from each and every part of his body. His skin, bones, flesh, everything was torn by the barrage of infinite punches.
Both his eye balls flew off, teeth becoming powder, his body was thoroughly destroyed.
Even Yasmine came out to deliver a few attacks, letting out all the frustration she had felt in the abandoned realm, seeing Vritra hurt.
"S- Spare me, ahhhhh p- please I beg ughh of you, cough I am sorrryyyyy-"
In the next moment, his right hand shot forward as he plunged through the wriggling flesh of the broken man. He gripped the newly healed spine and pulled it out of his body along with the skull.
While crushing his brain and destroying his body, Vritra muttered: "Knight, devour his soul."
[You have killed a level 5200 Human.]
[You have levelled up.]
[+Exp]
[All stats have increased by 50.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
A few messages popped in Vritra’s mind while at the same time, Dark Knight’s level rose as well by a great leap.
Then Vritra’s gaze moved towards the three remaining men, they would be great food for his soul wraiths.
Dusting off his clothes, Vritra jumped back and sat on his throne then he whistled and said: "Round 2: Begin!!"

Beast, Slave and Faceless came out of their stupor, they saw Vritra who was standing in front of them with a grin, confusing the three. Hadn’t they just beaten him nearly to death, or was it all a dream?
Once again the same process took place but this time it was Faceless who was tortured while Vritra enjoyed the whole process, giving his comments on the scope of improvement.
’Hmm Wifey, how about I let mom, Fiona and Diana kill these three, their level will increase by leaps and bounds, and in the future they won’t be so helpless.
Even if I kill all three I would at most gain one more level.’ Vritra asked, while watching Beast and Slave torture Faceless mercilessly.
The worst part was that the man was torturing himself with a sadistic grin while also crying at the same time.
"Well yeah, it could be of great help but there is a reason why big families don’t just get their infants to kill strong demons and become super powerful right from the start.
Their future growth will be slower and comprehending Field will be exponentially difficult.
Hmm all three of them are at 1st Legion rank currently so at most let them reach peak of 2nd Legion—or even 3rd Legion rank at initial levels for now.
They need to comprehend their Field at the same time." Yasmine replied, explaining in detail.
"Uhm... then what about me? Aren’t I in deep shit trouble? I am already at 5th Legion rank and haven’t comprehended the ’F’ of Field..."
Vritra muttered suddenly, feeling as if he had prepared for English when it was the exam for physics.
"Oh that’s... uh well you should be fine, you have got several cheats like your sugar mommy Mutamorphis, sugar daddy Divine, so yeah you should be fine." Yasmine said, after thinking for a moment.
Vritra: "..."
Sighing, he decided to think about his Field later. He also needed to get empty Legion stones for the three women, but he wasn’t worried about that aspect.
[You have killed a level 5240 Human.]
After the two were done torturing him, Vritra just went ahead and killed Faceless. Then it was just Beast torturing Slave.
Only when it was their turn to get tortured did they understand that they had been trapped by Vritra both physically and mentally right from the start.
Slave kept shouting and begging, as those big poles entered all holes on his body and inside the flower bloomed.
Beast was really enjoying using those torturing tools, despite it being the third time he was just as excited and enthusiastic.

"Let’s kill the third guy now." Vritra lazily got off the throne and approached the altar. The Misty Essence mythic halo was too great, even though it was ranked so low it could easily turn the tide of a war.
[You have killed a level 5190 Demon.]
Now only Beast remained and for the fourth time, the torture started. The demons and humans kept cheering the same thing from outside.

Vritra maintained the small smile on his lips and muttered:
"Haa.
What a disappointment, and here I thought you were better than that.
Why couldn’t you have entertained me for a bit longer?
Looks like, in the face of death, even you are not as much of a psycho."
"Well, I have already wasted enough time.
I can’t make my guests wait any longer, so let’s end this game right here..."
Vritra spoke, the same twisted smile on his face that Blunder had while saying the same things he did, before adding: "for now, that is."
As Blunder’s mouth healed a little, he spoke in a hissing tone: "D- Dare to ughhh cough have a f- fair fight ahhh?"
Vritra’s smile widened, he condensed a drop of his purplish blood and threw it towards Blunder.
The moment the drop of blood was absorbed into his body, Blunder’s body began to heal rapidly and in less than a minute he was almost back to his peak.
"Just watching was quite boring, we have quite a few things to settle after all," Vritra spoke.
"Huff huff You are going to regret this..." Blunder’s voice was a mix of anger and fear as he used his escape technique to make a run for his life.
His body broke into countless tiny drops of blood and spread in all directions.
Getting out of the realm, he ran and ran without even caring where he was heading.
He ran for hours and days without stopping and ran until his body refused to move.
Finally, while panting heavily, he stopped.
He really thought that he was going to die this time, although a new trauma seemed to have added to his already existing one but at least he got a third chance at life.
Internally he mocked Vritra for falling for such a trick, while still shivering by the degree of pain he had endured, Beast was definitely the most enthusiastic among all.
"Ughh My body still hurts so much, but I will make him regret this for sure.
But how was he able to do all that?
Even I was torturing myself—"
Blunder was just speaking but suddenly his body trembled as he found Vritra standing right in front of him, looking at him with a bored expression.
"Are you done?" he asked, then his body blurred and moving at extreme speed Vritra arrived to Blunder’s left.
WHOOOSH
BANG
Swinging his leg, Vritra delivered an explosive kick to his leg, as the crunching sound of bone breaking rang out.
BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG
Without giving Blunder any time, Vritra’s hands moved at full speed delivering hundreds of deadly punches each second.
Blunder could no longer tell what was happening, as pain kept shooting from each and every part of his body.
His skin, bones, flesh, everything was torn by the barrage of infinite punches.
Both his eye balls flew off, teeth becoming powder, his body was thoroughly destroyed.
Even Yasmine came out to deliver a few attacks, letting out all the frustration she had felt in the abandoned realm, seeing Vritra hurt.
"S- Spare me, ahhhhh p- please I beg ughh of you, cough I am sorrryyyyy-"
In the next moment, his right hand shot forward as he plunged through the wriggling flesh of the broken man.
He gripped the newly healed spine and pulled it out of his body along with the skull.
While crushing his brain and destroying his body, Vritra muttered: "Knight, devour his soul."
[You have killed a level 5200 Human.]
[You have levelled up.]
[+Exp]
[All stats have increased by 50.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
A few messages popped in Vritra’s mind while at the same time, Dark Knight’s level rose as well by a great leap.
Then Vritra’s gaze moved towards the three remaining men, they would be great food for his soul wraiths.
Dusting off his clothes, Vritra jumped back and sat on his throne then he whistled and said: "Round 2: Begin!!"
Beast, Slave and Faceless came out of their stupor, they saw Vritra who was standing in front of them with a grin, confusing the three.
Hadn’t they just beaten him nearly to death, or was it all a dream?
Once again the same process took place but this time it was Faceless who was tortured while Vritra enjoyed the whole process, giving his comments on the scope of improvement.
’Hmm Wifey, how about I let mom, Fiona and Diana kill these three, their level will increase by leaps and bounds, and in the future they won’t be so helpless.
Even if I kill all three I would at most gain one more level.’ Vritra asked, while watching Beast and Slave torture Faceless mercilessly.
The worst part was that the man was torturing himself with a sadistic grin while also crying at the same time.
"Well yeah, it could be of great help but there is a reason why big families don’t just get their infants to kill strong demons and become super powerful right from the start.
Their future growth will be slower and comprehending Field will be exponentially difficult.
Hmm all three of them are at 1st Legion rank currently so at most let them reach peak of 2nd Legion—or even 3rd Legion rank at initial levels for now.
They need to comprehend their Field at the same time." Yasmine replied, explaining in detail.
"Uhm... then what about me?
Aren’t I in deep shit trouble?
I am already at 5th Legion rank and haven’t comprehended the ’F’ of Field..."
Vritra muttered suddenly, feeling as if he had prepared for English when it was the exam for physics.
"Oh that’s... uh well you should be fine, you have got several cheats like your sugar mommy Mutamorphis, sugar daddy Divine, so yeah you should be fine." Yasmine said, after thinking for a moment.
Vritra: "..."
Sighing, he decided to think about his Field later.
He also needed to get empty Legion stones for the three women, but he wasn’t worried about that aspect.
[You have killed a level 5240 Human.]
After the two were done torturing him, Vritra just went ahead and killed Faceless.
Then it was just Beast torturing Slave.
Only when it was their turn to get tortured did they understand that they had been trapped by Vritra both physically and mentally right from the start.
Slave kept shouting and begging, as those big poles entered all holes on his body and inside the flower bloomed.
Beast was really enjoying using those torturing tools, despite it being the third time he was just as excited and enthusiastic.
"Let’s kill the third guy now." Vritra lazily got off the throne and approached the altar.
The Misty Essence mythic halo was too great, even though it was ranked so low it could easily turn the tide of a war.
[You have killed a level 5190 Demon.]
Now only Beast remained and for the fourth time, the torture started.
The demons and humans kept cheering the same thing from outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Corrosive
paragraphs: Beast was beating himself and even inserted the metallic rods into his own body, feeling the extremely hot flower bloom in the depth of his very being.
Crying and laughing manically at the same time.
[You have killed a level 5262 Demon.]
[You have levelled up.]
[+Exp]
[All stats have increased by 50.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
And soon, Vritra finished killing the four. He left the other demons there, trapped in an endless cycle of illusions.
They would greatly help the three women to level up later in the future.
Flying out of the Dimensional Book, Vritra breathed in the fresh air. He had wanted to kill Blunder and Faceless for so long.
When they had first met, he was so weak that they could have killed him without so much as touching him.
But now he didn’t even need to use his full strength, let alone Demonification or other transformations, to kill four strong beings.
Only at such a moment could he feel that he had actually grown so much after coming to this world.
Vritra had deep hatred for Blunder, from the first moment that psycho dragged him into such a dangerous fight that actually resulted in his death.
And even here, Blunder almost succeeded in killing Vritra and Yennefer.

"Now that’s perfect." Vritra nodded in satisfaction, there were still quite a lot of Sin points left, there were two skills that were yet to be upgraded.
Elegy Parasite and Nether Eye, and aside from that he needed to upgrade the Sin Arrow as well, the first reason he had decided to gather so many sin points.
But before any of that, he decided to go meet with Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana, although the empress had gone to save them.
Flying out of the hall, he hovered in the air and scanned the surroundings.
It didn’t take long for him to find the three women who were moving around at rapid speed and killing demons and humans from Bone Blood Cult and Slave Beast Gang.
"Well, looks like they are perfectly fine and leveling up already. Go and protect them and also devour as many souls as you can."
Vritra released all the soul wraiths, watching in satisfaction how the women were efficiently slaughtering all enemies.
It seemed after fighting in the war, they had grown quite a lot.
Not far away from the group, two guys could be seen riding a bull. Monk Shitless was driving Bullo while Onest stood on the back and kept killing the demons.
’When did they become such good friends? Well, I guess evil attracts evil.’ Vritra thought, the duo was definitely quite troublesome.
Nodding towards Yennefer, Vritra decided to focus on spending those sin points.
"Let’s do it, hubby, and see how they evolve. Maybe with the upgrade of Nether Eye you would even be able to peek in the bathrooms of the beautiful Queens in other continents."
Yasmine laughed, thinking of all the evil ways the skill could be used in the future.
"...No, why would I do that? But let’s see if it can do that." Vritra added, it wouldn’t hurt to do a little research with his skill.
And so he spent 20 million points on Nether Eye, while moving away from that place.
[Upgrading Nether Eye.]
[Upgrade complete.]
[You have obtained the Nether Eye.]
Although its name didn’t change, Vritra had high expectations for the skill, just like all skills from the divine.
[Nether Eye]
[Skill Description]: An all-seeing eye that could see through all illusions and barriers within a range of 100 kilometres.
It can release a corrosive wave that will affect the enemy’s soul and could weaken the enemy greatly or kill them. An eye that not only sees but corrodes, not only limited to souls.
"Oh, that’s quite nice. So it has also transformed, not into an attack-type ability. Great, its soul and mental attack were pretty weak before, and the corrosion isn’t just limited to souls."
Vritra mumbled, and how could he not give it a try when there were so many moving targets all over the place.
[Nether Eye Upgraded.]
Locking onto one of the demons, a black vertical containing endless darkness appeared on his forehead, it didn’t seem that different even after the upgrade.
In the next moment, an invisible wave of energy shot at extreme speed, that even Vritra himself would fail to dodge.

It hit the forehead of the demon who was trying to run away, instantly his body froze, his soul was devoured by the corrosive energy and within moments the 2nd Legion rank demon was killed and only the hollow body was left behind.
But the corrosive energy then began to spread across his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: The Palette!
paragraphs: "Damn, as always, it was better than I had expected." Vritra was truly satisfied with the skill; the corrosive nature would help even against stronger foes.
Along with Blood Lock, the Nether Eye would allow Vritra to kill opponents several times stronger than himself as long as he could stall for enough time.
Vritra wanted to try it a few more times, but he didn’t want to waste all those souls that his soul wraiths could devour, so calming his excitement, Vritra focused on his final skill.
The Elegy Parasite, a skill that he had used only one time before but was quite powerful; it was only because of this skill that Vritra had managed to survive.
"Alright, here goes another 20 million Sin Points."
Vritra mumbled and eagerly spent the points; spending those points didn’t make him hesitate for a single moment.
[Upgrading Elegy Parasite.]
[Upgrade complete.]
[You have obtained the Elegy Parasite.]
Like usual, the name didn’t change, but with the same enthusiasm, Vritra began to read its description.
[Elegy Parasite]
[Skill Description]: A not so dormant parasite that had always hated dying more than anything.
Now, the parasite no longer waits for the user’s health to drop below 1% and could be activated at any time, becoming a hybrid skill.
It can consume enemy’s life force to stay alive, increase strength and heal by using the enemy’s blood, and increase survival instinct steadily throughout the battle.

The parasite can latch onto enemies, controlling their movements and actions temporarily. It won’t go back to slumber until either the threat has disappeared, or the complete life force is devoured or the skill is deactivated.
Vritra: "!!!"
He was truly surprised; the skill had just transformed from passive to hybrid, his favourite type of skill.
Vritra wanted to try it so bad that he couldn’t hold back, but instead of trying it on himself, he decided to try letting it connect to a couple of demons’ bodies.
He quickly scanned the place and found several demons who were running away from Vanessa.
[Elegy Parasite Activated.]
Without wasting a second, he pointed his index finger at them as if ready to shoot with a gun and then launched several larva-like blackish parasites.
They flew at a speed that those demons didn’t even notice; they stuck to the back of their necks and quickly spread throughout their bodies, in the form of tiny web-like lines almost like tattoos.
In less than two seconds, the group of demons lost control of their bodies.
"Pause." Vritra muttered, and the creatures paused, then Vritra instructed them to turn and stand there like live targets.
As Vanessa killed the three, the parasites just disappeared; as expected, it was yet another great skill.
And he could even send his body to autopilot now, making it work at several times the efficiency while using the opponents’ life force; all in all, it was again a fabulous upgrade.

"For now, I am done with upgrading all the skills; originally I planned to upgrade the bloodlines and physiques but after merging, the price shot so high up." Vritra looked at the status panel and sighed.
But there was no problem, after all, the White Kingdom was an endless factory for the production of Sin Points; he can just gather more easily by his new identity.
Now there was just one thing left, upgrading the Divine Sin Arrow, and Vritra was quite excited about it.

"Wifey, are you ready? I wonder how it is going to bring this time around; the last time I got the arrow, I got the option to upgrade all my skills and even weapon." Vritra muttered, rubbing his palms together.
"Don’t make me wait, I want to know too; hurry up and upgrade it." Yasmine urged, eager to see a new Chapter in the growth of her husband.
Nodding, Vritra spent 30 million Sin Points at the upgrade of the Divine Sin Arrow while hoping that it doesn’t take too long like when it merged with the Sin Wheel.
"And here goes 30 million." Vritra muttered, as the pair of husband and wife anticipatingly watched one message flash after another.
[Upgrading the Divine Sin Arrow!!]
[Scanning the host’s body.]
[Calculating...]
[Designing the Palette!!]
Vritra waited; thankfully, the process wasn’t going to take more than around a dozen or so minutes. While the numbers were slowly climbing up, he looked around and observed the area.
His soul wraiths were spread across the entire place, where a demon or human from Bone Blood Cult or Slave Beast Gang was killed, they would pop out of nowhere and devour the soul.
The soul wraiths would even steal the kills from people other than the three women.
A big fight had broken out across the entire kingdom once again, and this time, the demons and those humans were in deep trouble.
Chopper, the king of the White Kingdom, was also back; he was one of the strongest powerhouses being at the 5th Legion rank, and under his command, they began to swipe away all the enemies.
Fiona, Vanessa, and Diana’s level was rising quickly; they would kill anything in their way, and what they couldn’t kill was weakened greatly by the soul wraiths and then they killed it.
"Muahahaha Bullo, charge charge!!" Monk Shitless was laughing maniacally while letting Bullo tear apart demons upon impact; that certainly wasn’t an ordinary bull.
There were stories that he had stolen the bull from someone very powerful when the bull was small, but as always, the evil monk survived.
On the bull’s back, Onest was attacking any of the approaching powerful demons, though he was scared a few times when his kills got stolen out of thin air.
Yennefer was enjoying herself as she flew all across the sky at a terrifying speed, striking the demons and leaving them almost dead.
Killing all these demons wouldn’t contribute much to her level, so she decided to let others take benefit of it, especially Vritra’s family.
[Upgrade complete!!]
While observing the battle around, the process was finally completed. Both Vritra and Yasmine stared at the new messages in excitement.
"Heh, I knew it, sugar daddy Divine..." the dragoness giggled.
[You have obtained the Divine Field Palette!!]
Vritra: "..."
He wanted to deny her but couldn’t; he did wonder since if the Divine really planned everything for him, then he must have thought something about Field as well.
And here the answer was...
"Let’s check it out first, it might be something different." Vritra said, but the two were now even more excited.
The words Divine and Sin would make anything infinitely special, so maybe he would finally be able to comprehend his fields.
Vritra opened the new addition with anticipation.
[Opening the Divine Field Palette.]
Instantly, an interface appeared in front of Vritra, and it really did look like a palette of a painter with several slots where paints are placed.
There were seven slots, and each seemed to contain a different colour, though in extremely small quantity, and a couple of them even looked empty.
"Interesting..." Yasmine muttered, sensing several types of energies from the palette, and just below the big palette, there were several lines written in the panel.
After observing the strange but wonderful interface, they began to read.

They flew at a speed that those demons didn’t even notice; they stuck to the back of their necks and quickly spread throughout their bodies, in the form of tiny web-like lines almost like tattoos.
In less than two seconds, the group of demons lost control of their bodies.
"Pause." Vritra muttered, and the creatures paused, then Vritra instructed them to turn and stand there like live targets.
As Vanessa killed the three, the parasites just disappeared; as expected, it was yet another great skill.
And he could even send his body to autopilot now, making it work at several times the efficiency while using the opponents’ life force; all in all, it was again a fabulous upgrade.

"For now, I am done with upgrading all the skills; originally I planned to upgrade the bloodlines and physiques but after merging, the price shot so high up." Vritra looked at the status panel and sighed.
But there was no problem, after all, the White Kingdom was an endless factory for the production of Sin Points; he can just gather more easily by his new identity.
Now there was just one thing left, upgrading the Divine Sin Arrow, and Vritra was quite excited about it.
"Wifey, are you ready?
I wonder how it is going to bring this time around; the last time I got the arrow, I got the option to upgrade all my skills and even weapon." Vritra muttered, rubbing his palms together.
"Don’t make me wait, I want to know too; hurry up and upgrade it." Yasmine urged, eager to see a new Chapter in the growth of her husband.
Nodding, Vritra spent 30 million Sin Points at the upgrade of the Divine Sin Arrow while hoping that it doesn’t take too long like when it merged with the Sin Wheel.
"And here goes 30 million." Vritra muttered, as the pair of husband and wife anticipatingly watched one message flash after another.
[Upgrading the Divine Sin Arrow!!]
[Scanning the host’s body.]
[Calculating...]
[Designing the Palette!!]
Vritra waited; thankfully, the process wasn’t going to take more than around a dozen or so minutes.
While the numbers were slowly climbing up, he looked around and observed the area.
His soul wraiths were spread across the entire place, where a demon or human from Bone Blood Cult or Slave Beast Gang was killed, they would pop out of nowhere and devour the soul.
The soul wraiths would even steal the kills from people other than the three women.
A big fight had broken out across the entire kingdom once again, and this time, the demons and those humans were in deep trouble.
Chopper, the king of the White Kingdom, was also back; he was one of the strongest powerhouses being at the 5th Legion rank, and under his command, they began to swipe away all the enemies.
Fiona, Vanessa, and Diana’s level was rising quickly; they would kill anything in their way, and what they couldn’t kill was weakened greatly by the soul wraiths and then they killed it.
"Muahahaha Bullo, charge charge!!" Monk Shitless was laughing maniacally while letting Bullo tear apart demons upon impact; that certainly wasn’t an ordinary bull.
There were stories that he had stolen the bull from someone very powerful when the bull was small, but as always, the evil monk survived.
On the bull’s back, Onest was attacking any of the approaching powerful demons, though he was scared a few times when his kills got stolen out of thin air.
Yennefer was enjoying herself as she flew all across the sky at a terrifying speed, striking the demons and leaving them almost dead.
Killing all these demons wouldn’t contribute much to her level, so she decided to let others take benefit of it, especially Vritra’s family.
[Upgrade complete!!]
While observing the battle around, the process was finally completed.
Both Vritra and Yasmine stared at the new messages in excitement.
"Heh, I knew it, sugar daddy Divine..." the dragoness giggled.
[You have obtained the Divine Field Palette!!]
Vritra: "..."
He wanted to deny her but couldn’t; he did wonder since if the Divine really planned everything for him, then he must have thought something about Field as well.
And here the answer was...
"Let’s check it out first, it might be something different." Vritra said, but the two were now even more excited.
The words Divine and Sin would make anything infinitely special, so maybe he would finally be able to comprehend his fields.
Vritra opened the new addition with anticipation.
[Opening the Divine Field Palette.]
Instantly, an interface appeared in front of Vritra, and it really did look like a palette of a painter with several slots where paints are placed.
There were seven slots, and each seemed to contain a different colour, though in extremely small quantity, and a couple of them even looked empty.
"Interesting..." Yasmine muttered, sensing several types of energies from the palette, and just below the big palette, there were several lines written in the panel.
After observing the strange but wonderful interface, they began to read.

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Expensive... or not?
paragraphs: Fields:
-Strength: 4%
-Agility: 4%
-Endurance: 4%
-Mental: 6%
-Soul: 7%
-Dust Manipulation: 3%
-Null:0%
Palette Droplet: 0
{1Palette Droplet: 2 million Sin points.}
(Note: 1 Palette Droplet could increase the comprehension of any of the recorded Fields by 1%.)
Vritra was speechless for a few minutes; he didn’t know whether to be happy or angry. Finally, he muttered:
"Damn, so expensive?!!"
He would have to spend two hundred million Sin Points just to complete the comprehension of Null, but Yasmine’s words made him happier.
"Whoa, so you can have more than one field?!! Hubby, that’s cheating on a whole another level, and you could even bring them to perfection.
Don’t complain without knowing how difficult it is to understand and comprehend the field.

As I said, very, very few could ever reach perfection, so even 200 million Sin Points is a cheap price to pay for something like that," Yasmine said in exasperation; she seemed dozens of times more shocked than Vritra.

"Oh, well, I guess gathering Sin Points isn’t that difficult for now. Yeah, yeah, I am satisfied; calm down, wifey." Vritra said, putting aside the matter of the Sin Points—this thing was too awesome.
With enough Sin Points, he could even comprehend ten or more Fields. Thinking again, Vritra was really overjoyed.
"Finally, the problem of the Field has been resolved; this is great." Vritra spoke.

"Congrats, hubby. Sigh, the world would be shocked if they were to know you had comprehended so many fields, so as you already know, you should keep it a secret like all your other abilities." Yasmine stated the obvious, even more excited about her husband’s future.

’With this done, now there is only the matter of the evolution of my Divine bloodline and physique remains... sigh, why am I growing so fast? It’s hard to keep track of things.’ Vritra sighed, suffering from success.
But the next place was going to be several times more dangerous, so he had to grow as much as possible before leaving the Topaz continent.
Vritra decided to try the Field Palette later; he needed to think about which field he should focus on first after all. As for evolution, he would do it after taking care of all the intruders.
For now, he decided to help with the cleanup of the demons, cultists, and the gang members; he would just let his women take the kills while delivering heavy blows just like Yennefer.
Along with the king, they quickly cleaned up the whole kingdom. Few of them were able to escape, but most were killed; finally, the Slave Beast Gang was wiped out.
It took nearly the entire night, and by morning, the White Kingdom was finally free.
Thanks to Slave Beast Gang, the death count was quite low—if it was a full-blown war, deaths would have been way higher, but now they had captured most to turn them into slaves.
Vritra hovered in the air along with Fiona, Vanessa, Diana, and Yennefer.
The five of them were just about to go and meet with the king, though Chopper was busy with the kingdom’s matter right now.
"You must have gained enough experience points to bring you to the 3rd Legion rank. Now we only need the Legion stones." Vritra mumbled while scanning the three women.
"..." Yennefer was about to offer the Legion stones to Vritra, but seeing the women’s affectionate gazes, she felt jealous and just remained silent; she would need more time to get used to this.
"Uhm, Empress, aren’t you leaving?" Fiona asked, seeing that Yennefer just stood there as if she was a part of their group.
"No—" just as Yennefer was about to answer, the gazes of the people were attracted toward the sky where a figure wrapped in black smoke flew at a speed that could easily match Yennefer’s top speed.
Vritra focused and barely managed to see two red eyes that scanned the place before flying away; even the lingering presence was quite heavy.
"I FOUND YOU!!" The air around Yennefer changed all of a sudden; without wasting a moment, she flew away, chasing after the disappearing figure.
"And here she goes..." Vritra mumbled, her hatred for demons was truly unprecedented. Ignoring her, he spoke: "I will explain everything that happened later; first, let’s go meet the king."
The Empress seemed to have forgotten everything as she chased after the demon lord with intense killing intent, only the thought of slaughtering the demon lord remaining in her mind.
Vritra could understand that she must hate demons because of some bad past experience, but he didn’t like that level of obsessiveness; it could be harmful for her and the people around her.
So he decided to just ignore her for now and later.
He had started to like her, but if she doesn’t change, then it would just be impossible for them to ever be together in the future.
He felt relieved that none of the three were hurt in the demon war. While flying towards the castle, they shared how it all began.

Initially, the kingdom’s army was able to handle those demons for a few days, but when the Slave Beast Gang targeted the kingdom from inside and even used the citizens’ lives, the army had no choice but to give up any sort of resistance.

All of them were captured peacefully with only a few casualties, and so the demons, Bone Blood Cult, Nine Pacts, and the gang obtained so many humans who could be used as test subjects, slaves, or any other purpose.
Vritra also explained how he got trapped in a realm where his strength had disappeared, also telling them about his time with the Empress.
"Honey, if she hates demons so much, will she accept you? B- But if she tries to hurt you, then I will..." Vanessa spoke, but there wasn’t really much she could do against the Empress.
"I will just turn her entire family into mindless creatures." She added after thinking.
Finally, the three women felt satisfied with their growth; they were already at the peak of 1st Legion rank and only needed the Legion stones to reach the 3rd Legion rank.
"Don’t worry, I will be careful, but I don’t think it will be possible to remove that hatred from her heart. Anyway, have you been comprehending your fields?" Vritra asked, gazing into the distance.
"Yeah, comprehending my Holy field is rather easy for me; I guess perks of being a goddess." Diana said proudly. If she had really tried to grow, then her strength would be a lot higher by now.
"I am working on it as well, though it’s a little difficult, but because of the inheritance I received, comprehending my Field wouldn’t be too hard." Fiona answered.

"Well, my progress is slow and I am trying to understand it better, but I feel like my comprehension is still lacking." Vanessa added with a sigh; she also didn’t like the feeling of getting left behind.

"Mm hmm, I understand, Mom; it seems we need to train more so you can comprehend it more deeply." Vritra suggested with a smile, but he knew they needed to know more about succubus so that her progression could be faster.
"Sure, honey, I was actually missing our training sessions." Vanessa added, with a knowing smile, looking extremely seductive just like the hottest succubus alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Vritra: God of Modesty
paragraphs: Soon the group arrived at the temple. All the people were busy arranging things.
They had been slaves for demons for a very short time, but there was a lot of chaos across the kingdom.
Chopper was busy giving orders while capturing many of the humans and directly killing the demons.
Vritra and the others had to wait for a couple of dozen minutes for Chopper to be free. They sat in the king’s discussion chamber and just chatted.

"Haa, sorry to make you all wait. Everything has been more hectic than I imagined. I will need several weeks to bring everything back to normal, but I will finally be able to remove this slave system," Chopper said as he wiped his forehead and jumped off Duffus’s shoulder.
The giant man was originally the protector of the king and was one of the strongest warriors under him.
"Duffus, get some rest as well. Your family must be missing you. I will call for you when I need your help with something," Chopper said as he sat on the chair.
"..." Duffus gratefully bowed and hurriedly left the room, worried about his family’s well-being, though he had already heard that they are fine.

"The nobles sure aren’t going to be happy about removing the slave system. I am sure it must be because of them that the Slave Beast Gang was able to grow to this extent, since they supported slavery and indirectly the gang itself."
Vritra said, picking up a glass of juice and a straw from the table, then taking a small sip.

"Yeah, they sure will be troublesome. But now if they still try anything, I will just attack them directly. After all, the Slave Beast Gang was connected with demons, and anyone supporting them would be considered so as well," Chopper said.
Looking around, he asked, "But where is your wife Yenni?"
"She has gone away because of some work," Vritra answered. In front of the king, he was in his original body, though he normally stayed as Ben.
"Ben, it is impossible to express with words how grateful I am to you. It is only because of you that I was able to get out of that wretched place and that this kingdom was able to survive.
Tell me, if there is anything I can do for you, then I will do my best," Chopper said, determination etched on his face.
"Oh, I didn’t really need anything. We are friends and I just did the obvious," Vritra said, surprising Diana and Yasmine.
The two women wondered when he became such a good person.
"Come on, I insist. I would feel bad if I can’t do anything for you, but if—" Chopper was speaking when Vritra interrupted him.
"Well, if you are forcing me so much, then can you arrange some Soul Potions for me?" he spoke modestly.
"How many?" Chopper asked.
"As many as you can. And while you are at it, can you give me three empty 2nd Legion stones?" Vritra asked, decreasing his modesty ever so slightly.
"Okay, that’s no problem. This is nothing in front of what you did for me and the kingdom. So—" Chopper was once again interrupted.
"Sigh, yeah, so this much isn’t enough to make you feel better? Then add three empty 3rd Legion ranked stones as well," Vritra added, still trying to be modest.
"Oh well, I can arrange that as well. If that’s all then—" Chopper was interrupted yet again.

"Haa, I understand. Being the king of such a big kingdom, these things must be nothing for you. Then why don’t you add three empty 4th ranked legion stones and three 5th ranked as well? Well, I won’t shy away since you insist so much.
I would be happier if you could add a few hundred high-level weapons, potions, and other stuff," Vritra spoke, throwing modesty in the gutter.
Chopper: "..."
"Uhm... I can arrange three empty 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Legion rank stones, though 4th ranked ones will be difficult.
But I can’t get the 5th Legion ranked ones. As for those potions and weapons, I will do my best," Chopper chuckled, shaking his head.
"Oh, don’t forget the money, we will be traveling outside the continent very soon after all," Diana reminded.
"King Chopper, that will be all for now," Vritra said, placing his arm over Chopper’s shoulder, a serious look on his face.
"Hahaha, okay, I will arrange them as soon as possible. But where is the God of Mercy I have been hearing so much about? He also seemed to have disappeared not long ago," the king asked.
There was a knock on the door and several of the ministers had come to speak to him, though Chopper told them to wait a little longer.
"Who knows, maybe he disappeared in the abandoned realm," Vritra shrugged his shoulder.
They chatted for a while longer, then Chopper had to leave to deal with several things, but he ordered the servants to prepare all the things Vritra had asked for and more.
While the materials were being prepared, the group of four returned to their room. Vritra lay back on the bed, feeling relaxed.
Though the peace this time was going to be very short-lived.
A problem thousands of times bigger than anything before was already present in the not-too-far-ahead future of the luckiest man alive.
Fiona sat on a chair.
In her fight earlier, she seemed to have grasped something about her Field which resonated with the memories of the first Phoenix Queen, so she closed her eyes and concentrated.
On Vritra’s right, Vanessa lay and observed every slightest movement on his face, watching his steady breathing.
’Sigh, why is my son so handsome? I am starving...’ Vanessa thought and leaned forward, pressing her soft moist lips against his, waking Vritra up.
The goddess on the left was surprised at this open display of affection but she was craving him so badly as well.
Feeling his mother’s warm lips, Vritra rolled slightly and was now on top of Vanessa. He cupped her face before taking her lips in his, nibbling and sucking on them.
"Mhmmm~" Vanessa wrapped her arms around his neck tightly, desperately in need of his kisses and a lot more. She reciprocated with the same hunger as the two began to suck and bite each other’s lips.
Diana wanted to join too but wasn’t sure how or if she should, but seeing the taboo display, the heat in her body rose.
Vanessa’s faint moans soon transformed into wet sounds, as her lips parted and their tongues met in a sensual and passionate kiss.
GULP
Diana could clearly see their tongues rolling and saliva becoming a hot mess.
Their lips rubbing against one another, while the tongues intertwined and moved from one mouth to another.
Vritra squeezed his mother’s breasts, even from above the clothes, they felt incredibly soft.
He continued to massage and knead her soft flesh, feeling his fingers sinking into the tender melons, and before long he could even feel something wet against his palms.
"Mmmm~" Vanessa let out a moan, a pleasurable current traversing from her breasts to her entire body.
Pulling her tongue into his mouth, Vritra sucked on the sweet tongue, nibbling on it and rubbing against his own tongue.
Their breathing quickened as Vritra pulled Vanessa’s clothes, exposing her fair buttery skin.
